O calado portugus foi capaz de criar novos processos de produo, promovendo uma forte ligao entre as empresas, e demonstrou que no s  indispensvel como  possvel melhorar o padro de especializao intrasectorial, atravs da aposta no s na melhoria da qualidade do produto como na antecipao das tendncias da procura nos segmentos superiores de mercado, passando da condio de fornecedores de produtos para a condio de produtores de tendncias de procura, isto , de moda, e dos correspondentes produtos. Esta demonstrao de mobilidade intrasectorial para segmentos superiores de mercado, com maior valor acrescentado e maior controlo da cadeia de valor, constitui a melhor demonstrao de que h futuro para as empresas dos sectores tradicionais e de que este futuro no depende da persistncia de um modelo de competitividade baseada em baixos salrios, mas sim de uma dinmica consistente, combinando capacidade de gesto, tecnologia, absoro de conhecimento, conhecimento dos mercados e da dinmica da procura. Em segundo lugar, o sector do calado reala a importncia da exposio  concorrncia no processo de melhoria de especializao intrasectorial quando acompanhada de esprito empreendedor e de uma adequada atitude empresarial. Contrariamente a outros sectores, o sector do calado respondeu ou, mesmo, antecipou a agressiva e crescente concorrncia internacional, atravs de uma melhoria dos nveis de eficincia e do reposicionamento no mercado. O sector do calado converteu duas grandes ameaas em duas grandes oportunidades. Refiro-me  integrao europeia, com a consequente abertura do mercado domstico que estava at ento cativo; e  abertura do mercado da Comunidade Europeia no contexto da globalizao e da emergncia da concorrncia dos pases asiticos com baixos salrios. O sucesso das respostas no foi fruto do acaso nem resultado do improviso. Foi sim o resultado da partilha de um sentimento estratgico entre os actores deste processo, que teve como pilares uma conscincia dos objectivos a atingir e dos meios a mobilizar e das vias a seguir. Entre estes e outros factores, o papel da APICCAPS foi determinante, no s porque promoveu o associativismo mas, sobretudo, porque promoveu o associativismo em torno da partilha alargada de um diagnstico da situao do sector e da evoluo dos mercados, de uma viso de futuro e dos meios para a concretizar, isto , pela partilha de um conceito estratgico que guiou a multiplicidade das aces e dos actores que determinaram a trajectria bem-sucedida do sector. A recente conquista do Prmio Europeu de Promoo Empresarial na categoria Apoio  Internacionalizao  um reconhecimento de todo o trabalho realizado pela APICCAPS, sendo tambm uma garantia de renovao dos xitos alcanados no passado. Esta capacidade empreendedora da APICCAPS constitui no s um caso digno de estudo por todos aqueles que hoje se dedicam ao estudo do conceito de collective entrepreneurship, na senda do trabalho de Schumpeter, como constitui uma referncia para a resposta dos demais sectores transacionveis onde predominam as PME. Parabns ao sector do calado e  respectiva associao, a APICCAPS. Frankfurt, 4 de Dezembro de 2013 Carlos da Silva Costa Governador Banco de Portugal

Title: Initial intervention by Governor Carlos da Silva Costa in the Committee on Budget, Finance and Public Administration on the authorization granted for the creation of the "Postal Bank" in the framework of the privatization of CTT
text: Initial intervention by Governor C... Initial intervention by Governor Carlos da Silva Costa in the Committee on Budget, Finance and Public Administration on the authorization granted for the creation of the "Postal Bank" in the framework of the privatization of CTT Feb. 14. 2014 The purpose of this hearing is to be granted by Banco de Portugal for the creation of Banco Postal in the context of the privatisation of the TTCs. As you know, the provision of information on specific cases is limited by the legal obligations of secrecy to which Banco de Portugal is subject. The clarifications I shall provide are thus essentially related to the processing and the criteria underlying any procedure for setting up a credit institution in accordance with the applicable national and European legislation. The process of setting up a credit institution is, as provided for in the General Regime of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations (RGICSF), consisting of three phases: (i) The first stage consists of the authorisation for the establishment of the credit institution; (ii) In a second phase, authorization is requested for the start of the activity, carried out through the request for special registration at Banco de Portugal. To this end, and following the institution's request, Banco de Portugal shall check on the spot whether the minimum legal and operational requirements necessary for the development of the activity are met; (iii) The third phase takes place in parallel with the second and consists of the assessment of the suitability of the members of the governing bodies. Therefore, the fact that Banco de Portugal authorises the establishment of a credit institution does not necessarily imply that the institution actually starts its activity. Without special registration at Banco de Portugal, the constitution authorisation shall expire if the institution does not start its activity within 12 months, an extendable period for another 12 months at the request of the interested parties. The process of constitution of Banco Postal, S.A. began on August 5, 2013, with the submission of an application of ctt to Banco de Portugal. Banco de Portugal's services then examined the elements that instructed the initial application to verify whether the conditions in Article 14 of the General Regime were fulfilled, i.e.:  Formal regularity;  Minimum share capital;  Main and effective head office of the administration in Portugal;  Sound devices in terms of the government of society;  Effective risk identification, management, control and communication processes;  Appropriate internal control mechanisms;  Remuneration policies and practices consistent with sound and prudent management. In addition to any non-compliance with any of these conditions, Banco de Portugal may refuse authorisation only on the basis of the additional reasons provided for in Article 20 of the General Scheme:  Lack of conditions of shareholders to ensure sound and prudent management;  Insufficient technical and financial resources;  Unviability of adequate supervision. This is an analysis based on objective criteria, strict compliance with the general principles of legality, equality, impartiality, collaboration with individuals and good faith, set out in the Code of Administrative Procedure. The evaluation of the future institution's business plan concluded that there were no reasons for jeopardising the economic and financial viability of the project or any other which, under legal terms, could justify the refusal of the application. Thus, the Board of Directors of Banco de Portugal decided, on November 27, 2013, to authorize the constitution of Banco Postal, S.A.. This decision was notified to interested parties on 28 November 2013 and published on the official website of Banco de Portugal, thus concluding the first phase of the process of setting up Banco Postal. On the authorisation process, and to finish this brief introduction, I would like to highlight three aspects. First, the law does not provide grounds for granting authorisation; grounds for refusing authorisation. The legitimate grounds for refusal of authorisation, although substantial, are only those provided for by law, forming a numerus clausus. This shows the law's care to limit the discretion of the decision to establish credit institutions, as is normal when we are in a constitutional environment that protects free economic initiative. And this without prejudice to the powers that are legally assigned to Banco de Portugal to verify the legal and operational requirements for the beginning of the activity and for assessing the suitability of the members of the governing bodies. Subjective considerations, particularly related to opportunity criteria, are excluded from the analysis. In this regard, it should be recalled that European legislation expressly prevents Member States from making the application for authorisation subject to an assessment on the basis of the economic needs of the market. The situations of refusal of authorisation, I repeat, are typified in the General Regime of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations and do not depend on the circumstances of the market. Refusal of authorisation to establish a credit institution on the basis of any grounds not typified by law is legally permissible. Secondly, the authorization for the constitution of Banco Postal, S.A. was granted based on the current direct and indirect qualified participants but is subject to certain conditions, related to the later stages of the establishment of a credit institution. One of these conditions is the demonstration, in the initial registration with Banco de Portugal and prior to the beginning of the activity, that the qualified participants resulting from the privatization process of the CTT meet the conditions that guarantee a sound and prudent management of the institution. It will also comply with Banco de Portugal to assess, at a later time, the suitability of the members of the corporate bodies, through the application of the criteria provided for in the General Regime of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations. These criteria apply to natural persons and not to legal persons. Thirdly, Banco de Portugal had a period of 6 months to take a decision from the date of the application for authorisation. The decision to set up Banco Postal was taken, within the legally foreseen period and when all the conditions were met, without interference from the timetable and the privatization plan of the CTT that took place in parallel. The fact that the decision on banco postal authorisation was granted during the privatisation process, if any consequence had in this process, was to allow all investors potentially interested in privatisation to be put on an equal footing. The market was informed in a timely manner of the ctt's formal request to Banco de Portugal for the authorization of a postal bank. This information was included in the prospectof public offering for the sale of ctt and a decision of Banco de Portugal was expected within the legally provided deadlines. The resolution of the Board of Directors on the authorization to set up Banco Postal was subsequently accessible to all potential investors through the publication of the addition to the prospectus of a public offering. In addition, the decision to authorise the establishment of Banco Postal resulted from an objective analysis of the economic and financial viability of the project, in strict compliance with the applicable national and European legal framework. Lisbon, 14 February 2014
text_original: Interveno inicial do Governador C... Interveno inicial do Governador Carlos da Silva Costa na Comisso de Oramento, Finanas e Administrao Pblica sobre a autorizao concedida para a criao do Banco Postal no quadro da privatizao dos CTT 14 fev. 2014 A presente audio tem por objeto a autorizao concedida pelo Banco de Portugal para a criao do Banco Postal no quadro da privatizao dos CTT. Como  do conhecimento dos Senhores Deputados, a prestao de informaes sobre casos concretos encontra-se limitada pelas obrigaes legais de sigilo a que est sujeito o Banco de Portugal. Os esclarecimentos que prestarei prendem-se, assim, no essencial, com a tramitao e os critrios subjacentes a qualquer processo de constituio de uma instituio de crdito, nos termos da legislao nacional e europeia aplicvel. O processo de constituio de uma instituio de crdito , conforme previsto no Regime Geral das Instituies de Crdito e Sociedades Financeiras (RGICSF), constitudo por trs fases: (i) A primeira fase consiste na autorizao para a constituio da instituio de crdito; (ii) Numa segunda fase,  requerida autorizao para o incio da atividade, concretizada atravs do pedido de registo especial no Banco de Portugal. Para o efeito, e na sequncia do pedido da instituio, o Banco de Portugal verifica in loco se se encontram preenchidos os requisitos legais e operacionais mnimos necessrios ao desenvolvimento da atividade; (iii) A terceira fase decorre em paralelo com a segunda e consiste na avaliao da idoneidade dos membros dos rgos sociais. Portanto, o facto de o Banco de Portugal autorizar a constituio de uma instituio de crdito no implica necessariamente que a instituio venha de facto a iniciar a sua atividade. Sem o registo especial no Banco de Portugal, a autorizao de constituio caduca se a instituio no iniciar a sua atividade no prazo de 12 meses, prazo prorrogvel por mais 12 meses a pedido dos interessados. O processo de constituio do Banco Postal, S.A. teve incio no dia 5 de agosto de 2013, com a apresentao de um pedido dos CTT ao Banco de Portugal. Os servios do Banco de Portugal analisaram, ento, os elementos que instruram o pedido inicial, para verificar se estavam preenchidas as condies elencadas no artigo 14 do Regime Geral, a saber:  Regularidade formal;  Capital social mnimo;  Sede principal e efetiva da administrao em Portugal;  Dispositivos slidos em matria de governo da sociedade;  Processos eficazes de identificao, gesto, controlo e comunicao dos riscos;  Mecanismos adequados de controlo interno;  Polticas e prticas de remunerao coerentes com uma gesto s e prudente. Alm do eventual incumprimento de alguma destas condies, o Banco de Portugal s pode recusar a autorizao com base nos motivos suplementares previstos no artigo 20. do Regime Geral:  Falta de condies dos acionistas para garantir uma gesto s e prudente;  Insuficincia de meios tcnicos e financeiros;  Inviabilidade de uma superviso adequada. Esta  uma anlise baseada em critrios objetivos, no estrito cumprimento dos princpios gerais de legalidade, igualdade, imparcialidade, colaborao com os particulares e boa-f, estabelecidos no Cdigo do Procedimento Administrativo. A avaliao do plano de negcios da futura instituio concluiu que no existiam razes suscetveis de colocar em causa a viabilidade econmico-financeira do projeto ou quaisquer outras que, nos termos legais, pudessem justificar a recusa do pedido. Desta forma, o Conselho de Administrao do Banco de Portugal deliberou, em 27 de novembro de 2013, autorizar a constituio do Banco Postal, S.A.. Esta deciso foi notificada aos interessados a 28 de novembro de 2013 e publicada no stio oficial do Banco de Portugal, concluindo-se, portanto, a primeira fase do processo de constituio do Banco Postal. Sobre o processo de autorizao, e para terminar esta breve introduo, gostaria de sublinhar trs aspetos. Em primeiro lugar, a lei no prev fundamentos para conceder a autorizao; prev, sim fundamentos para recusar a autorizao. Os motivos legtimos de recusa da autorizao, embora substanciais, so apenas os previstos na Lei, formando um numerus clausus. Isto mostra o cuidado da Lei em limitar a discricionariedade da deciso da autorizao de constituio de instituies de crdito, como alis  normal quando nos situamos num ambiente constitucional que tutela a livre iniciativa econmica. E isto sem prejuzo dos poderes que so legalmente atribudos ao Banco de Portugal para verificao dos requisitos legais e operacionais para incio da atividade e para apreciao da idoneidade dos membros dos rgos sociais. Consideraes de ndole subjetiva, designadamente relacionadas com critrios de oportunidade, encontram-se excludas da anlise. A este propsito convm recordar que a legislao europeia impede expressamente os Estados-Membros de sujeitarem o pedido de autorizao a uma apreciao em funo das necessidades econmicas do mercado. As situaes de recusa da autorizao, repito, encontram-se tipificadas no Regime Geral das Instituies de Crdito e Sociedades Financeiras e no dependem das circunstncias do mercado. No  legalmente admissvel a recusa de autorizao para constituio de uma instituio de crdito com base em qualquer fundamento no tipificado na lei. Em segundo lugar, a autorizao para a constituio do Banco Postal, S.A. foi concedida tendo por referncia os atuais participantes qualificados diretos e indiretos mas encontra-se sujeita a determinadas condies, relacionadas com as fases posteriores da constituio de uma instituio de crdito. Uma dessas condies  a demonstrao, em sede de registo inicial junto do Banco de Portugal e previamente ao incio da atividade, de que os participantes qualificados resultantes do processo de privatizao dos CTT renem as condies que garantam uma gesto s e prudente da instituio. Cumprir igualmente ao Banco de Portugal avaliar, em momento posterior, a idoneidade dos membros dos rgos sociais, atravs da aplicao dos critrios previstos no Regime Geral das Instituies de Crdito e Sociedades Financeiras. Estes critrios aplicam-se a pessoas singulares e no a pessoas coletivas. Em terceiro lugar, o Banco de Portugal tinha um prazo de 6 meses para tomar uma deciso, a contar da data do pedido de autorizao. A deciso de constituio do Banco Postal foi tomada, dentro do prazo legalmente previsto e quando se encontraram reunidas todas as condies para tal, sem interferncia do calendrio e do plano de privatizao dos CTT que decorria em paralelo. O facto de a deciso sobre a autorizao do Banco Postal ter sido concedida durante o processo de privatizao, se alguma consequncia teve neste processo, foi a de permitir colocar em p de igualdade todos os investidores potencialmente interessados na privatizao. O mercado foi atempadamente informado do pedido formal dos CTT, junto do Banco de Portugal, para autorizao de um banco postal. Esta informao constava do prospeto de oferta pblica de venda dos CTT e era expectvel uma deciso do Banco de Portugal dentro dos prazos legalmente previstos. A deliberao do Conselho de Administrao relativa  autorizao para constituio do Banco Postal ficou posteriormente acessvel a todos os potenciais investidores atravs de publicao da adenda ao prospeto de oferta pblica de venda. Em suma, a deciso de autorizao de constituio do Banco Postal resultou de uma anlise objetiva da viabilidade econmico-financeira do projeto, em estrita observncia do quadro legal nacional e europeu aplicvel. Lisboa, 14 de fevereiro de 2014

Title: Opening speech by Governor Carlos da Silva Costa at the Seminar to present the new 10 banknote - Europa Series
text: Intervention of opening of the Government... Opening speech by Governor Carlos da Silva Costa at the Seminar to present the new 10 -Europa Series Feb. 26. 2014 Very good afternoon, everyone. I thank you for your presence at this seminar organized by Banco de Portugal. With this initiative, Banco de Portugal intends to make known the new 10 banknote and, at the same time, start preparing its entry into circulation. The new ten euro banknote goes into circulation on 23 September 2014 in Portugal and other euro area countries. This is the second note in the Europa series to be issued, after the five euro banknote, which was introduced in May 2013. The new 10 euro banknote is similar to that of the first series, but is even safer, tougher and longer lasting, thanks to the progress made in the meantime in banknote production technology. The transition will be simple. The Portuguese will not have to exchange any notes and may continue to use the current ten euro banknote to make payments. In other words, the two banknotes will circulate at the same time, as is already the case with the five euro banknotes of the first and second series. The date on which the first grade grades will no longer be legal course is not yet known, but will be announced well in advance. In any case, the first grade banknotes will never lose their value and may be exchanged, for an unlimited period of time, at Banco de Portugal and the other national central banks of the Eurosystem. The entry into circulation of a new note involves multiple actors and requires a significant effort of cooperation between all. To this end, Banco de Portugal will conduct a wide range of information, communication and technical support initiatives for professionals and the general public. This seminar is the first of these initiatives. I would like to point out the significance of this event, not only because of the importance of simultaneously launching a new banknote throughout the euro area, but also because of the opportunity it has offered us to understand the evolution of the single currency since it was launched in 2002. Euro banknotes and coins began circulating in 12 countries. With latvia's adoption of the euro in January this year, 18 Member States of the European Union use the euro as a currency and take full advantage of it. The euro, in addition to being the currency of 333 million inhabitants in Europe, is also widely used on a global scale, assuming, despite its youth, an importance only comparable to that of the dollar. There are currently more than 15 billion euro banknotes in circulation, representing an overall value of around EUR 900 billion. The euro has been valued far beyond European borders and euro banknotes are recognised as a safe and reliable means of payment and an asset used as a reserve of value. The euro is arguably the strongest tangible symbol of the construction of the European Union. It symbolizes the union of millions of Europeans around a common project that aims to create the conditions for lasting peace and sustained economic development in Europe. The addition of new Member States to the single currency and the launch of a new series of euro banknotes -the Europe series - objectively mean that the process of building economic and monetary union, despite the doubts and hesitations that have arisen in the context of the sovereign debt crisis, continues with strong commitment and confidence. The Eurosystem has been working to increase the credibility of the euro and confidence in the use of the single currency. And it is from this work that results in the new series of euro banknotes, called "Europa" series due to the portrait of Europe, the mythological figure that gave rise to the name of the continent, which is found in the hologram and watermark of the banknotes. In the development of the first series of euro banknotes, one of the main concerns of the national central banks and the European Central Bank was to ensure a smooth transition of national currencies to the euro. To this end, it was decided at the time to include safety features with proven performance, previously used in national currencies. To incorporate new advances in banknote production technology, the Board of Governors decided in 2005, and as is common practice for central banks, to begin work on preparing to issue a second series of safer, tougher and longer-lasting euro banknotes. It should be noted that the levels of counterfeiting of banknotes in the euro area remain very low. In Portugal, about 11,000 banknotes were seized in 2013, less than in 2012 and representing only 1.7% of the total counterfeits seized in the euro area. We are therefore a country with a very secure fiduciary circulation, which is due not only to the performance of Banco de Portugal but also  and to a large extent  to the relevant role that the banking system, the entities operating in the areas of cash management and distribution and the police authorities have been playing. In this context, I cannot fail to signal the committed and responsible way in which all relevant operators, credit institutions and securities transport companies have fully and timely complied with the obligations arising from the implementation of the common framework for recirculation. On the technical characteristics of the new banknotes and on other technical aspects, which are also important, associated in particular with the production process and the strengthening of the durability and resistance of counterfeit banknotes, will have the opportunity to hear in this seminar an expert from the European Central Bank and technicians from the Department of Issuance and Treasury of Banco de Portugal. I thank you both for your willingness to participate in this initiative. At the end of my speech, I would like to highlight some important messages. The ten euro banknote from serious Europe will enter circulation on 23 September, but citizens will not have to exchange any banknotes. The current 10 euro banknote will continue to circulate and may continue to be used as a means of payment. I hope that this seminar will meet your expectations, that it will be truly useful in supporting the preparation for the launch of the new 10 banknote and that it will be the first of many joint initiatives aimed at successfully introducing the Europe series in the countries that have adopted the euro. I therefore call for cooperation and commitment of all in the process, making available Banco de Portugal, through its Department of Issuance and Treasury, to give all the support that is required of us, at the most diverse levels. It is now time to present the new 10 banknote and give the floor to the experts. Thank you very much. Lisbon, 26 February 2014 for what,

Interveno de abertura do Governador Carlos da Silva Costa no Seminrio de apresentao da nova nota de 10  -Srie Europa 26 fev. 2014 Muito boa tarde a todos. Agradeo a vossa presena neste seminrio organizado pelo Banco de Portugal. Esta  a segunda nota da srie Europa a ser emitida, depois da nota de cinco euros, que foi introduzida em maio de 2013. A nova nota de dez euros  semelhante  da primeira srie, mas  ainda mais segura, mais resistente e mais duradoura, graas aos progressos entretanto alcanados na tecnologia de produo de notas. O euro , indiscutivelmente, o smbolo tangvel mais forte da construo da Unio Europeia. Simboliza a unio de milhes de europeus em torno de um projeto comum que pretende criar, na Europa, condies para uma paz duradoura e para um desenvolvimento econmico sustentado. A adeso de novos Estados-Membros  moeda nica e o lanamento de uma nova srie de notas de euro -a srie Europa -significam, objetivamente, que o processo de construo da Unio Econmica e Monetria, no obstante as dvidas e hesitaes que surgiram no contexto da crise das dvidas soberanas, prossegue com reforado empenho e confiana. O Eurosistema tem trabalhado para aumentar a credibilidade do euro e a confiana na utilizao da moeda nica. E  desse trabalho que resulta a nova srie de notas de euro, designada srie Europa devido ao retrato de Europa, a figura mitolgica que deu origem ao nome do continente, que se encontra no holograma e na marca de gua das notas. No desenvolvimento da primeira srie de notas de euro, uma das principais preocupaes dos bancos centrais nacionais e do Banco Central Europeu foi acautelar uma transio tranquila das moedas nacionais para o euro. Para o efeito, optou-se, na altura, por incluir elementos de segurana com desempenho comprovado, anteriormente utilizados nas moedas nacionais. Para incorporar os novos avanos na tecnologia de produo de notas, o Conselho de Governadores decidiu em 2005, e como  prtica habitual dos bancos centrais, iniciar os trabalhos de preparao para emitir uma segunda srie de notas de euro, mais seguras, mais resistentes e mais duradouras. Em Portugal, foram apreendidas em 2013 cerca de 11 mil notas, menos do que em 2012 e representando apenas 1.7% do total de contrafaes apreendidas na rea do euro. Somos, portanto, um pas com uma circulao fiduciria muito segura, o que se deve no s ao desempenho do Banco de Portugal mas tambm  e em grande medida  ao relevante papel que o sistema bancrio, as entidades que operam nas reas da gesto e distribuio de numerrio e as autoridades policiais tm vindo a desempenhar. Neste mbito, no posso deixar de sinalizar a forma empenhada e responsvel como todos os operadores relevantes, instituies de crdito e empresas de transporte de valores, deram pleno e atempado cumprimento s obrigaes decorrentes da implementao do quadro comum para a recirculao. Sobre as caractersticas tcnicas das novas notas e sobre outros aspetos tcnicos, igualmente importantes, associados designadamente ao processo de produo e de reforo da durabilidade e resistncia das notas  contrafao, tero oportunidade de ouvir neste seminrio um especialista do Banco Central Europeu e tcnicos do Departamento de Emisso e Tesouraria do Banco de Portugal. Agradeo a ambos a disponibilidade para participar nesta iniciativa. A terminar a minha interveno, quero sublinhar algumas mensagens importantes. Espero que este seminrio venha a corresponder s vossas expetativas, que seja verdadeiramente til para apoiar a preparao do lanamento da nova nota de 10 e que seja a primeira de muitas iniciativas conjuntas destinadas a introduzir com sucesso, a srie Europa nos pases que adotaram o euro. Title: Initial intervention of Governor Carlos da Silva Costa at the Parliamentary Hearing on prescription of cases
text: Initial Intervention of Governor C... Initial intervention of Governor Carlos da Silva Costa at the Parliamentary Hearing on prescription of cases 09 Apr 2014 April 9, 2014 Gentlemen The theme of the prescription of cases of contraortion has recently acquired a media and political interest which is justified by its importance for the credibility of the sanctioning process and the prevention functions associated with it. This hearing is therefore an opportunity for debate and reflection on the causes of prescription and on measures, in particular legislative measures, which can be taken to mitigate it substantially. Under the current framework, the maximum limitation period in of-ordination proceedings is eight years, counted from the practice of the facts, and not from the knowledge of the facts by the supervisor. In this initial intervention, I will make some considerations about the different stages of the oforor proceedings: The administrative stage, in which the supervisor carries out the investigation, prosecution and conviction when unlawful practices are found; and The judicial phase, which takes place in the Courts, when the decisions of Banco de Portugal are challenged. In particular, I will try to highlight the complexity of the investigation of financial fraud, point out the main weaknesses of the current sanctioning framework and identify a number of legislative changes - which, moreover, Banco de Portugal has already proposed - which could, without prejudice to the essential guarantees of defense, increase the effectiveness and credibility of the sanctioning process. The complexity of financial fraud investigation The investigation of financial fraud is complex and time-consuming. The acts investigated are typically the subject of sophisticated concealment and camouflage operations, both inside and outside borders. The reconstitution of the facts requires thorough research and analysis, establish strong causatial relationships between a multiplicity of operations and their authors. Not inoften, the proof of a fact, or set of facts, implies investigating others that arise as related. In addition, many of the information vital to the success of investigations comes from financial squares and foreign authorities, proving to be difficult and time-consuming. The investigation process usually begins with preliminary investigations. If evidence of infringement is confirmed, the opening of a formal infringement procedure follows, in which new evidence is collected in a more extensive and profound manner to confirm and document the infringement, identify its perpetrators and make an accusation. Unlike the criminal investigation, the administrative procedure does not end with the prosecution. After the indictment, the law requires that a second phase be open in the administrative proceedings, a phase of defense and contradictory with the defendants. To some extent, this second stage amounts to a genuine trial, and the defendants have the right to lodge their defence, to offer the means of proof they see and to request further instructional steps. From the indictment, the acts of the supervisor take place with the presence and intervention of the defendants' lawyers. The inquiry of defense witnesses is done in a similar way to those of a court, with full guarantees, analogous to those of a trial. All this requires that the investigation phase of the proceedings has to be surrounded by special care, under penalty of the final decision of the regulator being vulnerable to the prosecution of nullities by the interested parties. The supervisor is therefore faced with a dilemma: either he defers the required evidence, which inevitably drags on decision times, or he refuses those requirements and introduces in successive proceedings factors of risk of subsequent invalidity of the decision. The weaknesses of the current sanctioning framework The current framework of Banco de Portugal's sanctioning action results from a complex web of interactions between the General Regime of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations (RGICSF), the General Regime of Contraordination (RGCO) and the Code of Criminal Procedure (CPP). This normative framework presents a set of weaknesses, which become particularly visible in more complex misordering processes. Indeed, in cases where the investigation of the facts is more demanding and where the number of defendants is greater, the multiplication of procedural requirements, diligence stakes in an important part of the time being consumed in the discussion of such incidents - usually around purely formal matters - and not in the clearance and judgment of the substance of the facts. Moreover, in the event of a judicial challenge against the decision given by the supervisor, the evidence gathered in the administrative proceedings must be fully submitted to court, and again assessed. This full repetition of the test constitutes a debatable duplication. In fact, in order to guarantee the defendants, it would be sufficient to review the evidence disputed, or those which the Court itself considered necessary to reproduce in its presence. Regulatory changes that could increase the effectiveness of the process It is ultimately up to the policy-makers to promote the necessary legislative changes in order to avoid misuse of the process and to minimise the risks associated with it, including limitation. The legislator is therefore faced with the need to define an appropriate and realistic framework for more complex misdemeanor proceedings, taking into account three key aspects: The need to streamline the process without breaking the essential core of defence of the accused; the equally vital need for safety in obtaining evidence; The creation of disincentives to the conduct of the intervening parties notoriously dilatory. In this sense, Banco de Portugal has been presenting a set of proposals with the aim of mitigating the risks of dragging and subsequent prescription of the processes. Let me highlight some of the latest proposals we have put forward in the framework of the ongoing RGICSF review process: Extension to 2 and a half years of the period of suspension of the counting of the prescription in the event of a judicial challenge against the decision of Banco de Portugal, a period this which is currently six months. An extension to 2 1/2 years would lead, in practice, to which the maximum limitation period for the contraortorism proceedings from the current 8 to 10 years. This solution would also make it possible to harmonise the national limitation period with the (maximum) period of 10 years provided for the limitation of infringements of the same nature, for which the sanctioning procedure will be competent ecb under the Single Supervisory Mechanism. Limitation of the number of witnesses, taking into account the time of production of the and the risks of prescription. Explicitness of the principle that, in the event of a challenge to the decision given by the Banco de Portugal, the court may decide not only on the basis of the evidence hearing, but also on the basis of the evidence produced at the administrative stage of the of the ordination proceedings. These amendments, and others that have been proposed if they are to be accepted, will make the processes a faster as a whole, especially the so-called mega-processes. They will thus contribute to mitigating the risks of prescribing infringements. I believe, however, that only with a profound change in the prescription regime in counter-national proceedings inspired by the current model of the Penal Code can these risks be substantially reduced. In this model, the guarantees of defense of the accused reflected in the limitation regime are particularly intense until the first damning court decision. From this, procedural incidents and dilatory expedients can hardly lead to prescription. These possible legislative changes could include the definition of a limitation regime which acts on the basis of the various procedural stages and which expresses an appropriate balance between defence guarantees and the interest of procedural speed and the performance of justice. Final notes Let me conclude with two final notes. Recent prescriptions undermine citizens' confidence in public institutions and the justice system and have been a cause for public concern, which Banco de Portugal shares. Banco de Portugal is also particularly concerned about the effects of the requirements on supervision. In fact, Banco de Portugal's sanctioning power is an indispensable complementary tool to ensure the effectiveness and credibility of supervision. The amendments we advocate for the limitation regime depend on a balance between the following values: the guarantees of defence of the accused, on the one hand, and the speed and procedural effectiveness, on the other. This balance must be sought by the legislator. For our part, we are prepared to cooperate in this debate and we are streging for the full exercise of citizens' rights in counter-national proceedings, but without the exercise of those rights being abused to force the prescription. I am naturally available to answer all the questions that you want to ask in the context of the theme provided for this hearing. Lisbon, 9 April 2014
text_original: Interveno Inicial do Governador C... Interveno Inicial do Governador Carlos da Silva Costa na Audio Parlamentar sobre prescrio de processos 09 abr. 2014 9 de abril de 2014 Senhores Deputados, O tema da prescrio de processos de contraordenao adquiriu recentemente um interesse meditico e poltico que se justifica pela sua importncia para a credibilidade do processo sancionatrio e das funes de preveno que lhe esto associadas. Esta audio constitui, assim, uma oportunidade de debate e de reflexo sobre as causas da prescrio e sobre medidas, designadamente legislativas, que podem ser tomadas para a mitigar substancialmente. No atual enquadramento, o prazo mximo de prescrio em processos de contraordenao  de oito anos, contados a partir da prtica dos factos, e no do conhecimento destes pelo supervisor. Nesta interveno inicial, tecerei algumas consideraes sobre as diferentes fases dos processos de contraordenao: A fase administrativa, em que o supervisor procede  investigao, acusao e condenao quando so detetadas prticas ilcitas; e A fase judicial, que decorre nos Tribunais, quando as decises do Banco de Portugal so impugnadas. Procurarei, em particular, destacar a complexidade da investigao de fraudes financeiras, apontar as principais fragilidades do atual quadro sancionatrio e identificar um conjunto de alteraes legislativas -que, alis, o Banco de Portugal j props  suscetveis de, sem prejuzo das garantias essenciais de defesa, aumentar a eficcia e credibilidade do processo sancionatrio. A complexidade da investigao de fraudes financeiras A investigao de fraudes financeiras  complexa e morosa. Os atos investigados so tipicamente objeto de operaes sofisticadas de dissimulao e camuflagem, dentro e fora de fronteiras. A reconstituio dos factos obriga a uma pesquisa e anlise exaustivas, que permitam estabelecer relaes causais slidas entre uma multiplicidade de operaes e os seus autores. No raramente, a comprovao de um facto, ou conjunto de factos, implica investigar outros que surgem como conexos. Acresce que muitas das informaes vitais para o sucesso das investigaes so provenientes de praas financeiras e autoridades estrangeiras, revelando-se de obteno difcil e demorada. O processo de investigao inicia-se normalmente com averiguaes preliminares. Caso se confirmem os indcios de infrao, segue-se a abertura de um processo formal de contraordenao, no mbito do qual so recolhidos, de forma mais extensa e profunda, novos elementos que permitam confirmar e documentar a infrao, identificar os seus autores e formular uma acusao. Ao contrrio do que sucede com o inqurito penal, o processo administrativo no termina com a acusao. Aps a acusao, a lei determina que se abra uma segunda fase no processo administrativo, uma fase de defesa e de contraditrio com os arguidos. Em certa medida, esta segunda fase equivale a um verdadeiro julgamento, tendo os arguidos o direito de apresentar a sua contestao, de oferecer os meios de prova que entendam e de requerer diligncias instrutrias complementares. A partir da acusao, os atos do supervisor decorrem com a presena e interveno dos advogados dos arguidos. A inquirio das testemunhas de defesa  feita em moldes semelhantes aos de um tribunal, com plenas garantias, anlogas s de um julgamento. Tudo isto exige que a fase de instruo dos processos tenha de ser rodeada de especiais cuidados, sob pena da deciso final do regulador ficar vulnervel  arguio de nulidades por parte dos interessados. O supervisor encontra-se, portanto, perante um dilema: ou defere as diligncias de prova requeridas, o que inevitavelmente arrasta os tempos de deciso, ou indefere esses requerimentos e introduz nos processos sucessivos fatores de risco de posterior invalidade da deciso. As fragilidades do quadro sancionatrio atual O atual enquadramento da atuao sancionatria do Banco de Portugal resulta de uma complexa teia de interaes entre o Regime Geral das Instituies de Crdito e Sociedades Financeiras (RGICSF), o Regime Geral das Contraordenao (RGCO) e o Cdigo de Processo Penal (CPP). Este quadro normativo apresenta um conjunto de fragilidades, que se tornam particularmente visveis nos processos de contraordenao de maior complexidade. Efetivamente, nos processos em que a investigao dos factos  mais exigente e em que  maior o nmero de arguidos, a multiplicao de requerimentos, diligncias e incidentes processuais leva a que uma parte importante do tempo seja consumida na discusso desses incidentes -normalmente em torno de questes puramente formais -e no no apuramento e julgamento da substncia dos factos. Acresce que, em caso de impugnao judicial da deciso proferida pelo supervisor, as provas reunidas no processo administrativo tm de ser integralmente reapresentadas em tribunal, e neste novamente apreciadas. Esta repetio integral da prova constitui uma duplicao discutvel. De facto, para garantia dos arguidos, bastaria a reapreciao das provas contestadas, ou daquelas que o prprio Tribunal considerasse necessrio reproduzir na sua presena. Alteraes regulamentares suscetveis de aumentar a eficcia do processo Cabe, em ltima instncia, ao decisor poltico promover as alteraes legislativas necessrias por forma a evitar a utilizao abusiva do processo e a minimizar os riscos que lhe esto associados, entre os quais o de prescrio. O legislador encontra-se, assim, perante a necessidade de definir um quadro adequado e realista para os processos de contraordenao de maior complexidade, que tenha em conta trs aspetos fundamentais: A necessidade de agilizar o processo sem quebra do ncleo essencial de garantias de defesa dos arguidos; A necessidade, igualmente vital, de segurana na obteno de elementos probatrios; A criao de desincentivos a condutas das partes intervenientes que revistam carter notoriamente dilatrio. Neste sentido, o Banco de Portugal tem vindo a apresentar um conjunto de propostas com o objetivo de mitigar os riscos de arrastamento e posterior prescrio dos processos. Permitam-me que destaque algumas das mais recentes propostas que apresentmos no mbito do processo de reviso do RGICSF que est em curso: Alargamento para 2 anos e meio do perodo de suspenso da contagem do tempo de prescrio em caso de impugnao judicial da deciso do Banco de Portugal, perodo este que  atualmente de seis meses. Um alargamento para 2 anos e meio conduziria, na prtica, a que o prazo mximo de prescrio dos processos de contraordenao passasse dos atuais 8 para 10 anos. Esta soluo permitiria ainda harmonizar o prazo de prescrio nacional com o prazo (mximo) de 10 anos previsto para a prescrio de infraes da mesma natureza, para cujo procedimento sancionatrio passar a ser competente o BCE, no mbito do Mecanismo nico de Superviso. Limitao do nmero de testemunhas, tendo em conta o tempo de produo da prova e os riscos de prescrio. Explicitao do princpio de que, em caso de impugnao da deciso proferida pelo Banco de Portugal, o tribunal poder decidir no apenas com base na prova realizada na audincia, mas tambm com base na prova produzida na fase administrativa do processo de contraordenao. Estas alteraes, e outras que foram propostas, caso venham a ser acolhidas, permitiro, no seu conjunto, tornar os processos mais cleres, em especial os chamados megaprocessos. Contribuiro, assim, para mitigar os riscos de prescrio das infraes. Considero, no entanto, que s com uma alterao profunda do regime de prescrio nos processos contraordenacionais inspirada no atual modelo do Cdigo Penal podem esses riscos ser substancialmente reduzidos. Nesse modelo, as garantias de defesa dos arguidos refletidas no regime da prescrio so particularmente intensas at  primeira deciso judicial condenatria. A partir desta, os incidentes processuais e os expedientes dilatrios dificilmente podero conduzir  prescrio. Estas possveis alteraes legislativas poderiam passar pela definio de um regime de prescrio que opere em funo das diversas fases processuais e que expresse um adequado equilbrio entre as garantias de defesa e o interesse da celeridade processual e da realizao da justia. Notas finais Permitam-me que conclua com duas notas finais. As prescries recentes minam a confiana dos cidados nas instituies pblicas e no sistema de justia e tm sido motivo de preocupao pblica, que o Banco de Portugal partilha. O Banco de Portugal est ainda especialmente preocupado com os efeitos das prescries sobre a superviso. De facto, o poder sancionatrio do Banco de Portugal  um instrumento complementar indispensvel para garantir a eficcia e a credibilidade da superviso. As alteraes que preconizamos para o regime da prescrio dependem de um equilbrio entre os seguintes valores: as garantias de defesa dos arguidos, por um lado, e a celeridade e eficcia processual, por outro. Este equilbrio deve ser procurado pelo legislador. Pelo nosso lado, estamos dispostos a colaborar neste debate e pugnamos pelo pleno exerccio dos direitos dos cidados no quadro dos processos contraordenacionais, mas sem que o exerccio desses direitos possa ser abusado para forar a prescrio. Estou naturalmente disponvel para responder a todas as questes que os Senhores Deputados entendam colocar no mbito do tema previsto para esta audio. Lisboa, 9 de abril de 2014

Title: Initial intervention of Governor Carlos da Silva Costa at the Hearing of the Governor of Banco de Portugal in the Committee on Budget, Finance and Public Administration
text: Initial Intervention of Governor C... Initial intervention of Governor Carlos da Silva Costa at the Hearing of the Governor of Banco de Portugal in the Committee on Budget, Finance and Public Administration 07 ago. 2014 August 7, 2014 Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, On July 18, I presented in detail to this Commission the supervisory work of Banco Espirito Santo that Banco de Portugal has developed over the last few years and the actions it has adopted. In addition, I mentioned that based on the information disclosed and the impacts quantified by the institution and the external auditor, BES had a sufficient capital cushion to accommodate possible negative impacts resulting from exposure to the non-financial arm of ges, without compromising compliance with the minimum capital ratios. At the time of the hearing, the information available on bes's exposure to GES was that contained in Banco Espirito Santo's communication to the market of July 10. According to this communication, BES's direct exposure to GES entities amounted to around EUR 1240 million. Finally, I tried to make the following three points clear during the hearing: First, that there were expressions of interest on the part of investors who, if the capital cushion if insufficient, should allow for a strengthening of capital by private individuals. I also pointed out that, ultimately, if this were not possible, available the public recapitalisation line set up under the Assistance Economic and Financial To Portugal. Second, that Banco de Portugal was available to support any liquidity needs if Banco Espirito Santo's situation deteriorated. Third, that the depositors were fully protected. The protection of depositors is enshrined in the Law and is the bank's top priority Portugal in any situation. As you know, the Board of Directors of Banco de Portugal decided on August 3 to apply to Banco Espirito Santo, S.A. a resolution measure. This measure consisted in the creation of the Novo Banco, to which the generality of the activity and assets of Banco Espirito Santo, S.A. was transferred. Novo Banco has a share capital of 4900 million euros, in full subscribed by the Resolution Fund. At today's hearing it seems important to me to start by answering three questions: 1. What has changed since my hearing in this Commission on 18 July and which 2. What is the resolution measure and what are the consequences for the main stakeholders? 3. What are the next steps? led to the application of the resolution measure to Banco Espirito Santo? 1. What has changed since my hearing in this Commission on 18 July On July 30, 2014, Banco Espirito Santo released the results for the first half of 2014, showing a loss that far exceeded the forecasts in light of the previous information. The loss amounted to EUR 3577 million. Almost all of this loss (EUR 3488 million) concerned the second quarter of 2014. The worsening of the results in relation to those that could be estimated two weeks earlier is the result of the practice of a set of management acts seriously detrimental to the interest of Banco Espirito Santo and in clear violation of the determinations issued by Banco de Portugal that prohibited increased exposure to other ges entities. These acts took place during the previous administration's term of office, but at a time when their replacement was already announced. In fact, in the second half of July, the external auditor identified the following operations: i. The issue of two comfort letters addressed to institutional investors residents, in violation of the internal approval procedures of this type of operations and determinations of Banco de Portugal. These comfort cards led recognition of a loss in Banco Espirito Santo's accounts in the amount of 267 million, with reference to 30 June 2014; ii. The carrying out of operations issuing and repurchasing own bonds, involving Banco Espirito Santo, The Espirito Santo Group and Eurofin Securities, which determined a record of losses in Banco Espirito Santo's accounts in the total amount eur 1249 million, with reference to 30 June 2014. These operations had a negative impact of around EUR 1500 million on the first half of the year profit and earnings account. In view of the losses, BES failed to meet the minimum capital ratios in force, with a Common Equity Tier 1 ratio of 5 per cent, below the 7 per cent minimum required by Banco de Portugal and the minimum of 8 per cent for institutions entering the comprehensive assessment exercise promoted by the ECB; As I told you on July 18, Banco de Portugal requested a forensic audit to assess the full compliance with all prudential determinations of ring-fencing issued in relation to ges' non-financial entities. In the framework of this audit, which is already underway, individual responsibilities will be assessed, including those of the former Chairman of the Executive Board, former administrator with the financial portfolio and other members of the Executive Board who have since resigned from the positions held. If the practice of illicit acts is confirmed, the necessary consequences in counterordenacional and criminal matters will be extracted. In addition to this audit, and in view of the new facts reported, Banco de Portugal determined on July 30 the following: The achievement of a capital increase by BES, entrusting its management to submit a capitalisation plan the implementation of which would allow the short strengthening of own funds to adequate levels of solvency; Inhibit the voting rights inherent in the qualified participation that Espirito Santo Financial Group, S.A. and Espirito Santo Financial (Portugal) -SGPS, S.A. held in BES; Suspend the members of the management bodies with the audit portfolios, compliance and risk management, as well as the holders of the supervisory body, for example, that these holders were entrusted with enhanced surveillance duties which could have ensured the timely prevention or detection of the situations in question; Appoint a supervisory committee composed of senior management of the PricewaterhouseCoopers&Associados, until the replacement of the members of the Audit by shareholders. However, the magnitude and nature of the losses had several very rapid and significant adverse consequences, which put BES in a situation of serious financial imbalance: i. On 1 August, the Governing Council of the European Central Bank ordered the suspension of banco Espirito Santo's access to monetary policy operations with the effect of from 4 August; ii. Public perception of the bank has deteriorated sharply, causing a very significant drop in the price of its shares and the suspension of transactions by CMVM on the afternoon of Friday, August 1; iii. Also on Friday, August 1, canadian rating agency DBRS cut rating assigned to BES and reported the possibility of further declines in the notation; iv. On July 31, Banco Espirito Santo, SA. communicated to Banco de Portugal the inability to promote a recapitalisation solution of the bank, in accordance with and within the time limits requested by Banco de Portugal. The facts I have just stated show that we were facing a serious and serious risk that Banco Espirito Santo would not comply in the short term with its obligations and, consequently, to not comply with the requirements for the maintenance of the authorization for the exercise of its activity. Given the relevance of Banco Espirito Santo in the banking system and in the financing of the Portuguese economy, the risk of inability to meet its obligations posed a serious threat to the stability of the national financial system. This situation has made it imperative and urgent to adopt a solution that at the same time: 1) ensures the protection of deposits; 2) ensure the stability of the financial system; 3) protect the public money and 4) ensure the continuity of the provision of financial services 2. Resolution measure applied to BES and consequences for the main parties Interested Once the private capitalisation solution was exhausted and, for reasons of financial stability, the possibility of liquidation of the institution, there were two alternatives: the public recapitalisation and the application of a resolution measure. Public recapitalisation, even in the form of mandatory capitalization, would not be feasible, given the urgent situation arising from the imminent risk of non-compliance with bes obligations, and would ensure neither the necessary segregation in relation to the Espirito Santo Group nor the protection of public resources in relation to the risks inherent to the banking activity. In this context, Banco de Portugal, in conjunction with the European authorities and taking into account the legal framework in force, decided that the best solution would be to apply a resolution measure to Banco Espirito Santo, SA., which, as I mentioned, went through the creation of a new bank, to which the essential of the activity developed by Banco Espirito Santo was transferred. Novo Banco was created, to which the generality of the assets and liabilities and other material resources of Banco Espirito Santo, SA. were transferred immediately and definitively. Employees of Banco Espirito Santo, SA. were also transferred to the Novo Banco. On the contrary, the problematic or discontinuing assets remained in Banco Espirito Santo. The assets were transferred at their book value, adjusted to ensure a conservative valuation. Novo Banco was adequately capitalized, and the Resolution Fund was the sole holder of its share capital. Novo Banco is an institution with full access to eurosystem liquidity facilities and benefits from the same financing conditions as other national credit institutions. The solution adopted by Banco de Portugal thus allows us to continue to ensure the activity developed so far by Banco Espirito Santo and to isolate Novo Banco, definitely, from the risks created by Banco Espirito Santo's exposure to entities of the Espirito Santo Group. These risks remain in the balance sheet of Banco Espirito Santo, SA. and the current shareholders of Banco Espirito Santo and its subordinated creditors will be responsible for them. The solution adopted by Banco de Portugal allowed to fully ensure deposits and non-subordinated obligations and preserve the jobs and commercial relations maintained so far by Banco Espirito Santo. The solution adopted by Banco de Portugal is also the one that best safeguards the interests of taxpayers and the public bank. The costs of the resolution measure are, first, borne by the shareholders and subordinated creditors of Banco Espirito Santo and, secondly, by the financial sector, through the Resolution Fund. 3. Next steps The scale and enormous complexity of the preparatory work of this measure required Banco de Portugal to concentrate exceptionally. During the weekend that passed, it was necessary to develop all the steps to ensure that on Monday, August 4, the Novo Banco was operational. It was also necessary to increase assets, estimate capital needs, prepare regulatory instruments, appoint the governing bodies of the new entities, prepare various communication documents and articulate the whole process with the European Commission, the European Central Bank and the Ministry of Finance. In the coming weeks, it will be necessary to ensure that no aspect of the operationalisation of the resolution measure is over-neglected. In terms of next steps, I would highlight two: i. An audit shall be carried out on the valuation of assets, liabilities and off-balance sheet transferred to Novo Banco. The audit will be carried out by the PricewaterhouseCoopers&Associados. ii. A solution for placing Novo Banco in shareholders will be developed Private. A financial advisor will be hired to, in liaison with the Of The New Bank, to present a transparent solution that maximize the bank's value. Novo Banco has a significant share in the financial market Portuguese, and being free of the risks that led to the losses recently announced by Banco Espirito Santo, is able to continue to assert itself and value itself in the market. Very muchthe fight.
text_original: Interveno Inicial do Governador C... Interveno Inicial do Governador Carlos da Silva Costa na Audio do Governador do Banco de Portugal na Comisso de Oramento, Finanas e Administrao Pblica 07 ago. 2014 7 de agosto de 2014 Senhor Presidente, Senhoras e Senhores Deputados, No passado dia 18 de julho apresentei detalhadamente a esta Comisso o trabalho de superviso do Banco Esprito Santo que o Banco de Portugal desenvolveu ao longo dos ltimos anos e as aes que adotou. Adicionalmente, referi que com base na informao divulgada e nos impactos quantificados pela instituio e pelo auditor externo, o BES possua uma almofada de capital suficiente para acomodar possveis impactos negativos resultantes da exposio ao brao no financeiro do GES, sem comprometer o cumprimento dos rcios mnimos de capital.  data da audio, a informao disponvel sobre a exposio do BES ao GES era a que constava da comunicao do Banco Esprito Santo ao mercado, de 10 de julho. De acordo com essa comunicao, a exposio direta do BES a entidades do GES ascendia a cerca de 1240 milhes de euros. Por ltimo, procurei deixar claro no decurso da audio os seguintes trs pontos: Primeiro, que havia manifestaes de interesse por parte de investidores que, caso a almofada de capital se revelasse insuficiente, deveriam permitir um reforo de capital por privados. Salientei ainda que, em ltima instncia, se tal no fosse possvel, estaria disponvel a linha de recapitalizao pblica criada no mbito do Programa de Assistncia Econmica e Financeira a Portugal. Segundo, que o Banco de Portugal estava disponvel para suportar eventuais necessidades de liquidez caso a situao do Banco Esprito Santo se deteriorasse. Terceiro, que os depositantes estavam plenamente protegidos. A proteo dos depositantes est consagrada na Lei e constitui prioridade mxima do Banco de Portugal em qualquer situao. Como  do Vosso conhecimento, o Conselho de Administrao do Banco de Portugal deliberou no passado dia 3 de agosto aplicar ao Banco Esprito Santo, S.A. uma medida de resoluo. Esta medida consistiu na criao do Novo Banco, para o qual foi transferida a generalidade da atividade e do patrimnio do Banco Esprito Santo, S.A.. O Novo Banco tem um capital social de 4900 milhes euros, integramente subscrito pelo Fundo de Resoluo. Na audio de hoje parece-me importante comear por responder a trs questes: 1. O que se alterou desde a minha audio nesta Comisso no dia 18 de julho e que 2. Em que consiste a medida de resoluo e quais as consequncias para as principais partes interessadas? 3. Quais so os prximos passos? conduziu  aplicao da medida de resoluo ao Banco Esprito Santo? 1. O que se alterou desde a minha audio nesta Comisso no dia 18 de julho No dia 30 de julho de 2014, o Banco Esprito Santo, divulgou os resultados relativos ao 1 semestre de 2014, apresentando um prejuzo que ultrapassou largamente os valores previsveis  luz da informao anterior. O prejuzo ascendeu a 3577 milhes de euros. A quase totalidade deste prejuzo (3488 milhes de euros) dizia respeito ao 2. trimestre de 2014. O agravamento dos resultados em relao aos que poderiam ser estimados duas semanas antes  resultado da prtica de um conjunto de atos de gesto gravemente prejudiciais ao interesse do Banco Esprito Santo e em clara violao das determinaes emitidas pelo Banco de Portugal que proibiam o aumento da exposio a outras entidades do GES. Estes atos tiveram lugar durante o mandato da anterior administrao, mas num momento em que a sua substituio estava j anunciada. Efetivamente, na segunda metade de julho, foram identificadas pelo auditor externo as seguintes operaes: i. A emisso de duas cartas-conforto dirigidas a investidores institucionais no residentes, em violao dos procedimentos internos de aprovao deste tipo de operaes e das determinaes do Banco de Portugal. Estas cartas-conforto conduziram ao reconhecimento de uma perda nas contas do Banco Esprito Santo no valor de 267 milhes de euros, com referncia a 30 de junho de 2014; ii. A realizao de operaes de emisso e recompra de obrigaes prprias, envolvendo o Banco Esprito Santo, o Grupo Esprito Santo e a Eurofin Securities, que determinaram um registo de perdas nas contas do Banco Esprito Santo no valor total de 1249 milhes de euros, com referncia a 30 de junho de 2014. Estas operaes tiveram um impacto negativo de cerca de 1500 milhes de euros na conta de resultados do 1. semestre. Face s perdas apuradas, o BES deixou de cumprir os rcios mnimos de capital em vigor, verificando um rcio de Common Equity Tier 1 de 5 por cento, abaixo do mnimo de 7 por cento exigido pelo Banco de Portugal e do mnimo de 8 por cento para as instituies que entram no exerccio de avaliao abrangente promovido pelo BCE; Como vos transmiti no passado dia 18 de julho, o Banco de Portugal solicitou uma auditoria forense para avaliar o cumprimento total de todas as determinaes prudenciais de isolamento dos riscos (ring-fencing) emitidas relativamente s entidades no financeiras do GES. No mbito desta auditoria, que j est em curso, sero avaliadas responsabilidades individuais, incluindo as do anterior Presidente da Comisso Executiva, anterior administrador com o pelouro financeiro e outros membros da Comisso Executiva que entretanto renunciaram aos cargos exercidos. Caso se confirme a prtica de ilcitos, sero extradas as necessrias consequncias em matria contraordenacional e criminal. Para alm dessa auditoria, e em face dos novos factos reportados, o Banco de Portugal determinou no dia 30 de julho o seguinte: A realizao de um aumento de capital por parte do BES, incumbindo a sua administrao de apresentar um plano de capitalizao cuja execuo permitisse, a curto prazo, o reforo dos fundos prprios para nveis adequados de solvabilidade; Inibir os direitos de voto inerentes  participao qualificada que a Esprito Santo Financial Group, S.A. e a Esprito Santo Financial (Portugal) -SGPS, S.A. detinham no BES; Suspender os membros dos rgos de administrao com os pelouros de auditoria, compliance e gesto de riscos, bem como os titulares do rgo de fiscalizao, por considerar que a estes titulares incumbiam deveres reforados de vigilncia que poderiam ter garantido a preveno ou a deteo tempestiva das situaes em causa; Designar uma comisso de fiscalizao, composta por quadros superiores da PricewaterhouseCoopers&Associados, at  substituio dos membros da Comisso de Auditoria pelos acionistas. Contudo, a magnitude e a natureza das perdas tiveram vrias consequncias adversas, muito rpidas e significativas, que colocaram o BES numa situao de grave desequilbrio financeiro: i. No dia 1 de agosto, o Conselho do Banco Central Europeu determinou a suspenso do acesso do Banco Esprito Santo s operaes de poltica monetria com efeitos a partir de 4 de agosto; ii. A perceo pblica relativamente ao banco deteriorou-se acentuadamente, provocando uma queda muito significativa da cotao das suas aes e a suspenso das transaes pela CMVM na tarde de sexta-feira, 1 de agosto; iii. Tambm na sexta-feira, dia 1 de agosto, a agncia de rating canadiana DBRS cortou a notao de rating atribuda ao BES e comunicou a possibilidade de novas descidas da notao; iv. No dia 31 de julho, o Banco Esprito Santo, SA. comunicou ao Banco de Portugal a impossibilidade de promover uma soluo de recapitalizao do banco, nos termos e nos prazos solicitados pelo Banco de Portugal. Os factos que acabei de enunciar demonstram que estvamos perante um risco srio e grave de o Banco Esprito Santo incumprir a curto prazo com as suas obrigaes e, em consequncia, de incumprir os requisitos para a manuteno da autorizao para o exerccio da sua atividade. Tendo em conta a relevncia do Banco Esprito Santo no sistema bancrio e no financiamento da economia portuguesa, o risco de incapacidade para cumprir as suas obrigaes constitua uma sria ameaa para a estabilidade do sistema financeiro nacional. Esta situao tornou imperativo e urgente adotar uma soluo que simultaneamente: 1) garantisse a proteo dos depsitos; 2) assegurasse a estabilidade do sistema financeiro; 3) protegesse o errio pblico e 4) garantisse a continuidade da prestao dos servios financeiros 2. Medida de resoluo aplicada ao BES e consequncias para as principais partes interessadas Esgotada a soluo de capitalizao privada e afastada, por razes de estabilidade financeira, a hiptese de liquidao da instituio, restavam duas alternativas: a recapitalizao pblica e a aplicao de uma medida de resoluo. A recapitalizao pblica, mesmo na modalidade de capitalizao obrigatria, no seria vivel, dada a situao de urgncia decorrente do risco iminente de incumprimento das obrigaes do BES, e no asseguraria nem a necessria segregao em relao ao Grupo Esprito Santo, nem a proteo dos recursos pblicos relativamente aos riscos prprios da atividade bancria. Neste contexto, o Banco de Portugal, em articulao com as autoridades europeias e tendo em conta o quadro legal em vigor, decidiu que a melhor soluo seria a aplicao de uma medida de resoluo ao Banco Esprito Santo, SA., que, como j referi, passou pela criao de um banco novo, para o qual foi transferido o essencial da atividade at ento desenvolvida pelo Banco Esprito Santo. Foi criado o Novo Banco, para o qual foram transferidos, de imediato e de forma definitiva, a generalidade dos ativos e passivos e demais recursos materiais do Banco Esprito Santo, SA.. Os colaboradores do Banco Esprito Santo, SA. tambm foram transferidos para o Novo Banco. Pelo contrrio, os ativos problemticos ou a descontinuar permaneceram no Banco Esprito Santo. Os ativos foram transferidos pelo respetivo valor contabilstico, ajustado de forma a assegurar uma valorizao conservadora. O Novo Banco foi adequadamente capitalizado, sendo o Fundo de Resoluo o detentor nico do seu capital social. O Novo Banco  uma instituio com pleno acesso s facilidades de liquidez do Eurosistema e beneficia das mesmas condies de financiamento das restantes instituies de crdito nacionais. A soluo adotada pelo Banco de Portugal permite, assim, continuar a assegurar a atividade at aqui desenvolvida pelo Banco Esprito Santo e isolar o Novo Banco, definitivamente, dos riscos criados pela exposio do Banco Esprito Santo a entidades do Grupo Esprito Santo. Estes riscos permanecem no balano do Banco Esprito Santo, SA. e por eles respondero os atuais acionistas do Banco Esprito Santo e os seus credores subordinados. A soluo adotada pelo Banco de Portugal permitiu assegurar integralmente os depsitos e as obrigaes no subordinadas e preservar os postos de trabalho e as relaes comerciais at aqui mantidas pelo Banco Esprito Santo. A soluo adotada pelo Banco de Portugal  tambm a que melhor salvaguarda os interesses dos contribuintes e do errio pblico. Os custos da medida de resoluo so, em primeiro lugar, suportados pelos acionistas e pelos credores subordinados do Banco Esprito Santo e, em segundo lugar, pelo setor financeiro, atravs do Fundo de Resoluo. 3. Prximos passos A dimenso e a enorme complexidade dos trabalhos preparatrios desta medida exigiram ao Banco de Portugal uma concentrao excecional de esforo. Durante o fim de semana que passou, foi necessrio desenvolver todas as diligncias para garantir que na segunda-feira, 4 de agosto, o Novo Banco se encontrava operacional. Foi tambm necessrio proceder  valorizao dos ativos, estimar as necessidades de capital, preparar instrumentos regulamentares, nomear os rgos sociais das novas entidades, preparar diversos documentos de comunicao e articular todo o processo com a Comisso Europeia, o Banco Central Europeu e o Ministrio das Finanas. Nas prximas semanas, ser necessrio assegurar que nenhum aspeto da operacionalizao da medida de resoluo  descurado. Em termos de prximos passos, salientaria dois: i. Ser efetuada uma auditoria  valorizao dos ativos, passivos e elementos extrapatrimoniais transferidos para o Novo Banco. A auditoria ser realizada pela PricewaterhouseCoopers&Associados. ii. Ser desenvolvida uma soluo de colocao do Novo Banco em acionistas privados. Um assessor financeiro ser contratado para, em articulao com o Conselho de Administrao do Novo Banco, apresentar uma soluo transparente e que maximize o valor do Banco. O Novo Banco tem uma quota significativa no mercado financeiro portugus, e estando livre dos riscos que conduziram s perdas recentemente anunciadas pelo Banco Esprito Santo, tem condies para continuar a afirmar-se e a valorizar-se no mercado. Muito obrigado.

Title: Intervention of The Administrator Antnio Varela at the inauguration ceremony of the new directors of Banco de Portugal
text: Intervention of the Administrator Antoni... Intervention of The Administrator Antonio Varela at the inauguration ceremony of the new directors of Banco de Portugal 10 set. 2014 September 10, 2014 Ministers and Secretaries of State, Mr Governor, Vice-Governors and Administrators of Banco de Portugal, Ladies and Gentlemen, Both Dr. Helder Rosalino and Myself are well aware of the delicacy and challenges of the European economic, financial and banking moment and also Portuguese, so much more proud of the confidence that this appointment reveals, which we thank, and so much more we will commit to the service of the country, the institution for which we have been appointed, and the markets. I remember half a century ago my grandfather explained to me that banks were used to keep their savings safely and industrialists, as they were said, to borrow money to buy machines and supplies. Since then we have invented dematerialization, deintermediation, bancassurance, securitizations, CLO, structured credits, off-shores, derivatives, leasing and factoring, cards and financial engineering  and not happy about it, we have also invented THE OPA, international expansion, category killers, strategic holdings, and more, and more... risks, and more risks, and very complex systems for managing those risks. We forget perhaps that we are human, that we are merely human and fallible; we have lost sight of the view that all these innovations, which are desirable because they help generate value, cannot jeopardise the fundamentals and essential purposes of banking activity. Bankers, Just as we reset when our mobile phone blocks, I believe that we also have to apply ourselves to the reconfiguration of our institutions and their business model  we have to question the suitability of our corporate governance and the capabilities and motivations of the people who lead it, we must constantly assess the risks we have on the balance sheet (or outside it, especially outside it), if they are appropriate and what management we do with them, we have to create and verify internal rules and compliance, we must fully inform customers and counterparties. These have to be permanent tasks and today more than ever are an essential condition of financial activity. And above all, we must act according to irreprehensible ethical principles. We must make a demanding diagnosis of the capacities of each institution and, from it, put into practice with determination the necessary measures. Minister Banco de Portugal has the best set of technicians in the country  competent, healthy, motivated; has excellent working methodologies, abundant resources. How can we then contribute to improving the activity and results produced by Banco de Portugal? As a man in the financial market I have naturally been concerned about the practice of supervision by Banco de Portugal; of my reflection, now on the other hand, I will try to contribute to it being further reinforced in three important qualities: Dialogue; Humility; Rigor. Dialogue, that is, ability to establish and maintain quality communication with institutions, with the market and with other financial supervisors, to better know people, strategies, business, better adapt reporting mechanisms and better monitor risks, minimizing bureaucratic burdens. That in this dialogue we have the humility to know who develops the financial activity, without losing critical capacity and the necessary exemption in the analysis. And that we supervise and regulate the banking market with rigor and utmost prudence, in setting the targets, in the requirement of compliance, in the evaluation of behaviors and, when necessary, in the sanction. Certain that we can count on the support of the other members of the Board of Directors, all employees of the Bank and the committed cooperation of the banking system and other entities with which Banco de Portugal relates, we are committed to working with total commitment, loyalty and dedication in the service of the public interest. Thank you very much.
