De ento para c inventmos a desmaterializao, a desintermediao, a bancassurance, as securitizaes, os CLO, os crditos estruturados, as off-shores, os derivados, o leasing e o factoring, os cartes e a engenharia financeira  e no contentes com isto, ainda inventmos as OPA, a expanso internacional, os category killers, as participaes estratgicas, e mais, e mais riscos, e mais riscos, e complexssimos sistemas para gerir esses riscos. Esquecemo-nos qui de que somos humanos, que continuamos meramente a ser humanos e falveis; perdemos de vista que todas essas inovaes, que so desejveis porque ajudam a gerar valor, no podem pr em risco os fundamentos e os propsitos essenciais da atividade bancria. Senhores banqueiros, Tal como fazemos um  reset quando o nosso telemvel bloqueia, creio que tambm na banca temos de decisivamente aplicar-nos na reconfigurao das nossas instituies e do seu modelo de negcio  temos de questionar a adequao do nosso governo societrio e das capacidades e motivaes das pessoas que o protagonizam, temos permanentemente de avaliar os riscos que temos no balano (ou fora dele, especialmente fora dele), se so apropriados e qual  a gesto que deles fazemos, temos de criar e verificar as regras internas e o cumprimento, temos de informar cabalmente clientes e contrapartes. Estas tm de ser tarefas permanentes e hoje mais do que nunca so condio essencial da atividade financeira. E, acima de tudo, temos de atuar de acordo com princpios ticos irrepreensveis. Temos de fazer um diagnstico exigente das capacidades de cada instituio e, a partir dele, pr em prtica com determinao as medidas necessrias. Senhora Ministra, O Banco de Portugal dispe do melhor conjunto de tcnicos do Pas  competentes, ntegros, motivados; dispe de excelentes metodologias de trabalho, de recursos abundantes. Como podemos ento contribuir para melhorar a atividade e os resultados produzidos pelo Banco de Portugal? Como homem do mercado financeiro tenho-me naturalmente preocupado com a prtica da superviso pelo Banco de Portugal; da minha reflexo, agora do outro lado, tentarei contribuir para que aquela seja ainda mais reforada em trs importantes qualidades: Dilogo; Humildade; Rigor. Dilogo, isto , capacidade de estabelecer e manter comunicao de qualidade com as instituies, com o mercado e com os outros supervisores financeiros, para melhor conhecer as pessoas, as estratgias, os negcios, melhor adaptar os mecanismos de reporte e melhor acompanhar riscos, minimizando cargas burocrticas. Que nesse dilogo tenhamos a humildade para saber ouvir quem desenvolve a atividade financeira, sem perder capacidade crtica e a iseno necessria na anlise. E que supervisionemos e regulemos o mercado bancrio com rigor e mxima prudncia, na fixao das metas, na exigncia do seu cumprimento, na avaliao dos comportamentos e, quando necessrio, na sano. Certos de que podemos contar com o apoio dos restantes membros do Conselho de Administrao, de todos os colaboradores do Banco e com a cooperao empenhada do sistema bancrio e das demais entidades com quem o Banco de Portugal se relaciona, assumimos o compromisso de trabalhar com empenho, lealdade e dedicao totais ao servio do interesse pblico. Muito obrigado.

Title: Intervention of Banco de Portugal Administrator Joo Amaral Tomaz at the session on the new 10 banknote
text: Intervention of the Administrator of Ban... Intervention of Banco de Portugal Administrator Joao Amaral Tomaz at the session on the new 10 banknote 22 set. 2014 Lisbon, 22 September 2014 Tomorrow, September 23, the new 10 euro banknote enters circulation in Portugal and other euro area countries. The new 10 euro banknote belongs to the second series of euro banknotes, the Europa series. As you recall, the first banknote in the Europa series to enter circulation was the 5 banknote, launched in 2013. Visually, the new 10 euro banknote is very similar to the current one and, for this reason, it is easy to recognize it. The dominant color of the note remains red. The design has been slightly altered, but we continue to find the Romanesque portico of the 10 euro note of the first series, in addition to other familiar elements. Nevertheless, the new note incorporates even more sophisticated safety features that make it even safer and more resistant to contraption. This is the case of the portrait of the goddess Europa, which we can find in the hologram and watermark, and the emerald number, security elements that the public already knows, because they are also included in the 5 euro note that was released last year. In fact, the Europe series is the result of a compromise between continuity and innovation, two characteristics indispensable for strengthening confidence in the currency. It is important that the public knows the new note well and knows how to identify the main security elements. While counterfeit banknote levels in Portugal and the euro area remain very low, it is essential that the public and cash professionals know how to assess the authenticity of a banknote at the time they receive it. The reason is simple: a contramade note cannot be exchanged for a genuine note. Anyone who accepts a contrator is deemed to be an authentic note will not be able to recover the its value. In this regard, let me address a word of thanks to all the entities contributing to the security of fiduciary movement in Portugal. In the specific case of Portugal, the number of contracting seed represents less than 2% of the total contraptic sums seized in the euro area. This result is due not only to the performance of Banco de Portugal, but also to the relevant role that the banking system, entities operating in the areas of cash management and distribution and police authorities have been playing in this area. There are other very relevant messages that need to be transmitted to the public regarding the release of the new note. With the entry into circulation of the new 10 euro banknote, the Portuguese will not have to exchange any banknotes. The first series 10 euro banknote will remain in circulation and may continue to be used to make payments without restrictions. The new banknote and the note of the first series will circulate simultaneously, as is already the case for the 5 euro banknotes of the first and second series. The date on which the first grade grades will no longer be legal due has not yet been set, but I can assure you that it will be announced well in advance. In any case, it should be made clear: the first grade notes will never lose their value. There is no prescription after 20 years as it was for the shield. In other words, the euro banknotes of the first series, even after they have lost their legal status, may be exchanged, for an unlimited period of time, at Banco de Portugal and the other national central banks of the Eurosystem. As you can imagine, the entry into circulation of a new note involves multiple actors and requires a significant effort of articulation and cooperation between all. For the launch of the new 10 euro banknote, 4.5 billion banknotes were produced. The printing process alone, the responsibility of 15 national central banks, took about a year. Since the beginning of this year, Banco de Portugal has developed a wide range of information and training, communication and technical support initiatives for professionals and the general public to prepare for the launch of the new banknote. In particular, the European Central Bank and the national central banks of the euro area have joined forces to promote timely adaptation of all types of equipment operating with cash. Although the responsibility for adapting the equipment is ultimately the responsibility of its owners, the Eurosystem and, in particular, Banco de Portugal have taken all the measures that were within its power to achieve this adaptation quickly. However, we cannot guarantee that all equipment will be able to accept the new 10 euro banknote from tomorrow. I would also like to point out that, in addition to the communication and information initiatives that Banco de Portugal has promoted for professionals and the general public, we are aware that other institutions are also doing so. It is noteworthy the prestigious initiative of the police authorities (GNR and PSP), which have developed awareness campaigns among populations with less access to information and who, as such, are more exposed to possible attempts at fraud. I would remind you again in this regard that no one is required to exchange notes on behalf of Banco de Portugal or on behalf of credit institutions. As I said, it is not necessary to exchange the old euro banknotes for the new banknotes, because even after the introduction of the new 10 euro banknote, the old banknotes will remain in circulation for a long time. Confidence in the currency  in our currency, the euro  is an asset that we all have a duty to preserve. I therefore invite you to know the new note and, in particular, its security features, which can be checked by anyone, without the need to resort to any special equipment. Finally, I recall the words of the Governor, delivered on 26 February last, at the Seminar to present the new 10 euro banknote, intended mainly for equipment manufacturers and companies operating on a large scale with vending machines for goods and services. "The euro is arguably the strongest tangible symbol of the construction of the European Union." The euro "symbolizes the union of millions of Europeans around a common project that aims to create the conditions for lasting peace and sustained economic development in Europe. I now pass the floor to Eng. Monica Fernandes, responsible for Quality Control in the Department of Issuance and Treasury of Banco de Portugal. Eng. Monica Fernandes will now make a more detailed presentation on the main features of the new 10 euro banknote. Thank you very much.

Interveno do Administrador do Banco de Portugal Joo Amaral Tomaz na sesso sobre a nova nota de 10 22 set. 2014 Lisboa, 22 de setembro de 2014 Amanh, dia 23 de setembro, entra em circulao, em Portugal e nos outros pases da rea do euro, a nova nota de 10 euros. A nova nota de 10 euros pertence  segunda srie de notas de euro, a srie Europa. Como certamente se recordam, a primeira nota da srie Europa a entrar em circulao foi a nota de 5 euros, lanada em 2013. Visualmente, a nova nota de 10 euros  muito semelhante  atual e, por esse motivo,  fcil reconhec-la. A cor dominante da nota continua a ser o vermelho. O desenho foi ligeiramente alterado, mas continuamos a encontrar o prtico romnico da nota de 10 euros da primeira srie, alm de outros elementos familiares. No obstante, a nova nota incorpora elementos de segurana ainda mais sofisticados, que a tornam ainda mais segura e mais resistente  contrafao.  o caso do retrato da deusa Europa, que podemos encontrar no holograma e na marca de gua, e do nmero esmeralda, elementos de segurana que o pblico j conhece, porque tambm constam da nota de 5 euros que foi lanada no ano passado. De facto, a srie Europa resulta de um compromisso entre a continuidade e a inovao, duas caratersticas indispensveis para reforar a confiana na moeda.  importante que o pblico conhea bem a nova nota e que saiba identificar os principais elementos de segurana. Embora os nveis de contrafao de notas em Portugal e na rea do euro permaneam muito baixos,  fundamental que o pblico e os profissionais que lidam com numerrio saibam avaliar a autenticidade de uma nota no momento em que a recebem. A razo  simples: uma nota contrafeita no pode ser trocada por uma nota genuna. Quem aceitar uma nota contrafeita julgando tratar-se de uma nota autntica no poder recuperar o seu valor. Permitam-me, a este propsito, dirigir a uma palavra de agradecimento a todas as entidades que contribuem para a segurana da circulao fiduciria em Portugal. No caso concreto de Portugal, o nmero de contrafaes apreendidas representa menos de 2% do total de contrafaes apreendidas na rea do euro. Este resultado deve-se, no apenas ao desempenho do Banco de Portugal, mas tambm ao relevante papel que o sistema bancrio, as entidades que operam nas reas da gesto e da distribuio de numerrio e as autoridades policiais tm vindo a desempenhar neste domnio. Existem outras mensagens muito relevantes que  necessrio transmitir ao pblico a propsito do lanamento da nova nota. Com a entrada em circulao da nova nota de 10 euros, os portugueses no tero de trocar quaisquer notas. A nota de 10 euros da primeira srie continuar em circulao e poder continuar a ser utilizada para efetuar pagamentos, sem restries. A nova nota e a nota da primeira srie vo circular em simultneo, como j se verifica, de resto, relativamente s notas de 5 euros da primeira e da segunda srie. A data em que as notas da primeira srie deixaro de ter curso legal ainda no foi definida, mas posso garantir que ser anunciada com bastante antecedncia. Em qualquer caso, convm deixar claro o seguinte: as notas da primeira srie nunca perdero o seu valor. No existe prescrio ao fim de 20 anos como se verificava para o escudo. Ou seja, as notas de euro da primeira srie, mesmo depois de perderem o curso legal, podero ser trocadas, por um perodo de tempo ilimitado, no Banco de Portugal e nos restantes bancos centrais nacionais do Eurosistema. Como podero imaginar, a entrada em circulao de uma nova nota envolve mltiplos intervenientes e exige um esforo significativo de articulao e de cooperao entre todos. Para o lanamento da nova nota de 10 euros, foram produzidos 4,5 mil milhes de notas. S o processo de impresso, da responsabilidade de 15 bancos centrais nacionais, demorou cerca de um ano. O Banco de Portugal desenvolveu, desde o incio deste ano, um conjunto alargado de iniciativas de informao e de formao, de comunicao e de apoio tcnico, para profissionais e para o pblico em geral, para preparar o lanamento da nova nota. Em especial, o Banco Central Europeu e os bancos centrais nacionais da rea do euro uniram esforos para promover a adaptao atempada de todos os tipos de equipamentos que operam com numerrio. Embora a responsabilidade pela adaptao dos equipamentos seja, em ltima anlise, dos respetivos proprietrios, o Eurosistema e, em particular, o Banco de Portugal tomaram todas as medidas que estavam ao seu alcance para que essa adaptao fosse concretizada rapidamente. Contudo, no podemos garantir que todos os equipamentos estejam aptos a aceitar a nova nota de 10 euros j a partir de amanh. Gostaria tambm de assinalar que, para alm das iniciativas de comunicao e de informao que o Banco de Portugal tem promovido para os profissionais e para o pblico em geral, temos conhecimento de que outras instituies tambm esto a fazlo.  de realar a prestimosa iniciativa das autoridades policiais (GNR e PSP), que tm desenvolvido campanhas de sensibilizao junto das populaes com menor acesso  informao e que, como tal, esto mais expostas a eventuais tentativas de burla. Volto a recordar, a este propsito, que ningum est mandatado para trocar notas em nome do Banco de Portugal ou em nome das instituies de crdito. Como referi, no  necessrio trocar as notas de euro antigas pelas novas notas, porque, mesmo depois da introduo da nova nota de 10 euros, as notas antigas vo permanecer em circulao por muito tempo. A confiana na moeda  na nossa moeda, o euro   um ativo que todos temos o dever de preservar. Convido-vos, por isso, a conhecer a nova nota e, em particular os seus elementos de segurana, que podem ser verificados por qualquer pessoa, sem necessidade de recorrer a qualquer equipamento especial. Para terminar, recordo as palavras do Senhor Governador, proferidas em 26 de fevereiro ltimo, no Seminrio de apresentao da nova nota de 10 euros, destinado sobretudo aos fabricantes de equipamento e s empresas que operam em grande escala com mquinas de venda automtica de bens e servios. O euro , indiscutivelmente, o smbolo tangvel mais forte da construo da Unio Europeia. O euro simboliza a unio de milhes de europeus em torno de um projeto comum que pretende criar, na Europa, condies para uma paz duradoura e para um desenvolvimento econmico sustentado. Passo agora a palavra  Eng. Mnica Fernandes, responsvel pelo Controlo de Qualidade no Departamento de Emisso e Tesouraria do Banco de Portugal. A Eng. Mnica Fernandes far agora uma apresentao mais detalhada sobre as principais caractersticas da nova nota de 10 euros. Muito obrigado.

Title: Intervention of Governor Carlos da Silva Costa on Financial Training Day: Financial training in support of entrepreneurship
text: Intervention of Governor Carlos da Silva Costa on Financial Training Day: Financial training in support of entrepreneurship 31 out. 2014 1. The Day of Financial Training Today we are gathered here to mark, for the 3rd consecutive year, the Financial Training Day, an initiative of the National Financial Training Plan, launched in 2011 by financial supervisors  Banco de Portugal, The Securities Market Commission and The Insurance Institute of Portugal. The National Financial Training Plan is an aggregating instrument of financial training initiatives and counts on the collaboration of a wide range of partners, who carry out day-to-day work to promote the objectives of the plan: to raise awareness of the importance of financial training; disseminate knowledge about financial products and services; and encourage appropriate attitudes and behaviors in the choice of these products. Financial Training Day is therefore an important occasion when financial supervisors and plan partners come together to raise citizens' awareness of the importance of financial training, but also to reflect on the work done and discuss new ideas and new ways of achieving the desired objectives. The choice of October 31 to mark The Day of Financial Training was not by chance. It is also celebrated today world saving day. Therefore, in 2012, the first edition of the Financial Training Day, which took place at Pateo da Gale in Lisbon, was precisely dedicated to the theme "Savings". In 2013, we were in Porto, at Filipa de Vilhena High School, under the motto "Financial training is in schools. Don't stay out of it." Last year's location and theme reflected the special attention that the Plan has given to the implementation of financial training in the school space. This year, The Day of Financial Training is dedicated to "Financial training in support of entrepreneurship" because we are convinced that financial skills are essential for the development of any project, whether it is the creation of self-employment or a micro-enterprise, or a social entrepreneurship initiative. 2. The concept of entrepreneurship and the importance of education for entrepreneurship The majority of authors and international bodies, such as the European Commission and the OECD, associate entrepreneurship/entrepreneurial capacity with a range of characteristics related to skills and attitudes and specific knowledge. The ability to plan and assess risks, to work as a team, to identify new opportunities, to be proactive, persevering, resilient and to have determination to achieve objectives is important. Anyone who owns these features is typically more likely to start a new project, a new business. It is therefore important that society values them and that the training of young people encourages their development. Teachers have an essential role here. We know that many are indeed concerned and that they are committed to transmitting the necessary knowledge, promoting the development of personal skills and, above all, creating in young people the self-confidence necessary for the creation of new projects. We see that many of the financial training projects of schools that apply for the Todos Conta Contest have an entrepreneurship component. During today we will also have several schools here sharing their experience in this area. And it is important that this is continued training, including primary education, secondary education, vocational training and higher education. 3. Financial training as a component of entrepreneurship Financial skills are key competencies for entrepreneurship. The success of innovative ideas involves the ability to plan, and plan in context of uncertainty, knowing that there are risks. The implementation of a new project usually requires a decision on how to financing, which may involve the use of bank credit. Even if this does not happen, interaction with the financial system is certainly necessary, to have a bank account, to make payments or to subscribe to compulsory insurance. Financial training provides knowledge about financial products and services, their characteristics and risks and the rights and duties of bank customers. By empowering the entrepreneur to an informed choice of products, financial training supports decision-making in the realization of new projects. A choice of financial products appropriate to the objectives of the project, taking into account the inherent risks, contributes to the success of the project and, eventually, makes it possible to avoid further situations of credit default, for the benefit of the efficiency and stability of the financial system. 4. The importance of partnerships The Plan is available to support entrepreneurship through the financial training component. But in this, as in other areas, cooperation and partnerships are essential to achieve results. I recall the example of collaboration between the Ministry of Education and Science and financial supervisors in the implementation of financial training in schools. The results are visible: In May 2013, the Financial Education Framework was published, prepared in ensemble. The document sets out the themes of financial training to be addressed in each financial teaching; In 2014, we also started teacher training on the Financial Education Framework, in the modality of training workshops accredited, addressed to teachers of pre-school education and primary and secondary. The first training workshops took place during the first semester, in Porto, for teachers from the Northern region, and are now taking place in Coimbra, for teachers from the Centro region. In 2015, these training workshops will to the regions of Lisbon and Tagus Valley, Alentejo and Algarve. Four associations of the financial sector - the Portuguese Association of Banks, Association of Investment Funds, Pensions and Assets, the Association of Insurance Companies and the Association of Specialized Credit Institutions - made available to collaborate with supervisors and the Ministry of Education and science in the production of pedagogical resources to support the implementation of the Financial Education reference in the school curriculum. Recently, an international organization  Child and Youth Finance International (CYFI)  recognized these results and awarded Portugal the Country Award 2014 for Europe, for the work carried out in the context of financial training in schools. But we know that the work is not finished and we want to go further in supporting financial training, in schools and in other training contexts. Therefore, under the National Financial Training Plan, financial supervisors will launch an e-learning platform, with the aim of supporting teachers and other trainers in teaching financial issues and also enabling self-training. As with financial training in schools, financial training to support entrepreneurship will only work with strong and lasting partnerships, because the objectives of financial training are necessarily medium and long term. The Plan is collaborating with the Antonio Sergio Cooperative for social economy (CASES) under the Academia ES program, which forms young people in order to favor the development of social entrepreneurship projects. I am sure that after this Financial Training Day, other partnerships will emerge and consolidate. Because financial training is important for the development of robust entrepreneurship projects and because an entrepreneurial society is better able to face risks and generate more sustainable economic growth. Thank you very much. evora, 31 October 2014 [1] Prepared to be given on the occasion of the celebrations of Financial Training Day 2014. text_original: Interveno do Governador Carlos da Silva Costa no Dia da Formao Financeira: A formao financeira no apoio ao empreendedorismo 31 out. 2014 1. O Dia da Formao Financeira Estamos hoje aqui reunidos para a assinalar, pelo 3. ano consecutivo, o Dia da Formao Financeira, uma iniciativa do Plano Nacional de Formao Financeira, lanado em 2011 pelos supervisores financeiros  Banco de Portugal, Comisso do Mercado de Valores Mobilirios e Instituto de Seguros de Portugal. O Plano Nacional de Formao Financeira  um instrumento agregador de iniciativas de formao financeira e conta com a colaborao de um conjunto alargado de parceiros, que desenvolvem no dia-a-dia um trabalho de promoo dos objetivos do plano : sensibilizar para a importncia da formao financeira; disseminar conhecimentos sobre produtos e servios financeiros; e incentivar atitudes e comportamentos adequados na escolha destes produtos. O Dia da Formao Financeira , por isso, uma ocasio importante, em que os supervisores financeiros e os parceiros do Plano se juntam para sensibilizar os cidados para a importncia da formao financeira, mas tambm para refletir sobre o trabalho realizado e debater novas ideias e novas formas de alcanar os objetivos pretendidos. A escolha do dia 31 de outubro para assinalar o Dia da Formao Financeira no foi por acaso.  que hoje comemora-se tambm o Dia Mundial da Poupana. Por isso, em 2012, a primeira edio do Dia da Formao Financeira, que decorreu no Pteo da Gal, em Lisboa, foi precisamente dedicada ao tema A Poupana. Em 2013, estivemos no Porto, na Escola Secundria Filipa de Vilhena, sob o lema A formao financeira est nas escolas. No fique de fora. O local e o tema do ano passado refletiram a especial ateno que o Plano tem dado  implementao da formao financeira no espao escolar. Este ano, o Dia da Formao Financeira  dedicado  Formao financeira no apoio ao empreendedorismo porque estamos convictos de que as competncias financeiras so essenciais para o desenvolvimento de qualquer projeto, seja de criao de autoemprego ou de uma microempresa, seja de uma iniciativa de empreendedorismo social . 2. O conceito de empreendedorismo e a importncia da educao para o empreendedorismo A generalidade dos autores e os organismos internacionais, como a Comisso Europeia e a OCDE, associam o empreendedorismo / a capacidade empreendedora a um conjunto de caractersticas relacionadas com competncias e atitudes e com conhecimentos especficos. So apontados como importantes as capacidades de planear e de avaliar riscos, de trabalhar em equipa, de identificar novas oportunidades, de ser pr-ativo, perseverante, resiliente e de ter determinao para atingir objetivos. Quem possui estas caractersticas  tipicamente mais propenso a comear um novo projeto, um novo negcio. , por isso, importante que a sociedade as valorize e que a formao dos jovens incentive o seu desenvolvimento. Os professores tm aqui um papel essencial. Sabemos que muitos tm efetivamente esta preocupao e que esto empenhados em transmitir os conhecimentos necessrios, em promover o desenvolvimento de competncias pessoais e, sobretudo, em criar nos jovens a autoconfiana necessria para a criao de novos projetos. Vemos que muitos dos projetos de formao financeira das escolas que se candidatam ao Concurso Todos Contam tm uma componente de empreendedorismo. Durante o dia de hoje teremos tambm aqui vrias escolas a partilhar a sua experincia nesta rea. E  importante que esta seja uma formao continuada, incluindo o ensino bsico, o ensino secundrio, a formao profissional e o ensino superior. 3. A formao financeira como componente do empreendedorismo As competncias financeiras so competncias-chave para o empreendedorismo. O sucesso das ideias inovadoras passa pela capacidade de planear, e de planear em   contexto de incerteza, sabendo que existem riscos. A concretizao de um novo projeto requer normalmente uma deciso sobre a forma de o financiar, o que pode envolver o recurso ao crdito bancrio. Mesmo que tal no acontea, a interao com o sistema financeiro  certamente necessria, para ter uma conta bancria, para fazer pagamentos ou para subscrever os seguros obrigatrios. A formao financeira proporciona conhecimentos sobre os produtos e servios financeiros, sobre as suas caractersticas e riscos e sobre os direitos e deveres dos clientes bancrios. Ao capacitar o empreendedor para uma escolha informada de produtos, a formao financeira apoia a tomada de decises na concretizao de novos projetos. Uma escolha de produtos financeiros adequados aos objetivos do projeto, que tenha em ateno os riscos inerentes, contribui para o sucesso do projeto e, eventualmente, permite evitar posteriores situaes de incumprimento de crdito, em benefcio da eficincia e da estabilidade do sistema financeiro. 4. A importncia das parcerias O Plano est disponvel para apoiar o empreendedorismo atravs da componente de formao financeira. Mas, nesta, como noutras reas, a cooperao e as parcerias so essenciais para obter resultados. Recordo o exemplo da colaborao entre o Ministrio da Educao e Cincia e os supervisores financeiros na implementao da formao financeira nas escolas. Os resultados so visveis: Em maio de 2013, foi publicado o Referencial de Educao Financeira, elaborado em conjunto. O documento define os temas de formao financeira a abordar em cada ciclo de ensino; Em 2014, tambm em conjunto, inicimos a formao de professores sobre o Referencial de Educao Financeira, na modalidade de oficinas de formao credenciadas, dirigidas a professores da educao pr-escolar e do ensino bsico e secundrio. As primeiras oficinas de formao decorreram durante o primeiro semestre, no Porto, para professores da regio Norte, e agora esto a decorrer em Coimbra, para professores da regio Centro. Em 2015, estas oficinas de formao vo alargar-se s regies de Lisboa e Vale do Tejo, Alentejo e Algarve. Quatro associaes do setor financeiro  a Associao Portuguesa de Bancos, a Associao Portuguesa de Fundos de Investimento, Penses e Patrimnios, a Associao Portuguesa de Seguradores e a Associao de Instituies de Crdito Especializado  disponibilizaram-se para colaborar com os supervisores e o Ministrio da Educao e Cincia na produo de recursos pedaggicos para apoiar a implementao do Referencial de Educao Financeira no currculo escolar. Recentemente, uma organizao internacional  a Child and Youth Finance International (CYFI) , reconheceu estes resultados e atribuiu a Portugal o Prmio Pas 2014 para a Europa, pelo trabalho desenvolvido no mbito da formao financeira nas escolas. Mas sabemos que o trabalho no est terminado e queremos ir mais longe no apoio  formao financeira, nas escolas e noutros contextos formativos. Title: Opinion article by Governor Carlos da Silva Costa in the Daily News: "Portuguese banks show resilience in the passage to the Single Supervisory Mechanism"
text: Governor Car's opinion piece... Opinion article by Governor Carlos da Silva Costa in the Daily News: "Portuguese banks show resilience in the passage to the Single Supervisory Mechanism" 04 nov. 2014 The recent conclusion of the Complete Assessment (CA), embodied in an asset quality analysis (AQR) and in the performance of stress tests, proved the resilience and adequate capitalization of the Portuguese banks covered by the exercise. This is the result of banco de Portugal's supervisory work over the past four years, as well as from the actions taken by the different banks, at a time when there is a turning point with the transition to the Single Supervisory Mechanism (SSM). To paraphrase Father Antonio Vieira, it is important to keep in mind that the resilience of a financial institution is like a myrtle sculpture that, unlike an identically beautiful marble sculpture, is exposed to multiple deformation factors that result from the dynamics of the organic development of the support that forms it, the surrounding conditions and the rooting of this support, of the parasites that attack him and the attention and diligence of the gardener who carves it. That is, it is tailored in the day-to-day through a management that anticipates the risks that result from its surroundings and that is attentive to the responsiveness of the organization and the risks emerging from it. The soundness of financial institutions and their resilience to shocks are essential to preserve the confidence of economic operators and safeguard financial stability, a fundamental condition for the proper functioning of the economy, ensuring sustainable economic growth and employment. The results of the AQR and the baseline scenario of the stress test showed that the national banks covered by the exercise are robust. In both cases, all banks recorded capital ratios above the reference value (8%). The only institution for which capital deficits have been projected in the adverse stress test scenario  a particularly serious and unlikely scenario  has already identified a set of measures to cover the gap, which will be incorporated into the plan that european central bank (ECB). The good results achieved by portuguese banks in the CA should be seen in the light of the work developed in the last four years, during which they were subject to a wide and intense scrutiny to all areas and balance sheet items, recognized oddities and strengthened capital. To this end, banco de Portugal's activity in the last four years, which has taken place in a context of special demand, both in the international sphere and in the context of the Economic and Financial Assistance Programme (PAEF), in which the Bank has taken on several responsibilities, must be underlined. The Bank's strategy since 2010 to safeguard financial stability and make the financial system more robust has been incorporated and deepened within the framework of the PAEF. This strategy was based on four main axes: strengthening the solvency of banks; protection of the liquidity of the system; strengthening monitoring and supervision of the banking system; improving the regulatory framework. Remarkable progress has been made in all respects, recognised by international partners. This progress is well evident in the evolution of the solvency of the Portuguese banking system, with the Core Tier 1 ratio increasing from 7.4% in 2010 to 12.3% at the end of 2013 (CA's starting point). Banco de Portugal adopted a more intrusive supervisory model, with a greater focus on risk and a more transversal and prospective nature. New supervisory instruments (e.g. Financing and Capital Plans) have been developed and quarterly stress tests have been carried out to assess the capacity of the banking system in adverse scenarios. Noteworthy is the cycle of cross-cutting inspections initiated in 2011  Special Inspection Program (SIP), On-Site Inspection St. (IpO), Cross-Sectional Exercise of Review of Credit Portfolio Oddities (ETRICC) and Analysis of the business plans of relevant customers of the banking system (ETRICC2)  with the aim of ensuring that the levels of parity recognized by banks were adequate and that the methodologies and procedures, including the appreciation of the collaterals associated with exposures, were conservative and were aligned with best practices. Overall, these actions have led to a strengthening of the odd and provisions of the eight largest national banking groups totaling EUR 3.8 billion, an amount reflected in their accounts. It should be said in this regard that, since the beginning of the international financial crisis, the recorded oddities have reached very high values, particularly in EU countries. In Portugal, between 2008 and 2013, approximately 31 billion euros of unmatches were recorded in the results of the banking system, approximately 7% of the total assets of the sector in 2013. The CA was the first major cross-cutting inspection of the European banking system and a crucial step in the ECB's assumption on 4 November of its responsibilities in the context of the SSM. The ECB, national supervisors and European banks will be the main players in this historic moment of the European project. Furthermore, this step for the Banking Union is expected to have a very positive impact on the euro area and the Portuguese economy in particular. The beneficial impact results from financing conditions for businesses and families that are no longer influenced by the sovereign state's risk; public accounts are now immune to accidents in the financial system and will increase confidence in the European banking system, as it will be easier to harmonise supervisory procedures and practices around demanding standards. With the Single Supervisory Mechanism, depositor confidence and the stability of the European financial system will be strengthened. Lisbon, 4 November 2014
