A ecloso da pandemia e as suas consequncias fizeram com que a formao financeira adquirisse ainda maior relevncia, sendo chamada a responder a um conjunto de novos e intensos desafios. O seu reconhecimento como importante instrumento no mbito da estratgia de resposta das autoridades pblicas  crise gerada pela pandemia est refletido em diversas iniciativas que a nvel internacional os decisores de poltica tm vindo a propor e a implementar. O Plano define trs dimenses estratgicas de atuao, a saber: (i) reforar a resilincia financeira; (ii) promover a formao financeira digital e (iii) contribuir para a sustentabilidade. So ainda identificadas oito linhas de ao prioritrias, a implementar em paralelo com as atividades regulares do Plano. De facto, ao longo dos ltimos anos a inovao tecnolgica tem estimulado a transformao digital do setor financeiro, alterando a configurao de muitos produtos e servios financeiros. Os canais digitais so muito convenientes e proporcionam uma maior rapidez aos consumidores no momento de contratar produtos e servios financeiros. Todavia, a sua utilizao deve ser acompanhada da adoo de medidas de precauo e mitigao de riscos, sob pena de os consumidores virem a ser alvo de tentativas de fraude e cibercrime, que provocam custos imediatos para as vtimas e reduzem a sua confiana numa futura utilizao destes meios. As medidas visando a proteo da sade pblica adotadas durante a atual pandemia, como os perodos de confinamento e o distanciamento social, reforaram a utilizao dos canais digitais, mesmo entre os consumidores que habitualmente o no faziam por possurem menores competncias digitais ou por receio dos riscos associados. Consequentemente, esta franja da populao ficou mais vulnervel  fraude e, infelizmente, h sempre pessoas  espreita de oportunidades  custa do prejuzo dos outros. Por outro lado, uma sociedade cada vez mais digital proporciona o acesso gil e simples a produtos e servios financeiros e uma oferta mais personalizada e integrada. Contudo, o ambiente digital propicia tambm a tomada de decises por impulso e a sobrevalorizao do presente, exacerbando os enviesamentos comportamentais, podendo conduzir a decises pouco ponderadas, por exemplo, no recurso ao crdito ou na escolha de produtos para investimento da poupana. Assim, atravs da promoo da formao financeira digital, o Plano Nacional de Formao Financeira 2021-2025 pretende contribuir para capacitar a populao para aceder de forma segura aos servios financeiros digitais, desenvolvendo comportamentos de preveno da fraude e de minimizao da excluso financeira por via da excluso digital. Title: Opening speech by the Governor, Mario Centeno, at the Conference of the National Financial Training Plan 2021 - 2025
text: Intervention of opening of the Government... Opening speech by the Governor, Mario Centeno, at the Conference of the National Financial Training Plan 2021 - 2025 26 nov. 2021 Exmos. members of the National Council of Financial Supervisors Exma. Madam President of the Insurance and Funds and Pensions Supervisory Authority, dear Margarida Correa de Aguiar Mr. Mr. Administrator of the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dear Rui Pinto Mr. Mr. Deputy Governor of Banco de Portugal, dear Luis Maximo dos Santos Exmos. Speakers Ladies and gentlemen, I am happy to welcome you to the conference to present the strategic guidelines of the National Financial Training Plan for 2021 to 2025. This conference takes place at an important time when the National Financial Training Plan celebrates 10 years of existence. The results of the latest financial literacy survey, conducted in early 2020, highlight the need for financial training to be addressed. I would remind you that a third of the Portuguese could not afford an unexpected expense equivalent to their income. And in the event of loss of the main source of income, a quarter would not be able to pay household expenses for more than a month. Despite the intense support measures, the pandemic situation brought fragility, which affected the traditional vulnerable groups. Financial training thus has an important role to play in strengthening the financial resilience of households and micro and small enterprises, seeking to help them be more empowered. At the same time, there was an acceleration of digital transformation and the new financial service providers. Recognizing the benefits of the digital transition, it is important to be aware of the risks of digitisation, in particular cybercrime. It is essential that citizens acquire the digital skills needed to access and contract financial products safely. It is essential to promote digital financial training by contributing to the safe and confident use of digital financial products and services and to the adoption of online fraud prevention behaviours. But it is also very important to avoid the risk of financial exclusion through digital exclusion. The role of financial training in raising citizens' awareness of sustainability is also another element to be considered. Here, I stress the importance of reflecting environmental, social and governance preferences in consumer choices and investment financial product choices. For the next few years, the National Council of Financial Supervisors maintains the same ambition: to promote financial training through the National Financial Training Plan. This is therefore the privileged time for us to reassess its strategic guidelines, following the approach that has been adopted, to carry out an in-depth reflection every five years. We intend to establish new partners and strengthen current ones to extend the action of the Plan progressively wider target audiences. We also want to strengthen the focus on digital platforms, such as financial training channels, without ever forgetting, face-to-face financial training initiatives. "Strengthening partnerships, betting on digital" is therefore the vision that guides the strategy that we now put to everyone's consultation. The topics under consideration at this conference and the written contributions we hope to receive from the different partners and the public will certainly be relevant to the definition of a more robust and effective plan. As President of the National Council of Financial Supervisors I would once again like to thank all partners for their commitment to pursuing our mission. International recognition of our work, in particular in the OECD's International Network on Financial Education, is proof of our ability to add efforts around financial training. As 10 years ago, the motto that guides our strategy continues to make sense, because in financial training: with the contribution of all, Everyone Counts! Thank you very much

Title: Intervention of Administrator Hlder Rosalino in the Greetings Session at the Ministry of Finance
text: Intervention of the Administrator Helder... Intervention of Administrator Helder Rosalino in the Greetings Session at the Ministry of Finance 29 nov. 2021 Minister of State and Finance, Secretaries of State, Mr Governor of Banco de Portugal, Dear Colleagues Ladies and gentlemen, I would like to begin by thanking the Secretary of State for State and Finance and also the Governor of Banco de Portugal have placed in me to continue to serve as Director of Banco de Portugal. It is a great honor to perform these functions in an institution with a long history of service to the country  which celebrates this year 175 years  and in which I have been serving for more than two and a half decades, in various positions and functions. Banco de Portugal plays a central role in national and European economic policy. This role stems from its dual mandate to maintain price stability and safeguard financial stability. The last few years have been very challenging for the execution of this dual mission, and have put to the test the capacity of the decision-making bodies of Banco de Portugal and its workers. During this period, as Administrator, I assumed several responsibilities and directly monitored several areas of the Bank's activity. Areas as central to the Bank's mission as the implementation of monetary policy, reserve management, monetary issuance and the oversight of payment systems. I also followed the areas of information systems and technologies, resources and accounting and management control, communication, strategic planning, ethics and conduct and business continuity management. I also held, by indication of Banco de Portugal, the functions of Director of Valora S.A.  the bank company responsible for the production of banknotes  and the Pension Fund Management Company of Banco de Portugal. I have performed all these functions with total dedication, commitment and commitment, always bearing in mind the purpose and reason of Banco de Portugal, which is to contribute to the well-being of citizens by safeguarding price stability and financial stability. On this occasion, I have to take stock of the years I take as a member of the Board of Directors of Banco de Portugal, focusing on the areas of responsibility that I have taken directly. But on this occasion, it is also important to look at some of the challenges that, in the near future, will require the attention of the Board of Directors of Banco de Portugal, which I will try to state in summary form. With reference to the brief balance sheet of my first term of office, it should be recalled that there have been several complex demands on Banco de Portugal in recent years. Among them, I note: i. the revision of the model of regulation and supervision of the financial system, in particular the establishment of the Banking Union; ii. the adoption of non-conventional monetary policy measures by the Eurosystem, which were key to saving the euro and ensuring financing of economies and states; iii. the profound technological transformation in the activity of financial intermediation and, in particular, in payment systems; iv. And more recently, the Covid-19 pandemic, which has brought challenges never before tested. In the areas I have followed more directly, and without being exhaustive, I would like to point out the following: Banco de Portugal had an influential participation and, on a timely basis, decisive decision, in the definition and implementation of new monetary policy measures, created to respond to the most recent crises. The Bank was at the forefront of discussing these measures on the Board of European Central Bank and, not least, in the technical teams that prepared the decisions of the Governors. In addition, the Bank has ensured the full implementation in Portugal of these measures, supporting the financing of the economy, households, businesses and the State, in extremely favourable conditions, never before verified. Followed personally and with close proximity, these developments, contributing to the measure of my responsibilities to ensure an adequate level of response bank of Portugal at such a high demand. In the area of payments, Banco de Portugal has responsibilities to regulate, monitor and promote the smooth functioning of means and payment systems. In this capacity, it actively participated in the transposition of the Revised payment (DSP2) and accompanied the implementation of the new framework regulation, which has created new payment services and promoted innovation and safety in carrying out operations. The Bank also had the concern to be close to technological innovation, established a structured dialogue with the market and with the promoters innovation. In this context, Banco de Portugal created Portugal FinLab, a platform for innovation aimed at facilitating dialogue between supervisors in the sector entrepreneurs in the area of digitisation. It also revitalised the Interbank Commission for Payment Systems and the Forum for Payment Systems, structures that integrate the participants of the market and aimed at promoting secure, efficient and efficient payment solutions Innovative. It was, moreover, within the framework of the Payment Systems Forum that the first National Strategy for Retail Payments in Portugal, presented in 2020 and whose implementation we will complete by the end of 2022. In the field of monetary issuance, I would like to note the launch of the second series of euro, the Europe Series. It was a strategic project, due to the relevance of introduction of new security elements for public confidence in the euro. I also note the agreement reached between the central banks of Austria, Belgium and Portugal, which allowed Valora S. A., the impressor of notes of the Bank of Portugal, to double its annual production of euro banknotes and to take a prominent role in european printers. At the level of the functioning of the Bank, and in order to respond to the new and the demands arising from digital transformation, the models of government and organization, along side internal processes. The regulatory framework and compliance with the rules of ethics and conduct has been strengthened and criteria have been efficiency and a culture of accountability for results. In the management of human resources, it was based on the training and development of competences of the workers, and the Banco de Portugal Academy was created, promoting integrated management of training on the basis of strategic priorities bank. After an intense and fruitful negotiation process with the union structures, it was signed a new Banco de Portugal Company Agreement, more adjusted to the new challenges facing the Bank and its employees. In the area of information technologies and systems, two structuring programmes: a digital transformation programme  the Digital Bank 2020  and an integrated information management programme. Collaborative solutions and mobility measures adopted under the digital transformation programme have ended, moreover, as it proves crucial in the context of pandemic mitigation measures. In March 2020, the Bank was able, in just over a week, to transfer 90% of the teleworking workers and thereby ensuring the uninterrupted provision of essential functions, even the most critical for the functioning of our economy. In order to increase protection against cyber-attacks, a cybersecurity, which also provided an integrated view of incidents security sector in the national financial sector. An innovation laboratory was also created, who has developed experimental work in response to different cases of business. In order to increase the transparency of the performance, contribute to a better understanding of economic and financial issues, and strengthen the connection to the community, a profound reformulation of the Bank's communication model, with centralization, department, of all external and internal communication responsibilities. In order to reach new audiences, the Bank opened social media accounts, produced simpler and more visually appealing content, and introduced changes to the to their regular publications. This route was recently recognized by Central Banking, which attributed the Banco de Portugal the best central bank award in the category of "new initiatives communication process." Looking to the future now, we will have to recognise that, like the previous ones, the coming years will certainly be very challenging for Banco de Portugal, which will have to carry out its public service mission in a marked context: For the gradual recovery of the public health crisis and its impact with the uncertainties still in existence; For the continuation of a very low interest rate environment, although it is a progressive recovery in inflation levels and the curves of income; By increasing risks in the financial system associated with the economic impact of pandemic; By the evolution of economic and monetary union and the European supervisory model and national; The challenges associated with financial and technological innovation and the risks to financial stability arising from climate change; By the emergence of new services and new financial operators and payments and the growing need for regulation and supervision of the financial sector non-banking; For greater demand and scrutiny regarding the performance of public institutions independent members; and By the global impact of climate change and the increased awareness of the need for sustainable and socially responsible institutions. Focusing on the areas that I follow more directly, and without being exhaustive, I would like to state some dimensions of action that will be, from a strategic point of view, more relevant in the coming years. It is therefore unquestionable that the activities associated with the conduct of monetary policy will continue to play a major role in maintaining adequate liquidity and financing conditions for all economic actors. Banco de Portugal's role in this area has been and will continue to be central to the economy and the national financial system, through its influential performance at Eurosystem level, as well as in the national dimension. In the area of payment systems, particular attention will be paid to the Eurosystem's project to issue a digital central bank currency, which could lead, as some anticipate, to an unprecedented global monetary transformation. In addition to the ability to influence the design of the so-called digital Euro and the ability to support the national financial system if the project advances, the Bank will have to actively participate in the research phase, which will run until 2023, and in the implementation phase, operationalizing the infrastructure that will be made available. In the context of issuing and treasury, Banco de Portugal will continue to promote the adoption of measures for a more efficient use of cash and for reducing its environmental impact. It is considered the possibility of implementing European measures for rounding up cash payments and, consequently, of discontinuation of the production and issue of 1 and 2 cent coins. These measures, if implemented, will also contribute to increasing the efficiency of the cash life cycle in our country. As regards internal management, it is a priority to continue to focus on business-based innovation and the promotion of a data driven organization, driven by a modern data architecture and artificial intelligence solutions. It is also necessary to evolve into advanced and increasingly robust models of cybersecurity and business continuity, from the experience lived in recent years. In the area of communication and image, the Bank should develop a consistent and ambitious line of action that will allow it, by 2025, to be better understood by society, with regard to its mission and functions, and perceived as closer to citizens. To bring the Bank closer to society, it will also be important to increase social responsibility initiatives, keeping inclusion by education and support for communities closer to the Bank as priorities. The Branch in Porto, the Regional Delegations of Madeira and the Azores and our Agencies throughout the country will continue to play a central role in the Bank's overall performance, not only for the increasing exercise of decentralized functions, but also for the strengthening of the provision of service to local communities, constituting an effective contribution of the Bank to the territorial cohesion of the country. The rules of conduct and ethics will continue to be improved, with the implementation of the new General Regime for the Prevention of Corruption and the adoption of an internal mechanism for the protection of people who report violations in the performance of the bank and its representatives, imposing the operationalization of efficient, safe and reliable reporting channels. Last but not least, the guarantee of Banco de Portugal's financial autonomy should be a priority in the field of governance and internal management, in particular given the prospect of a prolonged environment of low or even negative interest rates. The main challenges will be the search for new sources of income and the adoption of a new model of strategic allocation of the bank's management assets. The instruments for projectition and control of financial results should also be improved and the appropriate level of financial buffers defined. In a sense, the coming years will continue to be challenging, but Banco de Portugal is able to face them and prepared to continue to support the collective effort to recover the Portuguese economy and the European integration project. Before concluding, I would like to leave a personal thanks to the workers of Banco de Portugal, to whom I recognize an enormous professional capacity and a high sense of mission, and who have enriched me, over the years, with their knowledge and humanity. Finally, I can say that I am motivated to continue to perform these functions with dedication and a sense of public interest, and to contribute to the strengthening of credibility of Banco de Portugal as a reference institution in our society. Thank you very much.
text_original: Interveno do Administrador Hlder... Interveno do Administrador Hlder Rosalino na Sesso de Cumprimentos no Ministrio das Finanas 29 nov. 2021 Senhor Ministro de Estado e das Finanas, Senhores Secretrios de Estado, Senhor Governador do Banco de Portugal, Caros Colegas Minhas Senhoras e meus Senhores, Gostaria de comear por agradecer a confiana que o Senhor Ministro de Estado e das Finanas e tambm o Senhor Governador do Banco de Portugal depositaram em mim para continuar a exercer as funes de Administrador do Banco de Portugal.  uma grande honra desempenhar estas funes numa instituio com uma longa histria de servio ao Pas  que celebra este ano 175 anos  e na qual sirvo h mais de duas dcadas e meia, em diversos cargos e funes. O Banco de Portugal desempenha um papel central na poltica econmica nacional e europeia. Esse papel decorre do seu duplo mandato de manuteno da estabilidade dos preos e de salvaguarda da estabilidade financeira. Os ltimos anos foram muito desafiantes para a execuo desta dupla misso, e colocaram  prova a capacidade dos rgos de deciso do Banco de Portugal e dos seus trabalhadores. Durante esse perodo, como Administrador, assumi diversas responsabilidades e acompanhei diretamente vrias reas da atividade do Banco. reas to centrais na misso do Banco como a implementao da poltica monetria, a gesto de reservas, a emisso monetria e a superintendncia dos sistemas de pagamentos. Acompanhei tambm as reas de sistemas e tecnologias de informao, recursos humanos, contabilidade e controlo de gesto, comunicao, planeamento estratgico, tica e conduta e gesto de continuidade de negcio. Desempenhei ainda, por indicao do Banco de Portugal, funes de Administrador da Valora S. A.  empresa do banco responsvel pela produo de notas  e da Sociedade Gestora dos Fundos de Penses do Banco de Portugal. Exerci todas estas funes com total dedicao, empenho e compromisso, tendo sempre em mente o propsito e razo de ser do Banco de Portugal, que  o de contribuir para o bem-estar dos cidados atravs da salvaguarda da estabilidade de preos e da estabilidade financeira. Nesta ocasio, cumpre-me fazer um breve balano dos anos que levo como membro do Conselho de Administrao do Banco de Portugal, focando-me nas reas de responsabilidade que tenho assumido diretamente. Mas, nesta ocasio, importa tambm olhar para alguns dos desafios que, no futuro prximo, exigiro a ateno do Conselho de Administrao do Banco de Portugal, os quais procurarei enunciar de forma sumria. Com referncia ao breve balano do meu primeiro mandato, importa comear por recordar que foram vrias e complexas as exigncias que se colocaram ao Banco de Portugal nos ltimos anos. De entre elas, destaco: i. A reviso do modelo de regulao e superviso do sistema financeiro , designadamente a criao da Unio Bancria; ii. A adoo de medidas no convencionais de poltica monetria pelo Eurosistema, que foram fundamentais para salvar o euro e para garantir o financiamento das economias e dos Estados; iii. A profunda transformao tecnolgica na atividade de intermediao financeira e, em especial, nos sistemas de pagamentos; iv. E, mais recentemente, a pandemia de Covid-19, que trouxe desafios nunca antes testados. Nas reas que acompanhei mais diretamente, e sem ser exaustivo, gostaria de relevar o seguinte: O Banco de Portugal teve uma participao influente e, pontualmente mesmo decisiva, na definio e na implementao de novas medidas de poltica monetria, criadas para responder s crises mais recentes. O Banco esteve na linha da frente na discusso dessas medidas no Conselho do Banco Central Europeu e, no menos importante, nas equipas tcnicas que prepararam as decises dos Governadores. Para alm disso, o Banco assegurou a plena aplicao, em Portugal, destas medidas, suportando o financiamento da economia, das famlias, das empresas e do Estado, em condies extremamente favorveis, nunca antes verificadas. Acompanhei, pessoalmente e com grande proximidade, estes desenvolvimentos, contribuindo na medida das minhas responsabilidades para assegurar um nvel de resposta adequado do Banco de Portugal a to elevada exigncia. Na rea dos pagamentos, o Banco de Portugal tem responsabilidades de regular, fiscalizar e promover o bom funcionamento dos meios e dos sistemas de pagamentos. Nessa qualidade, participou ativamente na transposio da Diretiva de Servios de Pagamento revista (DSP2) e acompanhou a implementao do novo quadro regulamentar, que veio criar novos servios de pagamento e promover a inovao e a segurana na realizao das operaes. O Banco teve ainda a preocupao de estar prximo da inovao tecnolgica, tendo estabelecido um dilogo estruturado com o mercado e com os operadores promotores dessa inovao. Neste mbito, o Banco de Portugal criou o Portugal FinLab, uma plataforma de inovao orientada para facilitar o dilogo entre as autoridades de superviso do setor financeiro e os empreendedores na rea da digitalizao. Tambm revitalizou a Comisso Interbancria para os Sistemas de Pagamentos eo Frum para os Sistemas de Pagamentos, estruturas que integram os participantes do mercado e que visam a promoo de solues de pagamentos seguras, eficientes e inovadoras. Foi, alis, no mbito do Frum para os Sistemas de Pagamentos que foi elaborada a primeira Estratgia Nacional para os Pagamentos de Retalho em Portugal , apresentada em 2020 e cuja implementao concluiremos at ao final de 2022. No domnio da emisso monetria, destaco o lanamento da segunda srie de notas de euro, a Srie Europa. Tratou-se de um projeto estratgico, pela relevncia da introduo de novos elementos de segurana para a confiana pblica nas notas de euro. Assinalo tambm o acordo firmado entre os bancos centrais da ustria, Blgica e Portugal, que permitiu que a Valora S. A., o impressor de notas do Banco de Portugal, duplicasse a sua produo anual de notas de euro e assumisse um papel de destaque no conjunto dos impressores europeus. Ao nvel do funcionamento do Banco, e para dar resposta s novas funes assumidas e s exigncias decorrentes da transformao digital, foram melhorados os modelos de governo e organizao, a par dos processos internos. O quadro normativo e de observncia das regras de tica e de conduta foi reforado e promoveram-se critrios de eficincia e uma cultura de responsabilizao pelos resultados. Na gesto de recursos humanos, apostou-se na formao e no desenvolvimento de competncias dos trabalhadores, tendo sido criada a Academia do Banco de Portugal, que promove a gesto integrada da formao em funo das prioridades estratgicas do Banco. Aps um intenso e frutuoso processo negocial com as estruturas sindicais, foi assinado um novo Acordo de Empresa do Banco de Portugal, mais ajustado aos novos desafios que se colocam ao Banco e aos seus trabalhadores. Na rea das tecnologias e sistemas de informao, foram implementados dois programas estruturantes: um programa de transformao digital  o Banco Digital 2020  e um programa de gesto integrada da informao. As solues colaborativas e de mobilidade adotadas no mbito do programa de transformao digital acabaram, alis, por se revelar cruciais no contexto das medidas de mitigao da pandemia. Em maro de 2020, o Banco conseguiu, em pouco mais de uma semana, transferir 90% dos trabalhadores para teletrabalho e garantir, deste modo, a prestao ininterrupta das suas funes essenciais, mesmo as mais crticas para o funcionamento da nossa economia. Com vista a aumentar a proteo contra ciberataques, foi criado um centro de cibersegurana, que veio igualmente proporcionar uma viso integrada dos incidentes de segurana no setor financeiro nacional. Foi ainda criado um laboratrio de inovao, que tem desenvolvido trabalhos experimentais em resposta a diferentes casos de negcio. Para aumentar a transparncia da atuao, contribuir para uma melhor compreenso dos temas econmicos e financeiros, e fortalecer a ligao  comunidade, foi feita uma profunda reformulao do modelo de comunicao do Banco, com a centralizao, num departamento, de todas as responsabilidades de comunicao externa e interna. Com o propsito de chegar a novos pblicos, o Banco abriu contas nas redes sociais, produziu contedos mais simples e visualmente mais apelativos, e introduziu alteraes s suas publicaes regulares. Este percurso foi recentemente reconhecido pelo Central Banking, que atribuiu ao Banco de Portugal o prmio de melhor banco central na categoria de novas iniciativas de comunicao. Olhando agora para o futuro , teremos que reconhecer que  semelhana dos anteriores, os prximos anos sero seguramente muito desafiantes para o Banco de Portugal, que ter de desempenhar a sua misso de servio pblico num contexto marcado: Pela recuperao gradual da crise de sade pblica e do respetivo impacto econmico, com as incertezas ainda existentes; Pela continuao de um ambiente de taxas de juros muito baixas, embora se perspetive uma recuperao progressiva dos nveis de inflao e das curvas de rendimento; Pelo aumento de riscos no sistema financeiro associados ao impacto econmico da pandemia; Pela evoluo da Unio Econmica e Monetria e do modelo de superviso europeu e nacional; Pelos desafios associados  inovao financeira e tecnolgica e pelos riscos para a estabilidade financeira decorrentes das alteraes climticas; Pelo surgimento de novos servios e de novos operadores financeiros e de pagamentos e pela crescente necessidade de regulao e superviso do setor financeiro no bancrio; Por uma maior exigncia e escrutnio quanto  atuao de instituies pblicas independentes; e Pelo impacto global das alteraes climticas e pelo aumento da consciencializao pblica da necessidade de instituies sustentveis e socialmente responsveis. Centrando-me nas reas que acompanho mais diretamente, e sem ser exaustivo, gostaria de enunciar algumas dimenses de atuao que sero, do ponto de vista estratgico, mais relevantes nos prximos anos. Desde logo,  inquestionvel que as atividades associadas  conduo da poltica monetria continuaro a ter papel preponderante na manuteno de condies de liquidez e de financiamento adequadas ao conjunto dos agentes econmicos. O papel do Banco de Portugal neste domnio tem sido e continuar a ser central para a economia e para o sistema financeiro nacional, atravs da sua atuao influente ao nvel do Eurosistema, como tambm na dimenso nacional. Na rea dos sistemas de pagamentos, merecer especial ateno o projeto do Eurosistema tendente  emisso de uma moeda digital de banco central, que poder levar, como alguns antecipam, a uma transformao monetria global sem precedentes. Para ter capacidade de influenciar o desenho do chamado Euro digital e capacidade de apoiar o sistema financeiro nacional caso o projeto avance, o Banco ter de participar ativamente na fase de investigao, que decorrer at 2023, e na fase da implementao, operacionalizando a infraestrutura que vier a ser disponibilizada. No mbito da emisso e tesouraria, o Banco de Portugal continuar a promover a adoo de medidas para uma utilizao mais eficiente do numerrio e para a reduo do seu impacto ambiental. Perspetiva-se a possibilidade de serem implementadas medidas europeias de arredondamento de pagamentos em numerrio e, consequentemente, de descontinuao da produo e emisso das moedas de 1 e 2 cntimos. Estas medidas, caso sejam aplicadas, concorrero tambm para o aumento da eficincia do ciclo de vida do numerrio no nosso Pas. Em matria de gesto interna,  prioritrio continuar a apostar na inovao aplicada ao negcio e na promoo de uma organizao data driven, impulsionada por uma arquitetura de dados moderna e por solues de inteligncia artificial.  ainda necessrio evoluir para modelos avanados e cada vez mais robustos de cibersegurana e de continuidade de negcio, a partir da experincia vivida nos ltimos anos. Na rea da comunicao e imagem, o Banco dever desenvolver uma linha de atuao consistente e ambiciosa que lhe permita, at 2025, ser melhor compreendido pela sociedade, no que diz respeito s sua misso e funes, e percecionado como mais prximo dos cidados. Para aproximar o Banco da sociedade, ser tambm importante incrementar as iniciativas de responsabilidade social, mantendo como prioridades a incluso pela educao e o apoio s comunidades mais prximas do Banco. A Filial, no Porto, as Delegaes Regionais da Madeira e dos Aores e as nossas Agncias pelo Pas continuaro a ter um papel central no desempenho global do Banco, no s pelo exerccio crescente de funes descentralizadas, como pelo reforo da prestao de servio s comunidades locais, constituindo um contributo efetivo do Banco para a coeso territorial do Pas. As regras de conduta e de tica continuaro a ser aperfeioadas, com a implementao do novo Regime Geral da Preveno da Corrupo e a adoo de um mecanismo interno de proteo das pessoas que denunciam violaes na atuao do banco e dos seus representantes, impondo-se a operacionalizao de canais de denncia eficientes, seguros e fiveis. Por fim, mas no menos importante, a garantia da autonomia financeira do Banco de Portugal dever ser prioridade no mbito da governao e gesto interna, em particular dada a perspetiva de continuao de um ambiente prolongado de taxas de juro baixas ou mesmo negativas. Os principais desafios passaro pela procura de novas fontes de rendimento e pela adoo de um novo modelo de alocao estratgica dos ativos de gesto do banco. Devero ainda ser aperfeioados os instrumentos de projeo e controlo dos resultados financeiros e definido o nvel adequado de buffers financeiros. Em suma, os prximos anos continuaro a ser desafiantes, mas o Banco de Portugal est capacitado para os enfrentar e preparado para, no quadro da sua misso, continuar a apoiar o esforo coletivo de recuperao da economia portuguesa e o projeto de integrao europeia. Antes de concluir, quero deixar um agradecimento pessoal aos trabalhadores do Banco de Portugal, a quem reconheo uma enorme capacidade profissional e um elevado sentido de misso, e que me tm enriquecido, ao longo dos anos, com o seu saber e humanidade. Resta-me, por fim, afirmar que estou motivado para continuar a exercer estas funes com dedicao e com sentido de interesse pblico, e contribuir para o reforo da credibilidade do Banco de Portugal como instituio de referncia na nossa sociedade. Muito obrigado.

Title: Opening speech by the Governor, Mario Centeno, at the Expresso and Banco de Portugal Conference: "The challenges of the Portuguese economy in the post-pandemic"
text: Intervention of opening of the Government... Opening speech by the Governor, Mario Centeno, at the Expresso and Banco de Portugal Conference: "The challenges of the Portuguese economy in the post-pandemic period" 29 nov. 2021 Very good morning. It is with great pleasure that I welcome you to this initiative of Banco de Portugal together with Expresso on the challenges for the Portuguese economy. I hope that this debate between entrepreneurs, academics and policy makers will help to make the challenges of the Portuguese economy well identified and can be better addressed, fostering sustained and inclusive economic growth. The task will not be easy  never will  because now we have added to the digital and climate transitions that we had already begun before 2020, the added difficulties of the "postpandemic". In this context, I identify two structural challenges of the Portuguese economy. First the financial situation of the country, in its public and private dimensions. In all countries the crisis has resulted in an increase in indebtedness. That's a post-pandemic certainty. Public debt in the euro area increased by 13 pp to 90% of GDP. In Portugal, which started from a higher value, increased 19 pp in 2020 to 135%. Thus, in the coming years it is essential to resume the path of reducing the government debt ratio, a challenge mitigated by having already recorded similar values and at that time we showed that we could reduce them  minus 15 pp between 2017 and 2019. This reduction must be supported by a credible fiscal consolidation plan, to which economic growth will contribute, a challenge no less important, to which I will refer below. Although in the short term fiscal policy remains conditioned by the chemical imbalances, and it is desirable that it continue to contribute to the recovery of activity and to the maintenance of the resilience of the labour market, it is essential that it recovers the pre-scenario trajectory. The country has a 2-3 year time window to reverse the increase in permanent spending above the GDP trajectory observed in 2020 and 2021, to ensure debt sustainability and, with this, maintaining investor confidence. This transition should be supported by an efficient use of PRR funds, which have been made available in the lost fund to ensure that the countries with higher debt could achieve digital and climate transitions without being financed from their budgets. To miss this opportunity is to waste the most relevant moment of European integration since the creation of the euro. The decisions of the Eurogroup and the European Council of March and June 2020, which resulted in the first massive issue of European debt, because supranational, are the guarantee that Europe is available, solidary and integrated. On the private side in Portugal, I have to start by highlighting the extraordinary path of reducing the debt of the non-financial private sector as a percentage of GDP. Between 2012 and 2019, it decreased from 267% to 189%. The gap with the euro area, which was 74 pp in 2012, rose to -2pp in 2019; for the first time in many decades the weight of private debt in the economy was lower than that of the euro area. Unfortunately, with the pandemic, private debt has also disrupted this reduction process. However, it should be stressed that this result has contributed mainly to the contraction of the economy and the increase in indebtedness to the resident financial sector. It is clear that both sectors should resume deleveraging initiated in the pre-pandamic period. This will provide the Portuguese economy with the conditions to face future crises under even better conditions than those in which it was in early 2020 and, at the same time, the structural financial conditions will be solidified so that credit markets help to foster productive investment and, with this, the structural growth of the Portuguese economy. This brings me to the second structural challenge of the Portuguese economy. Sustainable and inclusive economic growth. At a time of chemical disuptake, the key element for economic growth is the stability and predictability of national and European public policies. Let's start with the Europeans. Europe found in 2020 the key to making monetary and fiscal policies complementary. No fear of moral hazard between countries, nor of the dominance of one policy by the other. This framework must remain stable, especially when, on the one hand, we resume the Stability and Growth Pact, which should accommodate post-pandemic recovery and, on the other hand, monetary policy will be normalised in the medium term. European funding of next generation EU is an important debate to be held, which will be all the simpler the greater the success of countries in using the funds. And I now resume the Resolution and Resilience Plan in Portugal. European resources must be used to consolidate sustained economic growth, and finance the digital and climate transition, which promote the modernisation of our economy. The implementation of the PRR could contribute in two ways to reducing the government debt ratio. In addition to the structural impact on economic growth, the PRR enables public and private investments without burdening public accounts in the short term. However, in the implementation of the PRR, attention should be paid to the challenges inherent in the very short time window for the use of funds -between 2021 (already finished) and 2026 - and the achievement of intermediate targets. The projects to be financed must be structuring, productive and contribute to financial and environmental sustainability. Public investment should be thought of in order to catalyze private investment. If between 2015 and 2019, Portugal was able to show the world how debt is simultaneously reduced and investment is now increased, with the support of the PRR, this task is much easier. Not getting it would be unforgivable. This is an excellent opportunity to influence how we produce, work and consume, accelerating and incorporating climate and digital transitions. This growth process must also be inclusive and promote the reduction of inequality. We must not forget that, since 2008, the entry into the labour market of the best-prepared generations, perhaps in all Portuguese economic history, has been accompanied by three crises of great magnitude and in succession: the great financial crisis, the sovereign debt crisis and the earthquake crisis. In a scenario of technological and climate transition, inequality will also tend to increase for low-skilled groups and for older and less adapted groups. To mitigate this effect, active labour market policies are of particular importance, in particular to support the professional transition of workers. Fiscal policy, which promoted the reduction of the structural component of taxation between 2016 and 2019 by more than 1pp of GDP, should also monitor and encourage the evolution of the productive structure. The other key to the success of sustained economic growth is schooling. We now have a population with higher schooling. However, this is a project, which we started more than two decades ago, but which is long-term, so it is essential that it is continued to be caressed and put in the foreground. We should invest in people. Only with more training and more years of schooling will we have more prepared generations and with greater mobility. Portugal left the last places. We approached, as never before in 100 years, our European partners. This is true in the pisa test results, where we are close to the OECD average and are one of the few countries that has a track record of improvement in all topics evaluated in this international programme. As it is also in the undergraduate rates of the youngest, either in secondary education or in the completion of degrees. In 2010 we had a secondary and tertiary training differential (degree) of 31 pp with the European Union, only 52% of our young people completed at least secondary education. In 2020, this differential was only 9 pp, making an almost quantum jump to 79%. But we can't stop. In just 10 years we have been in Spain, Italy and Japan. All eastern European countries with whom we sometimes like to compare have more than 90% of their young people with secondary or higher education. And everyone was already with these graduation rates in 2010. This is the real source of our country's structural backwardness. Today, more and higher quality are the human resources that our schools put in the labor market. We are closer to european countries, in some cases even above, but this path is not finished and we cannot let it get in the middle. The capacity to attract qualified human capital is also another key factor for sustained economic growth and should therefore be incorporated into public policies and business decisions. The Portuguese economy has everything to gain from resuming the growth path with convergence with the European Union, which had been registering in the years before this crisis. This trajectory is essential for Portugal to benefit fully from European policies, which must complement national policies. These policies should underpin sustained economic growth, but also on people. Thank you very much. Expresso and Banco de Portugal Conference: The challenges of the Portuguese economy in the post pandemic
text_original: Interveno de abertura do Governad... Interveno de abertura do Governador, Mrio Centeno, na Conferncia Expresso e Banco de Portugal: "Os desafios da economia portuguesa no pspandemia" 29 nov. 2021 Muito bom dia.  com grande prazer que vos dou as boas vindas a esta iniciativa do Banco de Portugal em conjunto com o Expresso sobre os desafios para a economia portuguesa. Espero que este debate entre empresrios, acadmicos e decisores polticos contribua para que os desafios da economia portuguesa sejam bem identificados e possam ser respondidos da melhor forma, fomentando um crescimento econmico sustentado e inclusivo. A tarefa no ser fcil  nunca o  , at porque agora juntamos s transies digitais e climticas que j tnhamos iniciado antes de 2020, as dificuldades acrescidas do pspandemia. Neste contexto identifico dois desafios estruturais da economia portuguesa. Primeiro a situao financeira do pas, nas suas dimenses pblica e privada. Em todos os pases a crise implicou um aumento do endividamento. Essa  uma certeza do ps-pandemia. A dvida pblica na rea do euro aumentou 13 pp, para 90% do PIB. Em Portugal, que partia de um valor mais elevado, aumentou em 2020 19 pp, para 135%. Assim, nos prximos anos  fundamental retomar a trajetria de reduo do rcio da dvida pblica, desafio atenuado por j termos registado valores similares e nessa altura mostrmos que conseguamos reduzi-los  menos 15 pp entre 2017 e 2019. Esta reduo deve ser sustentada por um plano credvel de consolidao oramental, para a qual contribuir o crescimento econmico, desafio no menos importante, a que me referirei de seguida. Embora no curto prazo a poltica oramental continue condicionada pelos desequilbrios pandmicos, sendo desejvel que continue a contribuir para a recuperao da atividade e para a manuteno da resilincia do mercado de trabalho,  fundamental que recupere a trajetria pr-pandmica. O pas tem uma janela temporal de 2 a 3 anos para reverter o aumento da despesa permanente acima da trajetria do PIB observado em 2020 e 2021, para garantir a sustentabilidade da dvida e, com isso, a manuteno da confiana dos investidores. Esta transio deve ser apoiada numa utilizao eficiente dos fundos do PRR, que foram disponibilizados a fundo perdido para garantir que os pases com maior endividamento pudessem concretizar as transies digital e climtica sem que fossem financiadas pelos seus oramentos. Perder esta oportunidade  desperdiar o momento de integrao europeia mais relevante desde a criao do euro. As decises do Eurogrupo e do Conselho Europeu, de maro e junho de 2020, e que resultaram na primeira emisso massiva de dvida europeia, porque supranacional, so a garantia de que a Europa est disponvel, solidria e integrada. Do lado privado em Portugal, tenho que comear por destacar o caminho extraordinrio de reduo da dvida do setor privado no financeiro em percentagem do PIB. Entre 2012 e 2019, reduziu-se de 267% para 189%. O diferencial com a rea do euro, que era de +74 pp em 2012, passou a -2pp em 2019; pela primeira vez em muitas dcadas o peso da dvida privada na economia foi inferior ao da rea do euro. Infelizmente, com a pandemia, tambm a dvida privada interrompeu este processo de reduo. No entanto, sublinhe-se que para este resultado contribuiu maioritariamente a contrao da economia e o aumento do endividamento junto do setor financeiro residente. Torna-se evidente que ambos os setores devem retomar a desalavancagem iniciada no perodo pr-pandmico. Tal proporcionar  economia portuguesa as condies para enfrentar futuras crises em condies ainda melhores do que as em que se encontrava no incio de 2020 e, concomitantemente, solidificar-se-o as condies financeiras estruturais para que os mercados de crdito ajudem a fomentar o investimento produtivo e, com isso, o crescimento estrutural da economia portuguesa. Isto leva-me ao segundo desafio estrutural da economia portuguesa. O crescimento econmico sustentvel e inclusivo. Neste momento de disrupo pandmica, o elemento chave para o crescimento econmico assenta na estabilidade e previsibilidade das polticas pblicas nacionais e europeias. Comecemos pelas europeias. A Europa encontrou em 2020 a chave para tornar as polticas monetria e oramental complementares. Sem receio de risco moral entre os pases, nem de domnio de uma poltica pela outra. Este quadro deve permanecer estvel, ainda mais quando, por um lado, retomamos o Pacto de Estabilidade e Crescimento, que deve acomodar a recuperao ps-pandmica e, por outro lado, se normalizar a mdio-prazo a poltica monetria. O financiamento europeu do Next Generation EU  um importante debate por realizar, que ser tanto mais simples quanto maior o sucesso dos pases na utilizao dos fundos. E retomo agora o Plano de Resoluo e Resilincia em Portugal. Os recursos europeus devem ser utilizados para consolidar o crescimento econmico sustentado, e financiar a transio digital e climtica, que promovam a modernizao da nossa economia. A implementao do PRR poder contribuir de duas formas para a reduo do rcio da dvida pblica. Alm do impacto estrutural no crescimento econmico, o PRR viabiliza investimentos pblicos e privados sem onerar, no curto prazo, as contas pblicas. No entanto, na execuo do PRR, deve ser tomada ateno os desafios inerentes  muito curta janela temporal para utilizao dos fundos -entre 2021 (j terminou) e 2026 -e ao cumprimento das metas intermdias. Os projetos a financiar devem ser estruturantes, produtivos e contribuir para a sustentabilidade financeira e ambiental. O investimento pblico deve ser pensado de forma a catalisar o investimento privado. Se entre 2015 e 2019, Portugal conseguiu mostrar ao mundo como simultaneamente se reduz o endividamento e se aumenta o investimento, agora, com o apoio do PRR, esta tarefa est muito mais facilitada. No o conseguir seria imperdovel. Esta  uma excelente oportunidade para influenciar a forma como produzimos, trabalhamos e consumimos, acelerando e incorporando as transies climtica e digital. Este processo de crescimento deve tambm ser inclusivo e promover a reduo da desigualdade. No nos podemos esquecer que, desde 2008, a entrada no mercado de trabalho das geraes mais bem preparadas, porventura de toda a histria econmica portuguesa, foi acompanhada por trs crises de forte magnitude e em sucesso: a grande crise financeira, a crise de dvida soberana e a crise pandmica. Num cenrio de transio tecnolgica e climtica a desigualdade tambm tender a aumentar para grupos com baixas qualificaes e para os mais velhos e menos adaptados. Para mitigar este efeito, assumem particular importncia as polticas ativas do mercado de trabalho, nomeadamente, de apoio  transio profissional dos trabalhadores. A poltica fiscal, que promoveu a reduo da componente estrutural da fiscalidade entre 2016 e 2019 em mais de 1pp do PIB, deve, tambm, acompanhar e incentivar a evoluo da estrutura produtiva. A outra chave para o sucesso do um crescimento econmico sustentado  a escolaridade. Temos hoje uma populao com mais elevada escolaridade. No entanto, este  um projeto, que inicimos h mais de duas dcadas, mas que  de longo prazo, sendo assim, fundamental que seja continuadamente acarinhado e colocado em primeiro plano. Devemos investir nas pessoas. S com mais formao e mais anos de escolaridade  que teremos geraes mais preparadas e com maior mobilidade. Portugal deixou os ltimos lugares. Aproximmo-nos, como nunca antes em 100 anos tnhamos feito, dos nossos parceiros europeus. Isto  verdade nos resultados dos testes do PISA, onde estamos prximos da mdia da OCDE e somos um dos poucos pases que tem uma trajetria de melhoria em todos os tpicos avaliados neste Programa internacional. Como tambm  nas taxas de graduao dos mais jovens, seja no ensino secundrio seja na concluso de licenciaturas. Em 2010 tnhamos um diferencial de formao secundria e terciria (licenciatura) de 31 pp com a Unio Europeia, apenas 52 % dos nossos jovens cumpria pelo menos o ensino secundrio. Em 2020, esse diferencial foi de apenas 9 pp, dando um salto quase quntico para 79%. Mas no podemos parar. Em apenas 10 anos ultrapssamos a Espanha, a Itlia e o Japo. Todos os pases do Leste Europeu com quem s vezes nos gostamos de comparar tm mais de 90% dos seus jovens com o ensino secundrio ou superior. E todos j estavam com estas taxas de graduao em 2010. Esta  a verdadeira fonte do atraso estrutural do nosso pas. Hoje, so mais e de maior qualidade os recursos humanos que as nossas escolas colocam no mercado de trabalho. Estamos mais perto dos pases europeus, nalguns casos mesmo j acima, mas este caminho no est terminado e no o podemos deixar ficar a meio. A capacidade de atrao de capital humano qualificado  tambm outro dos fatores chave para um crescimento econmico sustentado, devendo assim ser incorporado nas polticas pblicas e nas decises empresariais. A economia portuguesa tem tudo a ganhar em retomar a trajetria de crescimento com convergncia com a Unio Europeia, que vinha registando nos anos anteriores a esta crise pandmica. Esta trajetria  essencial para que Portugal beneficie em pleno das polticas europeias, que devem complementar as polticas nacionais. Polticas essas que devem fundamentar um crescimento econmico sustentado, mas tambm nas pessoas. Muito obrigado. Conferncia Expresso e Banco de Portugal: Os desafios da economia portuguesa no ps pandemia

Title: Interview of Vice Governor Luis Maximo dos Santos to Expresso
text: Louis... Interview of Vice Governor Luis Maximo dos Santos to Expresso 06 Dec. 2021 Will the Resolution Fund (FdR) have to put more money into the Novo Banco? Only capital calls can be determined once the accounts for the 2021 financial year, which are not closed, can be determined. The expectations that the FdR has is that no more calls will be needed, not least because the value at which we find global payments is very close to the european commission's global scenario, which was 3.3 billion. And that's an added factor that reinforces the hope that no more capital calls will be needed. You mean there won't be any new bank loans? The Fund has the resources to be able to honour its commitments. Part of the loan requested [in 2021] has not yet been used, although part of that is for the 112 million that remained outstanding. As of 2022, the Fund is able to generate more revenue than expenditure. It is clear that there are still pending disputes relating to the so-called second arbitration. The FdR has well hopes that favourable decisions will also be able to take favourable decisions in relation to such disputes. Why isn't the arbitral tribunal working on these disputes yet? These courts have some complexity. An arbitrator is appointed by each of the litigants, and each will choose its chairman, and it must be checked for any conflict of interest. It is a process with some slowness, runs under the aegis of the International Chamber of Commerce in Paris, and the expectation is that we can have a decision in this second dispute in late 2022, early 2023. Will this arbitration add several disputes? Yes. The fact that Novo Banco did not want to make use of the more favourable rules of the IFRS 9 transitional regime  those specifically implemented in 2020 because of the pandemic, not the others [already decided, favourably, for the FdR, freeing it from giving 169 million to the Novo Banco]. There is the sale of the bank's branch in Spain and an accounting record relating to the devaluation of Novo Banco's holdings in a set of restructuring funds. In an amount of... The overall amount amounts to 327 million, but the bulk is 162 million, relating to the IFRS issue that has not yet been examined. Disputes cannot be invoked for convenience or lightly. The Fund's decisions were quality decisions. Is it expected that the FdR will repay state loans by 2046? That will be paid no doubt, but we are a distance of 25 years. There are many factors of uncertainty. It remains to be seen what will be the revenue from the sale of the 25% of the FdR in Novo Banco, which revenues will be generated by the stake it has in Oitante. There are aspects that will weigh positively on the Fund's accounts, because a review of interest rates that are favourable to the Fund is planned after five years (early 2022). It is difficult to say with absolute rigour whether the period is enough to pay for everything. What is the estimate of interest savings with the new loan conditions from 2022? The rate drop is quite relevant. In 2020, the FdR paid around 97 million in interest. In 2021, it will pay 92 million. By 2022, you must pay approximately zero. It is an annual savings of more than 90 million for at least five years (fees are reviewed every five years). Banks are asking for a review of contributions to the FdR. I am the first to recognize the effort it means for the banking system Portuguese the contribution it makes to the FdR. There is no doubt. But this turns out to be a benefit for everyone: there is no loss of deposits. There must always be a proposal compatible with European rules. We have not received concrete proposals so far and, moreover, this is a governmental matter. Any proposal that is fair, balanced and compatible with the European order will be considered by the Government, the Fund does not place obstacles. What is needed is for it to be a consistent proposal. There are some ideas, but they have not passed an embryonic phase. How much will the FdR spend on compensation to creditors in bes and banif settlements? Only in the end, when the recognition of who is a common creditor, who is still dependent on insolvency proceedings, will be known. What about the lawsuits? We do not expect it to be too expressive or affect the sustainability of the Fund. Will the FdR exercise the right to prevent the State from holding a shareholder stake in Novo Banco? There is a great misadjustment between the amount at which the preference could be exercised and the amount at which the 25% share itself is recorded in the Fund's accounts. The probability of exercising preference is not high. But this will reduce the Fund's share to 8%... This process is not for now. This is an effectively more disturbing problem, even from the perspective of the financial system. We will see how these credits will be analyzed by the Tax Authority. It is by this legal way that there is a risk that participation will be significantly cut. I do not want to shy away from your question, but you need to know the credits eligible for that purpose. The management of Antonio Ramalho tried to take advantage of the protective shield of the FdR? The FdR did everything in its power in the context of the contract to be honoured by both parties. The FdR has been very vigilant, has been involved in the issue of prizes, in the disputes it has raised. You've done everything knowing that contracts are to be fulfilled. The mechanism was made to clean the bank, inherited a very complicated problem. The minimization of the use of the mechanism, which is an objective, must be compatible with another key objective, which is that Novo Banco progresses. Do you look kindly at Novo Banco buying EuroBic? The Governor has addressed this issue in an entirely correct way: the Novo Banco cannot make acquisitions in this period. In view of the current rules to which it is still subject, it cannot make this acquisition. Then it is all a process involving the European Commission. These aren't FdR decisions. Of the more than 900 decisions that Banco de Portugal (BdP) has taken in misdemeanor proceedings since 2017 resulted in fines of 52 million. Of this amount, 14 million was suspended in its execution, i.e. the targets did not need to pay them, either for lack of priors or for being applied to entities in liquidation. Fines of the remaining 38 million are effective, but only 11 million was paid by the convicts, according to data transmitted to expresso by Luis Maximo dos Santos. That is, 27 million is yet to be paid out. "This does not mean that there is no efficient sanctioning activity," argues the deputy governor of the BdP. "From the universe of processes, small and medium, people conform, resort, resort and lose pay, etc. Then there is a core of lawsuits that weigh heavily on fines, because they were the most severely valued conducts," he summarizes. In particular, ricardo salgado of Banco Espirito Santo is at stake. The former banker has fines of 3.7 million unpaid, but the amount could even rise to 8 million in the case of unfinished proceedings. Another example is Joao Rendeiro, from BPP. On the escape of the latter, the indication is that he will seek compensation from the Portuguese State and that he will give it, even if he has 1.5 million unpaid to the supervisor. Maximus dos Santos declined to comment. I just said, "The facts speak for themselves." The justification of both is that they have the assets seized in the criminal proceedings. These are the most relevant fines, even though half of the of-ordination charges carried out are even on behavioural supervision, i.e. problems in the marketing of products. "Often they are small things, but very important to people: a maximum interest rate that has been exceeded, an account that has not been closed, a transfer that was not made within the legal deadline." Despite the impossibility of all the fines imposed by him are then executed by the court, the deputy governor considers that it is not the supervisor of the bank that is weakened. "I think it weakens us as a community, it's not the BdP. We've seen some things we shouldn't be watching." "The BdP did what it had to do in all of these processes. Take the BES/GES case: if it were not for the convictions of the BdP, what convictions were there so far?" he exemplifies. Most of the contracharges were validated by the courts of first instance, the Relationship, the Constitutional, said. "I am very comfortable, because from the point of view of the processes conducted by the BdP, the results have been extremely positive," said the supervisor's number two. For Maximo dos Santos, "there may be legislative problems that need to be seen" to avoid these cases. "Do not take the speech that there are too many guarantees for the defendants. Now there is abusive use of them, there is no doubt about it," he says, without saying what could change. "We have a duty, everyone, regulators, courts, prosecutors, political power, to organize ourselves so that the objectives of the community are achieved. Of course it's not always easy. I've been through the BPP, the bad BES, I've never been aploutof justicialist spirits, because it's not justice. We want to do justice in the democratic rule of law. What happens is that, unfortunately, sometimes this goal ends up getting lost and that can't happen," he concludes. "If Parliament is dissolutiond, and this being a diploma that had to be in the form of a bill, we will have to wait for the new Parliament. What I would like to make clear is this: whatever the Government, the composition of Parliament, I am sure that the Banking Code (CAB) will not be left behind. It is not because directives are transapplied through it; is because CAB is really necessary. We haven't had a major reform of financial system legislation since 1992." The conviction is of Luis Maximo dos Santos, the deputy governor of Banco de Portugal, who is behind the proposal for new legislation for the banking sector. The dossier went through a public consultation, was presented to the Ministry of Finance in April, but with the fall of the Assembly of the Republic (AR) and consequent end of the Government, will not move forward. Banco de Portugal (BdP) proposed this new Code because the current legislation is "a patchwork absolutely contrary to all good rules of legistics, and has not even been updated in the face of the emergence of the Single Supervisory Mechanism in 2014". For Maximo dos Santos, it is not only the acronym - RGICSF, of The General Regime of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations - that needs to change. "That will not be, I believe, at all in question, because it is a necessity. Whoever is going to set up the next Government will look with all interest to the work that the BdP has done," he believes. "Reforms of things are not done through legislation, but they are often done with it. It is one of those cases where new legislation is absolutely indispensable", considers Maximo dos Santos. What if a next government doesn't consider it essential? "We will have legislation in a crucial sector with a very poor quality, and with very diverse problems." Was there disinterest from the Ministry of Finance? "We have to recognize that it is a complex and ambitious change, and there are priorities, and a lot to do." In the structure of supervision it is also necessary to make changes, particularly with regard to the National Council of Financial Supervisors (CNSF), which brings together the three financial supervisors: Banco de Portugal, CMVM and ASF. "It was created in 2000, had some changes in 2008, 2013, 2015, but that are in detail, with everything that has happened in the meantime, is a body that can be enhanced. It has to be adjusted to the new format, to the new times we are living", he believes. For example, problematiza Maximo dos Santos, the BdP is entitled to two participants, the governor and the member of the administration with the supervision, but does not specify what type of supervision, if prudential, if behavioral, if money laundering, areas that did not exist, with this division, at the time of its constitution. "It is a very important body, but it needs to be reviewed at various levels, depending on the evolution that the financial system has had," he continues, referring, for example, to the work that has been done in promoting financial literacy. Maximo dos Santos was appointed administrator in 2016, rose to deputy governor a year later and has a term until September 2022. About a re-leadership in office, he did not respond, since the competence will be the Government. The lieutenant governor is in favour of a single term, longer, but without renewal, so that the renewal does not depend on a political choice.
text_original: Lus... Entrevista do Vice-Governador Lus Mximo dos Santos ao Expresso 06 dez. 2021 O Fundo de Resoluo (FdR) vai ter de meter mais dinheiro no Novo Banco? S se podem determinar as chamadas de capital uma vez fechadas as contas do exerccio de 2021, que no esto fechadas. As expectativas que o FdR tem  que no venham a ser necessrias mais chamadas, at porque o valor em que nos encontramos de pagamentos globais est muito prximo do cenrio global da Comisso Europeia, que era 3,3 mil milhes. E isso  um fator adicional que refora a esperana de que no sejam precisas mais chamadas de capital. Quer dizer que no haver novos emprstimos da banca? O Fundo tem recursos para poder honrar os seus compromissos. Uma parte do emprstimo pedido [em 2021] no foi ainda usado, embora parte disso seja para os 112 milhes que ficaram pendentes. A partir de 2022, o Fundo est em condies de gerar mais receitas do que despesas.  evidente que ainda h os litgios pendentes relativos  chamada segunda arbitragem. O FdR tem fundadas esperanas de que tambm relativamente a esses litgios possa obter decises favorveis. Porque  que o tribunal arbitral ainda no est a trabalhar nesses litgios? Estes tribunais tm alguma complexidade.  indicado um rbitro por cada um dos litigantes, e cada um escolher o seu presidente, e tem de se verificar se h algum conflito de interesses.  um processo com alguma lentido, corre sob a gide da Cmara de Comrcio Internacional de Paris, e a expectativa  que possamos ter relativamente a este segundo litgio uma deciso no final de 2022, incio de 2023. Esta arbitragem vai agregar vrios diferendos? Sim. O facto de o Novo Banco no ter querido fazer uso das regras mais favorveis do regime transitrio de IFRS 9  as especificamente implementadas em 2020, por causa da pandemia, no as outras [j decididas, favoravelmente, para o FdR, desobrigando-o de dar 169 milhes ao Novo Banco]. H a venda da sucursal do banco em Espanha e um registo contabilstico referente  desvalorizao das participaes do Novo Banco num conjunto de fundos de reestruturao. Num montante de... O montante global ascende a 327 milhes, mas o grosso so 162 milhes, referentes  questo da IFRS que ainda no foi analisada. No se pode invocar litgios por convenincia ou de forma leviana. As decises do Fundo foram decises de qualidade.  expectvel que o FdR reembolse os emprstimos do Estado at 2046? Que iro ser pagos no h dvida, mas estamos a uma distncia de 25 anos. H muitssimos fatores de incerteza. Falta saber qual vai ser a receita da venda dos 25% do FdR no Novo Banco, que receitas vo ser geradas pela participao que tem na Oitante. H aspetos que vo pesar positivamente nas contas do Fundo, porque est prevista uma reviso das taxas de juro que so favorveis ao Fundo, ao fim de cinco anos (incio de 2022).  difcil dizer com rigor absoluto se o perodo  suficiente para pagar tudo. Qual  a estimativa de poupana de juros com as novas condies dos emprstimos, a partir de 2022? A descida da taxa  bastante relevante. Em 2020, o FdR pagou cerca de 97 milhes em juros. Em 2021, vai pagar 92 milhes. Em 2022, deve pagar aproximadamente zero.  uma poupana anual superior a 90 milhes, pelo menos durante cinco anos (as taxas so revistas a cada cinco anos). Os bancos pedem uma reviso das contribuies para o FdR. Sou o primeiro a reconhecer o esforo que significa para o sistema bancrio portugus a contribuio que faz para o FdR. No h dvida nenhuma. Mas isto acaba por ser um benefcio para todos: no haver perda de depsitos. Ter de haver sempre uma proposta compatvel com as regras europeias. No recebemos at agora propostas concretas e, de resto, esta  uma matria governamental. Alguma proposta que seja justa, equilibrada e compatvel com a ordem europeia ser ponderada pelo Governo, o Fundo no coloca obstculos. O que  preciso  que seja uma proposta consistente. H algumas ideias, mas no passaram de uma fase embrionria. Quanto  que o FdR gastar com compensaes a credores nas liquidaes do BES e do Banif? S no final, quando for feito o reconhecimento de quem  credor comum, que ainda est dependente do processo de insolvncia, se saber. E nos processos judiciais? No esperamos que venha a ser muito expressivo ou que afete a sustentabilidade do Fundo. O FdR vai exercer o direito para impedir o Estado de deter uma participao acionista no Novo Banco? H um grande desajustamento entre o valor a que a preferncia podia ser exercida e o valor a que a prpria participao dos 25% est contabilizada nas contas do Fundo. Do universo de processos, pequenos e mdios, as pessoas conformam-se, recorrem, se recorrem e perdem pagam, etc. Depois, h um ncleo de processos que pesam muito nas coimas, porque foram as condutas valoradas com mais gravidade, sintetiza. Sobre a fuga deste ltimo, a indicao  de que pedir uma indemnizao ao Estado portugus e que ir do-la, mesmo tendo 1,5 milhes por pagar ao supervisor. Mximo dos Santos no quis comentar. Apenas disse: Os factos falam por si. A justificao de ambos  que tm os bens arrestados nos processos-crime. Estas so as coimas mais relevantes, ainda que metade das contraordenaes levadas a cabo at sejam sobre superviso comportamental, isto , problemas na comercializao de produtos. Apesar da impossibilidade de todas as coimas por si aplicadas serem depois executadas pela justia, o vice-governador considera que no  o supervisor da banca que sai fragilizado. Acho que nos fragiliza como comunidade, no  o BdP. Temos assistido a algumas coisas a que no deveramos assistir. O BdP fez o que tinha a fazer nestes processos todos.
