Tom e Prncipe, e sobre Recursos Humanos em Macau, que se tem associado  nossa comunidade de Bancos Centrais e que hoje tem participao destacada no programa deste nosso 19 Encontro com a apresentao do Dr. Anselmo Teng a quem aproveito para dar calorosas boas-vindas. Estes Encontros de Lisboa, se, por um lado, servem para discutir e perspectivar a actividade das nossas instituis no domnio da cooperao, tm tambm o objectivo de permitir uma reflexo conjunta sobre a conjuntura econica internacional e os temas que mais fortemente marcaro a agenda das primas reunis anuais das instituis financeiras internacionais, em particular o Fundo Monetrio Internacional. O tema dominante da agenda dessas reunis , como no podia deixar de ser, a crise financeira global. Esta crise, que se chegou a temer que tivesse consequncias to graves e duradouras como a grande depresso dos anos 30, mostra agora alguns sinais de abrandamento. H quem procure aproveitar esse facto para tentar desvalorizar a crise que atravessamos e procurar defender que as regras do jogo e as polticas econicas deveriam voltar a ser o que eram. Refiro-me aos economistas e aos interesses que tendem a desvalorizar o papel dos choque monetrios e, sobretudo, dos choques financeiros. Torna-se conveniente, por isso, sublinhar quatro aspectos: O primeiro,  que os efeitos econicos mais reduzidos da crise sforam possveis graas a nveis de interveno sem precedentes das polticas monetrias e oramentais, acompanhados de uma elevada coordenao internacional. As lis dos anos 30 foram bem aprendidas pelos actuais responsveis. Um segundo aspecto decorre do actual maior peso do Estado na economia quando comparado com o que acontecia no perodo da Grande Depresso, o que contribui para um efeito equilibrador que se reflecte em estabilizadores automticos mais substanciais. Como afirmei aqui o ano passado O Estado surge de novo como o gestor do risco de tima instncia nas economias modernas. Na verdade, a crise veio demonstrar que quer na esfera financeira, quer na esfera real, os mercados no so auto-equilibradores e carecem da interveno plica para voltarem a um equilbrio aceitvel. O terceiro ponto que quero sublinhar, refere-se  dimenso da crise no sector financeiro que foi muito substancial e com relevantes consequncias futuras. Entre 1980 e 2007 os activos financeiros totais (acs, obrigas e depitos) quadruplicaram em percentagem do PIB mundial. Em 2008 caram quase 9 %, ou seja, cerca de 16 trilis de dares americanos. A este nero haver que juntar uma quebra de cerca de 3 trilis do valor dos activos imobilirios para se ter uma ideia da perda de riqueza por parte dos agentes econicos que procuraro repla, total ou parcialmente, poupando mais e consumindo menos. Estamos perante o maior declnio de riqueza registado durante um ano. Ao nvel do mercado de acs a quebra foi ainda maior, com uma perda de valor de cerca de 29 trilis de dares americanos de Janeiro de 2008 a Junho deste ano, no conjunto das bolsas mundiais. Em 2008 as bolsas registaram a maior queda anual desde a Grande Depresso. Foi sobretudo o aumento dos depitos e da dvida plica que contribuiu para tornar inferior a reduo do total de activos financeiros mundiais. Por outro lado, os fluxos financeiros trans-fronteirios, (de investimento directo, de carteira, emprstimos e depitos) diminuram em 2008 em 82 por cento, de cerca de 11 para cerca de apenas 2 trilis. O maior contributo para esta diminuio proveio sobretudo dos emprstimos bancrios. Esta fortssima reduo provocou ineras crises de liquidez e tenss cambiais em muitos pontos do globo. Todos estes neros revelam a extraordinria dimenso da crise financeira que provocou enormes deslocas na economia mundial. O futuro da globalizao financeira ficou abalado e  agora incerto se e quando se voltar a neros semelhantes aos anteriores  crise. Uma coisa parece certa: o sector financeiro nas economias desenvolvidas sofreu uma reduo relativamente ao PIB e no voltar, to cedo pelo menos, a crescimentos semelhantes aos das timas dcadas, porque as autoridades parecem agora apostadas em conter e domar os excessos financeiros que, periodicamente, geram graves crises econicas. Finalmente, o quarto ponto que queria destacar, para opor aos que procuram desvalorizar a importncia da crise, refere-se ao facto de se poder dizer que a crise ainda no acabou. Na verdade, existem ainda uma grande incerteza quanto  profundidade e sustentabilidade de uma retoma global, o que tem levado alguns analistas a prever que esta possa ser mais lenta do que seria desejvel. Vrios factores contribuem para fundamentar esse receio, acima de tudo nos pases desenvolvidos. A reposio da posio lquida de balano dos agentes econicos, que leva os particulares a poupar mais, contribui, juntamente com a incerteza quanto ao futuro, para o crescimento contido do consumo. Este ser tambm afectado pelo aumento do desemprego que continuar at ao final do primo ano. Por sua vez, o hiato de produto negativo e o baixo grau de utilizao da capacidade produtiva instalada, desencorajam a dinmica do investimento. O pequeno ciclo de variao de existncias que animou a produo industrial nos timos meses chegou o fim e deixar de animar a procura. A oferta de crdito poder continuar contida dada a fraqueza do balano dos bancos e a necessidade de continuar a aumentar o seu capital para fazer face a perdas ainda no registadas. Por outro lado, os elevados estmulos oramentais contriburam para aumentar os dfices oramentais e fazer subir para patamares preocupantes o nvel de dvida plica num grande nero de pases, o que condicionar fortemente a margem de manobra da poltica oramental nesses pases nos anos mais primos. Alis um dos riscos para o crescimento resulta precisamente de uma possvel retirada prematura de qualquer estmulo oramental com incio de esforos significativos de consolidao oramental que, embora necessrios em vrios pases, no devero comear antes de 2011, como referi em Janeiro passado e foi recentemente afirmado pela Comisso Europeia. Os mesmos riscos de retirada das medidas excepcionais de apoio  economia poderiam, alis, ocorrer no domnio da poltica monetria. Com efeito, os bancos centrais reagiram procurando aliviar as restris sobre a capacidade de financiamento do sistema financeiro atravs de avultadas injecs de liquidez, descidas significativas das taxas de juros e acs menos convencionais como, por exemplo, o alargamento do colateral e das contrapartes elegveis, o que contribuiu para elevar o peso dos bancos centrais na intermediao financeira e para o aumento significativo dos seus balanos e da base monetria que, por exemplo, subiu quase 100% no caso americano e cerca de 40% na rea do euro, desde o incio da crise. H quem veja nisto uma ameaa ou uma certeza de inflao futura e se preocupe com a sada desta situao monetria. H que recordar, no entanto, que apesar do crescimento da base monetria, da responsabilidade dos bancos centrais, o crescimento do crdito e da massa monetria tm vindo a reduzir-se substancialmente. Na rea do euro, em Julho o agregado M3 estava a crescer apenas 3% e o crdito a empresas e particulares somente 1.8%. A explicao reside em que h uma quebra da procura de crdito e as dificuldades de balano e de capital dos bancos contribuem para reduzir muito o multiplicador monetrio e de crdito. Para alm disso, importa sublinhar que, sobretudo na rea do euro, a retirada das medidas excepcionais de apoio  liquidez  fcil de fazer e encontra-se tecnicamente preparada para execuo no momento adequado. Por enquanto, as previss de inflao revelam valores para 2009 e 2010 muito abaixo da definio de estabilidade de preos que adoptamos na rea do euro e, sobretudo, as expectativas de mdio e longo prazo para a inflao encontram-se bem ancoradas nos limites daquela nossa definio. Para isso contribui sem dida a credibilidade do Eurosistema e o facto do hiato de produto negativo, o baixo grau de utilizao da capacidade produtiva e a moderao salarial que se verifica, colocarem a economia europeia muito longe de uma situao de sobreaquecimento que pudesse reacender tenss inflacionistas. Em suma, a sada da crise de crescimento econica ser lenta e prolongada Apesar de ser prematuro falar do fim da crise, os indicadores estatsticos divulgados nas timas semanas revelam que,  escala mundial, o crescimento econico voltou a apresentar valores positivos, se no face aos nveis do ano anterior, pelo menos em relao aos trimestres precedentes. Esta recuperao apresenta ainda a caracterstica de ser generalizada, isto , de ser tendencialmente simultnea e abranger quer as economias mais desenvolvidas, quer as economias emergentes e em desenvolvimento. Esta evoluo no evitar, no entanto, que para o ano de 2009 e para a economia mundial como um todo, a taxa de variao real venha a ser negativa. No entanto este valor negativo  essencialmente o resultado da profunda contraco verificada no primeiro trimestre do ano, pois, como referimos atrs, a partir da, a generalidade das economias apresentaram sinais positivos de recuperao, reagindo aos fortes estmulos monetrios e fiscais implementados pelas respectivas autoridades. Igualmente o comrcio internacional, que apresentar uma contraco sem precedentes em 2009, poder j evidenciar uma recuperao em 2010, embora a um ritmo muito inferior ao que vinha sucedendo nos anos anteriores  crise. As economias emergentes e em desenvolvimento conseguiro no seu conjunto apresentar uma variao positiva do produto em 2009 (ao contrrio do que suceder nas economias desenvolvidas). Naturalmente que dentre estas, haver pases que, ou por dependerem fortemente do petreo ou por terem sofrido especialmente os efeitos do colapso do comrcio mundial ou dos seus sistemas bancrios, apresentaro ainda contracs em 2009 e recuperas mais modestas em 2010. As economias africanas registaram na presente crise um desempenho digno de realce. De certa forma pode dizer-se que, em vrios pases desta regio, a crise chegou antes do colapso internacional provocada pelo mercado do sub-prime, pois os aumentos de preos dos bens alimentares e dos combustveis verificados logo no incio de 2007 geraram tenss econicas e sociais nos pases importadores lquidos de bens alimentares e energticos que nem a boa performance do crescimento do produto interno bruto (mdia anual de 6% em termos reais para o perodo 2004-08) conseguiu amenizar. No entanto as consequncias mais srias esto agora a ser experimentadas pois a abrupta reduo do preo de bens primrios (de que vrios pases africanos so exportadores lquidos), a par da contraco macia do comrcio internacional, da reduo dos fluxos de investimento estrangeiro e das remessas de emigrantes ir provocar uma desacelerao marcante do crescimento do produto em 2009, o qual poder mesmo registar varias negativas nalguns pases africanos, nomeadamente nos mais fortemente dependentes da explorao de bens energticos. As perspectivas de recuperao destas economias para 2010 dependem criticamente do comportamento da economia mundial e, nomeadamente, da recuperao do comrcio internacional para patamares semelhantes aos que se verificavam antes da crise. Os sinais transmitidos pelos dados estatsticos referentes ao final do 2 e ao presente trimestre permitem alimentar a esperana que j em 2010 a economia mundial e, mais particularmente, todos os pases africanos possam apresentar um ritmo de crescimento mais compatvel com as potencialidades econicas e as necessidades sociais da regio. O crescimento econico previsto para frica como um todo em 2010 surge assim mais em consonncia com os nveis observados at 2008, representando portanto uma clara recuperao face  muito modesta variao que se estima que venha a ser registada em 2009, apesar de tudo positiva. No menos importante  a expectativa que essa dinmica de crescimento em 2010 se estenda  generalidade dos pases e subregis do continente. No que respeita  economia portuguesa, importa referir que tambm se verifica uma melhoria da situao relativamente s previss de h alguns meses atrs. Na tima previso publicada pelo Banco de Portugal, em Abril passado, previamos uma recesso de -3.5% este ano e uma crescimento negativo de -0.6% n primo ano. Neste momento, as perspectivas apontam para uma recesso inferior este ano e uma crescimento ligeiramente positivo em 2010. O desempenho da economia portuguesa dever, assim, ser um pouco superior ao previsto para a rea do euro. Para alm das medidas j tomadas de conteno dos efeitos da crise,  de fundamental importncia criar as condis para prevenir, no futuro, novas crises desta natureza. Nessa medida devero acentuarse os esforos para criar um enquadramento de regulao e superviso mais resistente e que evite a reemergncia das fragilidades que estiveram na origem do eclodir da presente crise. Este esforo sser verdadeiramente coroado de xito se houver uma profunda coordenao a nvel internacional e, nessa medida, o papel das instituis financeiras internacionais  fundamental. A crise financeira veio revelar ineras vulnerabilidades no funcionamento do sistema financeiro internacional, que o forte crescimento dos anos que a precederam contribuiu para camuflar. O optimismo associado ao elevado crescimento econico e a manuteno prolongada de taxas de juro a um nvel historicamente baixo incentivaram os investidores a procurar aplicas financeiras mais rentveis e com um maior grau de risco. A complexidade dos novos instrumentos financeiros, baseados em estruturas de titularizao particularmente opacas, contribuiu para disfarar o facto de o risco inerente estar mais concentrado do que inicialmente se suponha. Por outro lado, a segmentao da regulamentao financeira e a desregulamentao que se verificou em alguns pases, nomeadamente nos Estados Unidos, contribuiu para a expanso do sector financeiro no regulamentado (que inclui bancos de investimento, fundos de investimento, hedge funds etc.), deixando de fora do universo de regulao e superviso os segmentos de mercado com maior risco e que revelaram possuir um impacto sistmico muito maior do que se pensava anteriormente. Se a crise nos mostra fragilidades no sistema e nos dogmas que assumamos como certos, tambm cria a oportunidade de reflectirmos sobre uma nova ordem e novos princpios que devero existir no futuro. Este facto  particularmente notio nesta crise e, ap as intervens com o objectivo de resolver os problemas imediatos da crise financeira, vrias tm sido as iniciativas que demonstram a preocupao da comunidade internacional, quer ao nvel do G-20, da Unio Europeia, ou das organizas internacionais, em tomar medidas orientadas para uma reforma do sistema financeiro internacional e para minimizar a hipese de emergncia de crises futuras, pelo menos com as caractersticas que esta assumiu. As orientas aprovadas na tima reunio dos G20 so significativas nesta perspectiva e incluem: a regulao do chamado sistema bancrio sombra; a imposio de um rcio mximo de alavancagem entre os capitais prrios dos bancos e o total do balano sem qualquer ponderao pelo risco; a reduo do caracter prciclico da regulao do capital e das regras contabilisticas; a transferncia para mercados organizados dos derivados de crdito como os CDSs; a correco dos incentivos errados na remunerao de grestores e traders. As caractersticas mais marcantes desta actuao so, por um lado o seu elevado grau de coordenao  o que  normal tratando-se de uma crise global  mas tambm o reconhecimento do papel que as organizas internacionais, nomeadamente o FMI, devero assumir na sua preveno e resoluo e na arquitectura de um novo sistema financeiro internacional. Importa aqui relembrar que este papel nem sempre foi reconhecido em crises anteriores. Com efeito, a actuao do FMI nas crises financeiras dos anos 90 foi frequentemente criticada com o argumento que os grandes pacotes financeiros que a caracterizaram poderiam dar origem a moral hazard (i.e. incentivos adversos tanto por parte de pases devedores como dos credores internacionais, podendo inclusivamente contribuir para o agravamento dos efeitos da crise) e que o leque de facilidades financeiras de que dispunha ser pouco orientado para resolver crises com origem na balana de capitais, que passaram a ser mais relevantes a partir de ento. Assim, com o seu papel redefinido, so vrias as reformas em discusso no FMI que visam tornar a instituio mais adequada  preveno e resoluo de crises financeiras. Estas reformas abrangem a totalidade das reas da sua actuao: os recursos financeiros de que disp, a governao, as facilidades financeiras de apoio  crise e a vigilncia do sistema monetrio e financeiro internacional. Com efeito, a deciso dos pases do G-20, na Cimeira de Abril, em Londres, confirmada agora em Pittsburg, de aumentar os recursos disponveis para o FMI em 750 mil milhs de dares, constitui uma indicao do papel que a instituio dever assumir na resoluo da crise. As reformas em curso no mbito da governao (que abrangem a antecipao por dois anos da reviso prevista das quotas, a configurao do Conselho Executivo, a eventual transformao do IMFC num go mais activo e com poder de deciso), contribuem para aumentar a voz e representao dos pases emergentes e de baixo rendimento, e permitiro tornar a organizao mais representativa ao nvel da economia global e, consequentemente, mais eficaz. No mbito das facilidades de financiamento do FMI, vrias iniciativas traduzem claramente uma preocupao em tornar as facilidades financeiras do Fundo mais orientadas para os problemas e circunstncias individuais dos pases membros. Isso mesmo se reflecte nas iniciativas de aumentar o acesso dos pases membros aos recursos do Fundo, de flexibilizar esse acesso, por exemplo, atravs da nova Flexible Credit Line que substituiu a necessidade de condicionalidade ex post por critrios de elegibilidade ex ante, ou na de redefinir a condicionalidade e eliminar alguns elementos que podero contribuir para o estigma por vezes associado aos programas do Fundo, como por exemplo a eliminao de critrios de performance estrutural, cuja no observncia teria de implicar um abdicar formal do critrio ou o no cumprimento do programa do FMI. A disponibilizao de um montante mais elevado de recursos e a reforma das facilidades destinadas a apoiar os pases de baixo rendimento, particularmente vulnerveis  crise financeira, tambm reflectem esta preocupao. Este facto  ilustrado pela consolidao no Poverty Reduction and Growth Trust dos diversos trusts anteriormente existentes, no mbito do qual so criadas trs novas facilidades: a Extended Credit Facility, a Standby Credit Facility e a Rapid Gredit Facility, que substituem os instrumentos anteriormente existentes No que respeita  vigilncia do sistema financeiro internacional, as reformas em curso so no sentido de conferir uma maior nfase  vigilncia macro-prudencial e multilateral. Pretende-se com estas reformas integrar melhor a anlise de polticas macroeconicas com a dos sistemas financeiros, bem como entre a vigilncia bilateral e multilateral, procurando deste modo melhor identificar riscos, problemas de contgio e spillovers que estiveram na origem da actual crise. Embora ainda seja prematuro qualquer comentrio quanto  eficcia de todas estas reformas, elas traduzem um esforo no sentido de responder  maioria dos problemas identificados como as causas da actual crise financeira e parecem revelar da parte da comunidade internacional uma indita vontade de cooperao. Esta vontade vai ser posta  prova nos primos tempos em relao a um problema fundamental ainda no resolvido, o dos chamados desequilbrios macroeconicos globais. A existncia de vrios pases com enormes dfices externos em contraponto com outros que apresentam significativos excedentes no permitir um crescimento equilibrado da economia mundial e pode facilmente originar novas crises no futuro. A coordenao de polticas de ajustamento que resolvam este problema vai exigir um grau de cooperao internacional que no tem precedente histico. A nova realidade geopoltica que resulta da consagrao do G20 como principal orgo da governao mundial, constitui um factor positivo. Esperemos apenas que a lucidez dos dirigentes mundiais esteja  altura das suas responsabilidades. Lisboa 29 de Setembro de 2009

Title: Speech by Professor Vitor Gaspar at the Public Policy Forum 2014 - ISCTE
text: PUBLIC POLICY FORUM 2014 EVALUATE THE PRESENT AND BUILD THE FUTURE: PUBLIC POLICIES FOR THE POST MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING. CONTRIBUTION OF ViTOR GASPAR TO THE PANEL "BUDGETARY POLICY", 19 MARCH 2014, 10.00-12.30h. Very good morning! The Public Policy Forum is an iscte initiative. It was launched two years ago, on the occasion of the celebration of the Institute's 40th anniversary. The Public Policy Forum is a space for debate on political choices with great relevance to Portugal. It is an initiative of great importance to allow the deepening of information and analysis that serve as the basis for public debate in Portugal. Only from a well-informed and participated public debate will it be possible to generate politically the choices that best serve the interests of the country. That is why I want to thank Maria de Lurdes Rodrigues and Pedro Adao e Silva for the initiative and have been kind enough to invite me to participate in the Public Policy Forum 2014. The theme of this panel is Fiscal Policy. It's about assessing the present and building the future. There are a number of reasons why I will focus on the second part: building the future. I take this opportunity to greet my predecessors: I worked with Antonio Bagao Felix at Banco de Portugal, with Manuela Ferreira Leite at Banco de Portugal and in the Ministry of Finance and with Fernando Teixeira dos Santos I collaborated in various instances of the European Union. Before entering the substance I am pleased to announce clearly that the positions I will defend are my sole responsibility and do not necessarily reflect the positions of any organization with which I am associated. My presentation is structured around three questions: 1. What future? 2. What are the minimum elements of a fiscal union for the euro area? 3. How to ensure the fundamentals of national public credit? And then I'll finish. 1. What future? At the end of the 19th century, after the bankruptcy of 1892, the great Joaquim Pedro Oliveira Martins wrote: "It seems to me that the third moment when, in the course of two and a half centuries, the Portuguese nation is faced with a vital question. Are there or are there not enough resources, intellectual, moral, especially economic to subsist as an autonomous people within the Portuguese borders?" The first of these moments was 1640. The second was associated with the loss of brazil's gold revenues. The third, experienced by Oliveira Martins, was motivated by the crisis that culminated in Portugal's participation in the gold standard and in the process of expansion of global capitalism. The crisis that Oliveira Martins starred as Minister of Finance was dramatically marked by the refusal by the President of the Council of Ministers, Dias Ferreira, of the agreement with creditors that had been achieved after months of negotiation. In my view, the inability to develop in Portugal in the 19th century, the institutions that would ensure the sustainability of public finances, the competent management of public debt, development and financial stability play a prominent role in understanding the economic backwardness Portuguese from a historical perspective. Title i withdraw from an important book by Jaime Reis. More recently, in recent decades, Portugal has suffered repeated budgetary and financial crises. Since the 1970s, Portugal has had to resort three times to stabilization programs involving the International Monetary Fund. Since we participated in the euro area, according to the latest statistical series available, the general government deficit has always been above the three per cent of GDP threshold , defined as the threshold for an excessive budget deficit. We have never, during this period, been able to achieve a balanced budgetary position as prescribed in the Stability and Growth Pact. Since 2000 Portugal has experienced a situation of mediocre growth that has led to constant political and social pressure for the increase in social expenditure. In the decade before the global crisis, Portugal (with Italy) was at the tail of the euro area in terms of economic growth. Then returning to the future: what are the fundamental issues? For me there are two fundamental questions: First, and to paraphrase Oliveira Martins: is Portugal able to ensure its future prosperity as a full member of the euro area and the European Union? Do we have the capabilities and willto ensure that political institutions and incentives are aligned with the requirements for participation in monetary union? Second, more generally, is Portugal able to seek its prosperity in the global economy, while avoiding the recurrence of crises? The parallel with Oliveira Martins shows that these are fundamental and lasting issues that portugal is placed as a political society. These are fundamental political problems. Portugal is one of other European countries facing these kinds of issues. It is not an isolated case: but it is our case! There are also problems that arise in the political context defined by European integration and globalisation. The key political issues for Portugal are part of the development of a systemic solution for the euro area as a whole. Key issues have broad implications  national, European and global. The answers will have to be equally broad. The mandate on this panel is restricted to budgetary policy. This should not, however, prevent the fundamental importance of structural policies from being highlighted. Policies that ensure openness and integration in Europe and the world, strengthen competition and weaken demand for rents, ensure flexibility in product and labour markets and, in general, create the conditions for the effective functioning of a social market economy. In addition, there are central problems at European level. It would highlight the problem of unemployment, youth unemployment and long-term unemployment. Europe is characterised by the great importance of social policies. The solution to the problem of unemployment in Europe is not only a social imperative but an issue where europe's own identity is what is at stake. Multiple initiatives have been taken but the importance and urgency of the problem recommend political priority. 2. What are the minimum elements of fiscal union necessary for the stability of the euro area? In September last year I was asked to comment on this question at a Conference in Paris by the International Monetary Fund and the French Ministry of Finance. My answer was that the necessary elements are as follows: (i) a set of budgetary rules and procedures ensuring the sustainability of public finances, ensuring public credit and contributing to financial stability; (ii) the supra-national mechanisms and funds necessary to sustain the banking union and, more generally, the financial union. About the first element I will talk about Portugal below. I now want to briefly justify the second. I have argued since the mid-1990s that the dynamics of macroeconomic adjustment in the euro area have been dominated by financial factors. Theoretical literature and empirical evidence show that financial integration is the mechanism that most contributes (potentially) to the absorption of territorially concentrated economic shocks. In the global crisis and the euro area the adjustment costs were greatly increased by the financial fragmentation that accompanied the crisis. This fragmentation stemmed largely from the perverse cycle consisting of the interdependence between bank risk and sovereign risk. Portugal is an excellent example of how these mechanisms work: it first had a prolonged period of credit-financed expenditure growth and then a sudden and brutal worsening of financing conditions. The process culminated in a sudden breakdown in access to international private funding in the spring of 2010. The identification of the minimum elements involves moving towards the banking union and extending the concept to that of a genuine and comprehensive financial union, based on the single market programme. This programme has some budgetary assumptions. Specifically, systemic stability is dependent on effective collective action mechanisms. The design of these mechanisms involves the contributions of the banking system itself. Its most relevant dimensions are the bank resolution mechanism (and fund) and the deposit guarantee mechanism. In both cases the need for collective financial support mechanisms is crucial to ensure the stability and exclude the occurrence of perverse balances  perhaps in panic situations. A system of institutions can only be considered complete when it is robust and resilient. This is when it decreases and limits the possibility of crises and when it effectively contains their effects. 3. How to manage national public finances? Since June 2012, great progress has been made in European economic and monetary integration. In the macroeconomic and budgetary area are in force the so-called "six pack" and "two pack". The result is a strengthened set of procedures at European level. For countries such as Portugal, which have benefited from official funding, the procedures that apply are strengthened. As has been widely commented in Portugal the pressure for adjustment and to reduce the debt burden will have to persist for decades. All this is true and all this is important. However, that is not the point I want to highlight. For me the fundamental innovation in budgetary matters is the Treaty on Stability, Coordination and Governance (Fiscal Compact). The Treaty, in terms of rules and benchmarks, reproduces the contents of the six pack. But then what's new? The novelty is fundamental: the Treaty states that the agreed rules and procedures must be translated into the internal legal order of each Member State. National institutions must adapt to the requirements of the rules. This point is fundamental. Why? In my opinion, politics in Europe is marked by a basic fact: the primacy of the national dimension of politics. This is of course particularly central in the area of budgetary policy. The role of parliaments in budgetary policy is of great importance. The need for quality information and analysis is also felt mainly at national level. It is curious that in Portugal there was a repeated failure to comply with euro area budgetary rules during the first decade of monetary union. However, today the debate is much more intense because these issues have become internally political lysalient. Only with an in-depth and conscious debate will it be possible to solve a problem with this degree of difficulty and depth. The issue is not the design or content of the rules. All this is well known. The issue is effectiveness in implementation and conviction in the choice of regime. Returning to Oliveira Martins  in speech in Parliament in February 1893  the writer states that as Minister of Finance he promoted an agreement with creditors. He said, as justification: "I believe that until we can adopt a system that is equally accepted by the creditor and debtor, a system that gives mutual satisfaction, we will always live a bitter life." As I have already mentioned above, this position was not shared by the President of the Council who rejected the arrangement. According to Oliveira Martins, Dias Ferreira's position was enough to declare that it was not paid. This position was defended on the grounds that there was no fear of coming to the Tagus (as happened in Alexandria). But for Oliveira Martins, this is a false question. He says: "It was not an armed intervention that I feared; what I feared were the economic results of the lack of a covenant, a covenant that was a sine qua non condition of obtaining for Portugal a sufficient sum of gold to establish confidence and to settle the crisis." This argument by Oliveira Martins is similar to that used by Alexander Hamilton when he deals with the fundamentals of public credit in the newly formed American administration. Hamilton's arguments are available in the First Public Credit Report of January 1790. Alexander Hamilton's experience as the first U.S. treasury secretary has been the subject of my investigation in recent months. Conclusion It seems appropriate to conclude with a quote from Alexander Hamilton (the translation is mine): "Whoever considers the nature of the Government with discernment will find that despite obstacles and delays they are in the adoption of good policies; it is true that once adopted they will probably be stable and permanent. It's much harder to undo than to do." This is a message that deserves to be revisited in Europe today. It is a message that applies - here and now - to Portugal.
text_original: FORUM DAS POLTICAS PBLICAS 2014 AVALIAR O PRESENTE E CONSTRUIR O FUTURO: POLTICAS PBLICAS PARA O PS MEMORANDO DE ENTENDIMENTO. CONTRIBUIO DE VTOR GASPAR PARA O PAINEL POLTICA ORAMENTAL, 19 DE MARO DE 2014, 10.00-12.30h. Muito bom dia! O Frum das Polticas Pblicas  uma iniciativa do ISCTE. Foi lanado h dois anos, por ocasio da celebrao dos quarenta anos do Instituto. O Frum das Polticas Pblicas constitui um espao de debate sobre escolhas polticas com grande relevncia para Portugal.  uma iniciativa de grande importncia para permitir o aprofundamento da informao e anlise que servem de base ao debate pblico em Portugal. S de um debate pblico bem informado e participado ser possvel gerar politicamente as escolhas que melhor servem os interesses do pas.  por isso que quero agradecer  Maria de Lurdes Rodrigues e ao Pedro Ado e Silva a iniciativa e o terem tido a amabilidade de me convidar para participar no Frum das Polticas Pblicas de 2014. O tema deste painel  Poltica Oramental. Trata-se de avaliar o presente e construir o futuro. Existem inmeras razes pelas quais me irei concentrar na segunda parte: construir o futuro. Aproveito para cumprimentar os meus predecessores: trabalhei com Antnio Bago Flix no Banco de Portugal, com Manuela Ferreira Leite no Banco de Portugal e no Ministrio das Finanas e com Fernando Teixeira dos Santos colaborei em vrias instncias da Unio Europeia. Antes de entrar na substncia tenho o prazer de anunciar com clareza que as posies que vou defender so da minha exclusiva responsabilidade e no refletem necessariamente as posies de quaisquer organizao com que eu esteja associado. A minha apresentao est estruturada em torno de trs questes: 1. Que futuro? 2. Quais os elementos mnimos de uma unio oramental para a rea do euro? 3. Como assegurar os fundamentos do crdito pblico nacional? E, de seguida, concluirei. 1. Que futuro? No final do sculo XIX, aps a bancarrota de 1892, o grande Joaquim Pedro Oliveira Martins escrevia: Parece-me chegado o terceiro momento em que, no decurso de dois sculos e meio, a nao portuguesa se encontra perante uma interrogao vital. H ou no h recursos bastantes, intelectuais, morais, sobretudo econmicos para subsistir como povo autnomo dentro das fronteiras portuguesas? O primeiro destes momentos foi 1640. O segundo esteve associado  perda das receitas do ouro do Brasil. O terceiro, vivido por Oliveira Martins, foi motivado pela crise que culminou na participao de Portugal no padro ouro e no processo de expanso do capitalismo global. A crise que Oliveira Martins protagonizou como Ministro das Finanas foi dramaticamente marcada pela recusa, por parte do Presidente do Conselho de Ministros, Dias Ferreira, do acordo com os credores que tinha sido conseguido aps meses de negociao. Em meu entender a incapacidade de desenvolver em Portugal, no sculo XIX, as instituies que assegurariam a sustentabilidade das finanas pblicas, a gesto competente da dvida pblica, o desenvolvimento e a estabilidade financeira tem um papel destacado para a compreenso do atraso econmico portugus em perspetiva histrica. Ttulo que retiro de um importante livro de Jaime Reis. Mais recentemente, nas ltimas dcadas, Portugal sofreu repetidas crises oramentais e financeiras. Desde a dcada de 1970, Portugal teve de recorrer por trs vezes a programas de estabilizao envolvendo o Fundo Monetrio Internacional. Desde que participamos na rea do euro de acordo com as ltima sries estatsticas disponveis  o dfice das administraes pblicas esteve sempre acima do limite de trs por cento do PIB  definido como o limiar de um dfice oramental excessivo. Nunca, durante este perodo, conseguimos atingir uma posio oramental equilibrada como prescrito no Pacto de Estabilidade e Crescimento. Desde o ano 2000 Portugal tem vivido uma situao de crescimento medocre que conduziu a uma presso poltica e social constante para o aumento das despesas sociais. Na dcada anterior  crise global, Portugal (com a Itlia) esteve na cauda da rea do euro em termos de crescimento econmico. Voltando ento ao futuro: quais so as questes fundamentais? Para mim so duas as questes fundamentais: Primeira, e parafraseando Oliveira Martins: tem Portugal condies para assegurar a sua prosperidade futura como membro pleno da rea do euro e da Unio Europeia? Temos capacidades e vontade de assegurar que as instituies e os incentivos polticos so alinhados com as exigncias de participao na unio monetria? Segunda, mais geral, tem Portugal condies para buscar a sua prosperidade, na economia global, ao mesmo tempo que evita a recorrncia de crises? O paralelo com Oliveira Martins mostra que se trata de questes fundamentais e duradouras que se colocam a Portugal como sociedade poltica. So problemas polticos fundamentais. Portugal  um entre outros pases europeus que enfrentam este tipo de questes. No  um caso isolado: mas  o nosso caso! So ainda problemas que se colocam no contexto poltico definido pela integrao europeia e pela globalizao. As questes polticas fundamentais para Portugal enquadram-se no contexto do desenvolvimento de uma soluo sistmica para a rea do euro no seu conjunto. As questes fundamentais tm implicaes vastas  nacionais, europeia e globais. As respostas tero de ser igualmente amplas. O mandato neste painel est restrito  poltica oramental. Este ponto no dever, no entanto, impedir destacar a importncia fundamental das polticas estruturais. Polticas que assegurem a abertura e a integrao na Europa e no mundo, reforcem a concorrncia e penalizem a procura de rendas, garantam a flexibilidade dos mercados do produto e do trabalho e, em geral, criem as condies para o funcionamento eficaz de uma economia social de mercado. Existem, para alm disso, problemas centrais a nvel europeu. Destacaria o problema do desemprego, do desemprego jovem e do desemprego de longa durao. A Europa  caracterizada por uma grande importncia das polticas sociais. A soluo para o problema do desemprego na Europa  no s um imperativo social mas uma questo em que o que est em causa  a prpria identidade da Europa. Tm sido tomadas mltiplas iniciativas mas a importncia e a urgncia do problema recomendam prioridade poltica. 2. Quais so os elementos mnimos de unio oramental necessrios  estabilidade da rea do euro? Em Setembro do ano passado recebi a incumbncia de comentar esta pergunta numa Conferncia, organizada em Paris, pelo Fundo Monetrio Internacional e pelo Ministrio das Finanas francs. A minha resposta foi que os elementos necessrios so os seguintes: (i) Um conjunto de regras e procedimentos oramentais que assegurem a sustentabilidade das finanas pblicas, assegurem o crdito pblico e contribuam para a estabilidade financeira; (ii) Os mecanismos e fundos supra-nacionais necessrios para sustentar a unio bancria e, de forma mais geral, a unio financeira. Sobre o primeiro elemento falarei a seguir a propsito de Portugal. Quero agora justificar brevemente o segundo. Tenho defendido desde meados da dcada de 1990 que a dinmica de ajustamento macroeconmico na rea do euro tem sido dominada por fatores financeiros. A literatura terica e a evidncia emprica mostram que a integrao financeira constitui o mecanismo que mais contribui (potencialmente) para a absoro de choques econmicos territorialmente concentrados. Na crise global e da rea do euro os custos de ajustamento foram muito aumentados pela fragmentao financeira que acompanhou a crise. Esta fragmentao decorreu, em grande parte, do ciclo perverso constitudo pela interdependncia entre risco bancrio e risco soberano. Portugal  um excelente exemplo do funcionamento destes mecanismos: teve primeiro um perodo prolongado de crescimento da despesa financiado a crdito e depois um agravamento sbito e brutal das condies de financiamento. O processo culminou com uma quebra subita no acesso ao financiamento privado internacional na primavera de 2010. A identificao dos elementos mnimos passa por avanar para a unio bancria e alargar o conceito para o de uma verdadeira e abrangente unio financeira, baseada no programa do mercado nico. Este programa tem alguns pressupostos oramentais. Especificamente a estabilidade sistmica est dependente de mecanismos de ao coletiva eficazes. O desenho destes mecanismos passa pelas contribuies do prprio sistema bancrio. As suas dimenses mais relevantes so o mecanismo (e fundo) de resoluo bancrio e o mecanismo de garantia de depsitos. Em ambos os casos a necessidade de mecanismos financeiros coletivos de suporte  crucial para assegurar a estabilidade e excluir a ocorrncia de equilbrios perversos  porventura em situaes de pnico. Um sistema de instituies s pode considerar-se completo quando  robusto e resiliente. Isto  quando diminui e limita a possibilidade de ocorrncia de crises e quando contm eficazmente os seus efeitos. 3. Como gerir as finanas pblicas nacionais? Desde Junho de 2012 que se tm verificado grandes progressos na integrao econmica e monetria europeia. Na rea macroeconmica e oramental esto em vigor os chamados six pack e two pack. O resultado  um conjunto reforado de procedimentos a nvel europeu. Para pases como Portugal, que beneficiaram de financiamento oficial, os procedimentos que se aplicam so reforados. Como tem sido amplamente comentado em Portugal a presso para o ajustamento e para a diminuio do peso da dvida ter de persistir por dcadas. Tudo isto  verdade e tudo isto  importante. No entanto no  esse o aspeto que quero destacar. Para mim a inovao fundamental em matria oramental  o Tratado de Estabilidade, Coordenao e Governao (Fiscal Compact). O Tratado, em termos de regras e valores de referncia, reproduz o contedo do six pack. Mas ento qual  a novidade? A novidade  fundamental: o Tratado estabelece que as regras e procedimentos acordados tm de ter traduo na ordem jurdica interna de cada Estado-membro. As instituies nacionais tm de se adaptar s exigncias das regras. Este ponto  fundamental. Porqu? Em minha opinio a poltica na Europa  marcada por um facto bsico: o primado da dimenso nacional da poltica. Este facto geral  naturalmente particularmente central na rea da poltica oramental. O papel dos parlamentos na poltica oramental  de grande importncia. A necessidade de informao e anlise de qualidade tambm se faz sentir sobretudo a nvel nacional.  curioso que, em Portugal, se verificou um repetido incumprimento das regras oramentais da rea do euro durante a primeira dcada da unio monetria. No entanto, hoje o debate  muito mais intenso porque estas questes se tornaram internamente salientes do ponto de vista poltico. S com um debate aprofundado e consciente ser possvel resolver um problema com este grau de dificuldade e profundidade. A questo no  o desenho nem o contedo das regras. Tudo isso  bem conhecido. A questo  de eficcia na execuo e de convico na opo de regime. Voltando a Oliveira Martins  em interveno no Parlamento, em fevereiro de 1893 - o escritor afirma que como Ministro das Finanas promoveu um acordo com os credores. Afirmou, como justificao: Creio que, enquanto no pudermos chegar a adotar um sistema que seja igualmente aceite pelo credor e devedor, um sistema que d satisfao recproca, viveremos sempre uma vida amargurada. Como j referi acima esta posio no era partilhada pelo Presidente do Conselho que rejeitou o convnio. De acordo com Oliveira Martins, a posio de Dias Ferreira, era que bastava declarar que no se pagava. Esta posio era defendida com o argumento de que no havia receio de virem esquadras ao Tejo (como aconteceu em Alexandria). Mas, para Oliveira Martins, esta  uma falsa questo. Afirma: No era uma interveno armada que eu temia; o que eu temia eram os resultados econmicos da falta de um convnio, convnio que era condio sine qua non de se obter para Portugal uma soma de ouro suficiente para estabelecer a confiana e para liquidar a crise.. Este argumento de Oliveira Martins  semelhante ao usado por Alexander Hamilton quando se ocupa com os fundamentos do crdito pblico na recm formada administrao americana. Os argumentos de Hamilton esto disponveis no Primeiro Relatrio sobre o Crdito Pblico de Janeiro de 1790. A experincia de Alexander Hamilton como primeiro secretrio do tesouro americano tem sido tema da minha investigao nos ltimos meses. Concluso Parece-me apropriado concluir com uma citao de Alexander Hamilton (a traduo  minha): Quem quer que considere a natureza do Governo com discernimento verificar que no obstante obstculos e atrasos se coloquem  adoo de boas polticas;  verdade que uma vez adotadas sero provavelmente estveis e permanentes.  muito mais difcil desfazer do que fazer. Esta  uma mensagem que merece ser revisitada na Europa de hoje.  uma mensagem que se aplica  aqui e agora  a Portugal.

Title: Intervention of Deputy Governor Pedro Duarte Neves at the II Banking Law Congress: "The RGICSF - past, present and future"
text: II BANKING LAW CONGRESS - INAUGURAL CONFERENCE The RGICSF - past, present and future Pedro Duarte Neves* * Deputy Governor of Banco de Portugal. The opinions of this article are expressed on a personal level and do not bind Banco de Portugal. This text benefited from the excellent collaboration of Dr. Susana Brito of the Department of Legal Services. Ladies and gentlemen, It is with great pleasure that I participate in this II Congress of Banking Law. I begin by thanking, on behalf of myself, and on behalf of Banco de Portugal, the honorable invitation addressed to me for this inaugural speech, by Professor Miguel Pestana de Vasconcelos, whom I congratulate for the scientific coordination of the work program of this congress. On January 1, 2015, 22 years of the entry into force of the General Regime of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations1, approved by DecreeLaw No. 298/92 of December 31. In the course of its 22 years of life, the RGICSF has undergone 39 legislative amendments. I refer only to "formal" legislative changes including only those cases where the text has been modified2, not 1 Ahead in the text "RGICSF", an abbreviation that came to be pronounced from an early age, simplified with the sound corresponding to the acronym "RGIC". 2 At the time of the conference in May 2015, the number of amendments was 35. On the date of preparation of the text for publication at the beginning of December, the 39 amending diplomas are as follows: Decreelaws No 246/95, of 14 September 232/96 of 5 December 222/99, 22 June 250/250, 13 October 285/2001, 3 November 201/2002, 26 September, 319/2002, of 28 December, 28 December, 28 December, 2002, 28 December 2002, 2002, 2002 252/2003, of 17 October, 145/2006, 31 July, 104/2007, of 3 April, 357A/2007, of October 31, 1/2008, of January 3, 126/2008, of July 21 and 211A/2008, of November 3, by Law No. 28/2009 of June 19, by DecreeLaw No. 162/2009 of July 20, of July 20, 2009, law no. 94/2009 of September 1, by DecreesLaws No. 317/2009 of October 30, 52/2010, of May 26 and 71/2010, of June 18, by Law No. 36/2010, of September 2, by Decree-Law No. 140A/2010, of December 30, by Law No. 46/2011, of June 24, by DecreesLaws No. 88/2011, of 20 July, 119/2011, of 26 December, 31A/2012, of 10 February and 242/2012, of November 7, by Law No. 64/2012 of December 24, by DecreesLaws No. 18/2013, of February 6, 63A/2013, of May 10, 114A/2014, of August 1, 114B/2014, of August 4 and 157/2014, 24 October, by Laws No. 16/2015, of February 24, 23A/2015, of March 26 and 66/2015, of July 6, by DecreeLaw No. 140/2015, of July 31, by Law No. 118/2015, of August 31 and by DecreeLaw No. 190/2015, of September 10. therefore, in view of cases where the scope of the RGICSF has been extended by another diploma, without formal amendment of the text. As a comparative example of the "legislative intervention index", consider the situation of the civil cigo that takes 48 years, going through two constitutional periods of our country: the 69 amendments to the text of this cigo, counted at the time of this congress, express a "ratio" of legislative changes lower than that of the GSF. Some other formal indicators  what can an economist do without number ones?  note this changing fate of the RGICSF: the initial text was albeit by 11 titles, which contained 232 articles. Although the RGICSF continues to end in Article 232, inserted in Title XI, today, by the effect of numerous interleavings, the number of titles of the RGICSF amounts to 14, with the number of articles significantly doubled.3 3 In the current version , between Article 116 (Supervisory Procedures) and Article 117 (Management companies of shareshares) shall mediatise Articles 116a (Supervisory Procedure) to 116AI (Review Committee, evaluations and supervisory measures); between Article 145 (Suspension or removal of members of the administration bodies) and Article 146 (Urgent nature of the measures) are Articles 145a (Designation of 145AV (Rules of immediate application on contractual obligations). Several republics have been keeping the text together, although perhaps losing some clarity, coherence and systematic unity. The last of them occurred by determination of Law No. 23A/2015 of March 26.4 The path I decided to follow in this intervention was to identify the main milestones that led to the current configuration of the RGICSF and through which the duties of credit institutions and financial corporations and, on the other hand, administrative powers in such varied areas as microprudential supervision, macroprudential supervision, were defined, behavioral supervision, sanctioning, the depsitos guarantee system and, finally, the recovery, resolution and liquidation of credit institutions and investment firms. 4 Banco de Portugal provides a permanently consolidated version of the (unofficial) RGICSF on the "Supervision" tab of its homepage. A. The first milestone. Approval of the RGICSF by DecreeLaw No. 298/92 of December 31 The first milestone in the history of the RGICSF is constituted, of course, by its very appearance. This event, which introduced a coded regime of credit institutions and financial corporations, marks a major milestone in the history of financial regulation and supervision in our country5. The RGICSF was approved in the use of a legislative authorization that entrusted the Government with powers to "reformulate the legal framework of the financial system (banking and parabanking)"6. The regime established by DecreeLaw No. 41 403 of November 27 was then in force, through which an "reorganization of credit was enprocessed and accompanied by some individual legislation, in order to ensure the banking assistance necessary to achieve the higher ends of the national economy"7. 5 The GSF does not contain the full set of legal rules on the establishment and functioning of credit institutions and financial corporations. If this is generally the case for banks, each of the types of other credit institutions  economic banks and agricultural credit banks  and financial corporations have specific regimes that regulate aspects of their operation. 6 Law No. 9/92 of July 3. 7 Law No. 2079 of 21 December 1955. The legislative acquis repealed (or replaced) by the introduction of the RGICSF (18 diplomas)8 already included some hiccups that were absorbed by the new regime and that last to this day. An important 1986 "legislative package" was already part of this acquis, on the eve of eec participation, harmonising national legislation with Community legislation. In contrast to the previous regime, financial firms submitted to the RGICSF were al-sized between credit institutions and financial corporations, thus abandoning the previous tripartite classification between credit institutions, parabanking institutions and credit ancillary. In delimiting the object or scope of activity of banks, the universal banking model  in which banks provide all services to all customers  was welcomed, although some changes, remains in place. Despite some specific changes, the first decade of the RGICSF took place under relative reassurance, with six amendments almost all resulting from Community legislation, which i highlight the transposition of Directives 94/19/EC, the European Parliament and the 8 DecreesLaws No 41403 of 27 November 1957, 46302, of 27 April 1965, 46492, 18 August 1965, 46493, 18 August 1965, 47413, 23 December 1966, 205/70, 12 May 119/74, 23 March 540A/74, 12 October, 76B/75, of February 21, 183B/76, of March 10, 353S/77, of August 29, 372/77, of September 5, 2/78, of 9 January, 23/86, of February 18, 24/86, of February 18, 25/86, of February 18, 318/89, of 23 September and 91/90, of 17 March 17, 17 March Council of 30 May 1994 on the Depsitos Guarantee Fund, and 97/9/EC of the European Parliament and the Council of 3 March on the investor compensation scheme. B. Mark of Basel. The in-depth review of the RGICSF by DecreeLaw No. 201/2002 of September 26 It is not possible to talk about prudential supervision of credit institutions without mentioning the influence of the work of the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), constituted in late 1974 by the central bank governors of the G10 countries for cooperation in banking supervision. Today 28 countries sit on the Committee and their work is followed by various international organisations. The European Union also has membership and is represented by the European Central Bank and the Single Supervisory Mechanism. The other European institutions (Commission, Council and European Parliament) have been following the work in Basel from the outset. And it is essentially in this way that the recommendations and standards issued by the Committee have been incorporated into the RGICSF. The recommendations of the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision took shape in several documents, successively called "Basel", "Basel II" and "Basel III", important banking supervision milestones that also marked the evolution of the RGICSF. The first major amendment of the RGICSF, by DecreeLaw No. 201/2002 of 26 September, has the mark of Basel (to the extent that this diploma transpose directives that had accepted recommendations of the BCBS), although the experience resulting from a few years of application of the GSF had also determined some solutions. This decreelaw constitutes the 6th amendment of the RGICSF. This amendment has strengthened the control of the operating conditions of regulated entities, in view, which will continue to have full expression in the supervening modifications of the GSF, that it is in the public interest to ensure that regulated entities are properly manageable, so that they can be in the best condition to ensure their solvency and liquidity. Thus, in the context of this first major amendment of the RGICSF, as regards the control of the suitability of qualified holdings, the very notion of qualified participation has been reformulated, with an emphasis on a qualitative criterion; a presumption of rebuttable significant influence was introduced where the percentage reached 5 %, while an absolute presumption of significant influence on management was maintained in cases of participation equal to or greater than 10% of the capital or voting rights. In addition to this aspect, a duty of communication was also established whenever an acquisition of participation occurred with an expression likely to constitute a situation of influence on the institution. Banco de Portugal's powers as supervisory authority have also been significantly strengthened. I would like to give an example the power to declare the qualified nature of a holding; the power to apply an opposition measure provided to prevent the implementation of operations in certain cases and the power to inhibit the voting rights of a qualified holding holder. In addition to these points, the review adjusted the provisions of the rules on prudential ratios and limits and introduced some improvements to the sanitation scheme of the institutions. The reference expressed, until then, to the Caixa Geral de Depitos was also eliminated, because it was understood that this institution  without prejudice to the attributions that, in addition to the banking activity, would be especially conferred by law  fully integrated itself into the concept of credit institution. C. Again Basel. Basel II. The 10th amendment to the RGICSF After five years of intensive work, the Basel Banking Supervision Committee concluded in June 2004 the revised capital framework, which would become known as "Basel II". The Basel II recommendations are based on three pillars: the first pillar develops the principles relating to minimum capital requirements, with the introduction of internal models for credit risk and capital requirements for operational risk; the second pillar strengthens the supervision of capital adequacy and the internal evaluation process by credit institutions and the third pillar aims at strengthening market discipline and encouraging good practice by institutions through transparency mechanisms. Thus, in mid-June 2006, on a proposal from the European Commission and with the strongly favourable opinion of the ECB, Directive No 2006/48/EC of the European Parliament and the Council of 14 June was issued. In good rigour, Basel II gave rise to two separate directives (paragraphs 48 and 49/2006), but the transposition of the second was made by separate legislation, which is nevertheless in close connection with the RGICSF, by means of various remissive standards. Directive 2006/48/EC on access to the activity of credit institutions and their exercise would take the name "CRD" ("Capital Requirements Directive")  and would later be renamed "CRD I". The transposition of this directive by DecreeLaw No. 104/2007 of 3 April led to the 10th amendment of the RGICSF. Although supervised institutions have, in particular, of course, they have been addressed to various prudential content rules through DecreeLaw No. 104/2007  for example, those through the provisions that have improved the methods of risk assessment and management to which credit institutions are exposed  what I would like to highlight in particular in this framework of the evolution of the RGICSF is the redefinition that has been designed with it in the profile of the supervisory authority. The strengthening of the supervision carried out by the 10th amendment of the GSF involved a clear increase in number and complexity of the first acts of supervision, i.e. the list of duties and responsibilities of the supervisory authority (more markedly perhaps than the strengthening, which has also occurred, of supervisory powers). In this sense, in an illustrative way, we list, from now on, the strengthening of the disclosure by Banco de Portugal, as supervisor, of information on relevant legal and regulatory diplomas, as well as to the general recommendations adopted in Portugal; the options and discretions provided for in Community legislation which have been exercised by the competent legislator/authority; and the criteria and methodologies used to analyse compliance with the requirements applicable to institutions and assess the risks to which institutions are or may be exposed. Other aspects to be highlighted concern the densification of coordination and cooperation schemes in the context of consolidated supervision, in particular in emergency situations, and the establishment of rules on cooperation and conclusion of memoranda of understanding, as well as the establishment of colleges of supervisors. D. The fourth milestone. Behavioral supervision The fourth important episio in the "life" of THE RGICSF is the consecration in the legal Portuguese of behavioral supervision in 2008, by DecreeLaw No. 1/2008, of March 3. In its original formulation, the RGICSF already established in Title VI, under the heading "rules of conduct", a set of general duties of credit institutions to their clients, provisions relating to professional secrecy and also a chapter dedicated to conflicts of interest, competition protection and publicity (to the purpose of which some powers were given to the supervisor). But it is in 2008 that the General Regime now has a chapter called "Behavioral Supervision", thus consoning the importance of this which aims at confidence in the banking system, for Banco de Portugal's broader strategy. Banco de Portugal is responsible for supervising the activities of institutions in retail banking markets (depitos, credits and payment).9 Behavioural supervision acts on the supply of banking products, but also aims  by promoting financial literacy demand. 9 When credit institutions act as financial intermediaries, their supervision is the responsibility of the CMVM, as the entity responsible for the supervision of the securities market. When credit institutions act as insurance agents, their supervision is the responsibility of the ASF. An enlightened demand is an important condition for the efficient functioning of markets. This should promote the information and financial training of bank customers. One might think that the Portuguese legislator came late in expressly providing for behavioural supervision only in early 2008, but, in fact, Portugal was a forerunner in this matter in the European and international panorama. In most countries, behavioural supervision has taken on importance after the international financial crisis that began in 2007. This crisis has clearly exposed the risks to which bank customers may be subject, in particular at the level of credit, and the consequences of these risks for the financial system and economic activity in general (nevertheless, the functions of behavioural supervision are not explicitly recognised in the mandate and structure of most banking supervisors). In the field of behavioural supervision, THE RGICSF has invested Banco de Portugal in a broad set of powers, of a regulatory, supervisory and sanctioning nature. Banco de Portugal's regulatory power in behavioral supervision focuses mainly on the transparency of the information made available to the banking client by the credit institution. The supervisory power is exercised through inspections of central services and branches of credit institutions, as well as through the analysis of the information disclosed on the institutions' websites and the analysis of other information reported to Banco de Portugal. The analysis of the complaints of bank customers, sent to Banco de Portugal for consideration, is also used as a tool for monitoring the conduct of the institutions. The sanctioning powers in the field of behavioural supervision may consist of the requirement to correct irregularities, or where appropriate, the initiation of proceedings against the basis of charges and the consequent imposition of fines or other appropriate penalties. E. The fifth milestone. Strengthening the sanctioning regime. 15th amendment. Law No. 28/2009 of June 19 The list of criminal and counter-criminal offences  and corresponding sanctions  remained unchanged during the first decade and a half of the RGICSF. Law No. 28/2009 of June 19, later developed by legislation of 2012 and 2014, set a new milestone in the evolution of the RGICSF by the reinforcement it introduced in the sanctioning regime applicable to entities submitted to this regulatory legislation. As regards the amendments introduced by Law 28/2009, it should be noted, first, the significant increase in the amounts of the applicable fines, which have almost doubled in value. The purpose of the increase of the fine was also introduced, under which if twice the econico benefit obtained by the infringer exceeds the ceiling of the applicable fine, the amount to be borne by the infringer may be increased to twice the benefit, without prejudice, of course, to the loss of the maximum eco-benefit. In addition, in addition, the experience started in the securities sector was introduced to make the intervention more agile, which also gathered the experience started in the securities sector. The very extreme procedure is a relevant instrument of procedural efficiency, applicable in cases where the nature of the infringement, the intensity of the fault and other circumstances characterise the unlawful as of low severity. Since then the sanctioning regime enshrined in the RGICSF has also undergone several improvements, especially those introduced under DecreeLaw No. 157/2014 of October 24. Moreover, the importance of this diploma exceeds the universe of the RGICSF, since it has also established preventive and repressive measures to combat the laundering of advantages of illicit origin and the financing of terrorism, matters which are disciplined in legislation. As regards the sanctioning regime for behavioural supervision, I would like to highlight some of the most recent changes: the increase in the ceiling of the applicable fine (5 million for natural persons and 10% of the total net annual debt volume in the case of legal persons); the creation of a new criminal type of disobedience to legitimate orders or warrants of Banco de Portugal and, finally, the extension of the limitation period of counterordenational proceedings whenever the delay is related to acts committed by the accused. Desecrating and clarifying what was being practiced by Banco de Portugal and accepted by the case-law, there was also more improvements of the regime (for example, express consecration of the secrecy of justice until the decision of Banco de Portugal was given, simplification of the system of notifications and communications and clarification of the criteria for the graduation of the sanction). F. Basel again: Basel III. The 33rd amendment: DecreeLaw No. 157/2014, of October 24 In 2011, the Basel Committee developed a new set of measures to strengthen the regulation, supervision and risk management of the banking sector. Thus appeared "Basel III". The Basel III measures aim to improve the banking sector's ability to absorb shocks from adverse environmental or financial situations, improve risk management and corporate governance of institutions and enhance transparency and information on the situation of banks. Basel III has implications both at the microprudential and macroprudential level. Basel III gave rise to two important instruments at European level: Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and the Council of 26 June 2013 on prudential requirements for credit institutions and investment firms10 and Directive No 2013/36/EU of the European Parliament and the Council of 26 June 2013, on access to the activity of credit institutions and prudential supervision of credit institutions and investment firms11 . The transposition of this Directive and the introduction into the GOURSF of open-menu sums (for choice of national legislation) in Regulation No 575/2013 mark another high milestone in the evolution of the GSF. DecreeLaw No. 157/2014 of October 24 materialized this milestone, which corresponds to the 33rd amendment of the RGCISF. Contrary to what had happened with the transposition of the Directive adopting Basel II, the transposition of CRD IV (Basel III) was generally in the body of the RGICSF. CRD IV contains rules on access to the activity of credit institutions, including, inter alia, rules on the formation of reserves of financial funds, the requirements on liquidity risk and leverage of credit institutions, the exercise of freedom 10 Sometimes called "CRR" (Capital Requirement Regulation). 11Known as "CRD IV". freedom to provide services, corporate governance requirements, including employee remuneration, supervisory framework, powers of competent authorities, and the sanctioning regime. I highlight some of the new solutions: The RGICSF has now determined that the gons of credit institutions are responsible for the application of government systems capable of ensuring the effective and prudent management of these institutions, not neglecting the separation of functions within the organization and the prevention of conflicts of interest. In addition, additional requirements have been laid down in terms of suitability, qualification, professional experience, independence and availability of the members of the administration and oversight. Remuneration practices, in turn, are subject to the definition of remuneration policies, which have to adapt to the circumstances of the institution, as well as to the nature of the activities, and may not involve excessive risk-taking, in particular due to the variable component of the remuneration of members of social groups and other responsible persons. A duty to publish and disseminate the policies of credit institutions and financial companies on the suitability, professional qualification, availability and independence of management and supervisory bodies, as well as the practices and policies, thereby promoting transparency and widespread access to this type of information. Another innovation to be mentioned is the extension of the subjective scope of requirements previously only concerning the holders of management and supervisory bodies, so that certain employees with significant influence on the management of credit institutions and financial corporations may also be subject to them. The universe in question consists of those responsible for compliance, internal audit, control and risk management. It should also be noted in the context of the reference framework, the measure aimed at strengthening the risk strategy of supervised entities, expressed by the need to set up a risk committee composed of holders of non-executive functions. It is also worth mentioning, in the context of this significant change in the RGICSF, the expansion of the range of supervisory powers with corrective function. The supervisory authority now has, for example, the power to request disinvestment in activities that present excessive risks, the power to limit or prohibit the payment of dividends in certain cases and the power to impose specific liquidity and leverage requirements. Finally, but with great importance, it is to be reported to this framework that risk mitigation and the safeguarding of financial stability can be pursued through a variety of mechanisms reserves of public funds, the determination of which is in the hands of the macroprudential authority: "conservation reserve", "countercyclical reserve", "reserve for institutions of global systemic importance", "reserve for other institutions of systemic importance" and "systemic risk reserve". G. The seventh milestone. The 35th amendment. Law 23A/2015 of March 26 The last major milestone in the evolution of the GSF resulted from the transposition into the national legal order of Directive No 2014/59 of the European Parliament and the Council of 15 May 201412 on the recovery and resolution of credit institutions and investment firms. The collapse of a credit institution, in particular with the inherent breach of trust in the savings collection system and the insusceptibility resulting from providing the economy with the financial means for its operation, particularly with regard to payments, carries a risk of collapse of the financial system, with an incalculable impact on the economy and society. 12Conhecida por BRRD (Bank Recovery and Resolution Directive). BRRD provides tools to deal with these crisis situations for the recovery and resolution of credit institutions and investment firms. It is worth mentioning, to this propitium, the obligation to draw up recovery plans and resolution plans; the possibility of adopting corrective intervention measures; the assessment of the problem-upability of credit institutions and cross-border groups; a set of resolution measures, such as the divestment of the activity to another credit institution, the transfer of the activity to transition institutions, the segregation of assets in an entity specialized in its management and the so-called internal recapitalisation (bailin) and, finally, the intervention of financing mechanisms in the implementation of resolution measures. In Portugal, BRRD was somewhat anticipated by DecreeLaw No. 31A/2012 of February 10, which established13 a set of intervention measures, graduated according to the severity of the crisis in the institution concerned: corrective intervention, provisional administration and resolution. This diploma was inspired by the technical work that was already taking place in the European Commission, in view of what would become BRRD, as well as recommendations from the Financial Stability Board, a group forum created in 2009 under the G20. 13 In line with the Economic and Financial Assistance Programme agreed in May 2011 between the Portuguese authorities, the European Union and the International Monetary Fund. However, Law No. 23A/2015 of March 3, through which the 35th amendment of the RGICSF was registered, did not limit itself to transpose brrd. In fact, in the normative amendment printed by this law, we refound a matter that constituted the central theme of the 1st amendment to the RGICSF, carried out by DecreeLaw No. 246/95 of September 14, the Depitos Guarantee Fund.14 H. The future of RGICSF The 40th amendment of the RGICSF is already being designed on the horizon. The transposition of Directive 2014/65/EU of the European Parliament and the Council of 15 May on markets in financial instruments15 is expected to make changes to the TEXT of the GSF on authorisations and requirements for access to activity by investment firms. The RGICSF has been throughout its twenty-two years of validity a structure capable of housing successive and striking legislative interventions. As prticas de remunerao, por seu turno, passam a estar condicionadas  definio de polticas de remunerao, que tm de adequarse s circunstncias da instituio, bem como  natureza das actividades, no podendo envolver a assuno de riscos excessivos, designadamente em razo da componente varivel da remunerao dos membros dos gos sociais e de outros responsveis. Foi imposto um dever de publicao e de divulgao no stio na internet das polticas das instituis de crdito e sociedades financeiras relativas  idoneidade, qualificao profissional, disponibilidade e independncia dos gos de administrao e de fiscalizao, assim como das prticas e polticas remuneratias, promovendose assim a transparncia e o acesso generalizado a este tipo de informao. Outra inovao a mencionar consiste na extenso do mbito subjetivo de exigncias anteriormente apenas respeitantes aos titulares de gos de administrao e de fiscalizao, de modo a passarem a ser tambm a elas submetidos certos colaboradores com influncia significativa na gesto das instituis de crdito e das sociedades financeiras. O universo em causa  constitudo por responsveis pelas funs de compliance, auditoria interna, controlo e gesto de riscos. H ainda a assinalar no contexto do marco em referncia, a medida destinada ao reforo da estratgia de risco das entidades supervisionadas, expressa pela necessidade de criao de um comit de risco, composto por titulares de funs no executivas. Merece ainda ser mencionada, no quadro desta significativa alterao do RGICSF, a ampliao do leque dos poderes de superviso com funo corretiva. A autoridade de superviso passou a dispor, por exemplo, do poder de solicitar o desinvestimento em actividades que apresentem riscos excessivos, do poder de limitar ou proibir o pagamento de dividendos em certos casos e do poder de impor requisitos especficos de liquidez e de alavancagem. Por ltimo, mas com grande relevo,  de reportar a este marco que a mitigao de riscos e a salvaguarda da estabilidade financeira passaram a poder ser prosseguidas mediante uma variedade de mecanismos respeitantes a reservas de fundos prrios, cuja determinao se encontra na mo da autoridade macroprudencial: reserva de conservao, reserva contracclica, reserva para instituis de importncia sistmica global, reserva para outras instituis de importncia sistmica e reserva para risco sistmico. G. O stimo marco. A 35. alterao. A Lei 23A/2015, de 26 de maro O ltimo grande marco na evoluo do RGICSF resultou da transposio para a ordem jurdica nacional da Diretiva n. 2014/59, do Parlamento Europeu e do Conselho, de 15 de maio de 201412 , relativa  recuperao e  resoluo de instituis de crdito e de empresas de investimento. O colapso de uma instituio de crdito, em particular, com a inerente quebra de confiana no sistema de captao de poupanas e a insusceptibilidade da decorrente de proporcionar  economia os meios financeiros para o seu funcionamento, designadamente no que respeita aos pagamentos, comporta um risco de colapso do prrio sistema financeiro, com impacto incalculvel na economia e na sociedade. 12Conhecida por BRRD (Bank Recovery and Resolution Directive). A BRRD proporciona utenslios para lidar com estas situas de crise para a recuperao e a resoluo de instituies de crdito e de empresas de investimento. So de destacar, a este propito, a obrigatoriedade de elaborao de planos de recuperao e de planos de resoluo; a possibilidade de adoo de medidas de interveno corretiva; a avaliao da resolubilidade das instituis de crdito e dos grupos transfronteirios; um conjunto de medidas de resoluo, como a alienao da actividade a outra instituio de crdito, a transferncia da actividade para instituies de transio, a segregao de ativos em entidade especializada na sua gesto e a denominada recapitalizao interna (bailin) e, por ltimo, a interveno de mecanismos de financiamento na aplicao de medidas de resoluo. Em Portugal, a BRRD foi de certo modo antecipada pelo DecretoLei n. 31A/2012, de 10 de fevereiro, que estabeleceu13 um conjunto de medidas de interveno, graduadas em funo da gravidade da crise na instituio em causa: a interveno correctiva, a administrao provisia e a resoluo. Este diploma foi inspirado nos trabalhos tcnicos que ento j corriam na Comisso Europeia, em vista do que viria a ser a BRRD, bem como em recomendas do Financial Stability Board, um forum grupo criado em 2009 no mbito do G20. 13 Em consonncia com o Programa de Assistncia Econmica e Financeira acordado em maio de 2011 entre as autoridades portuguesas, a Unio Europeia e o Fundo Monetrio Internacional. Porm, a Lei n. 23A/2015, de 3 de maro, por via da qual se registou a 35. alterao do RGICSF, no se limitou a transpor a BRRD. Com efeito, na alterao normativa imprimida por esta lei, reencontramos uma matria que constitura o tema central da 1. alterao ao RGICSF, levada a cabo pelo DecretoLei n. 246/95, de 14 de setembro, o Fundo de Garantia de Depitos.14 H. O futuro do RGICSF Desenhase j no horizonte a 40. alterao do RGICSF. Com efeito, a transposio da Diretiva 2014/65/EU, do Parlamento europeu e do conselho, de 15 de maio, relativa aos mercados de instrumentos financeiros15 , vir previsivelmente a introduzir modificas no texto do RGICSF quanto s autorizas e aos requisitos de acesso  actividade por parte das empresas de investimento. O RGICSF tem sido ao longo dos seus vinte e dois anos de vigncia uma estrutura capaz de albergar as sucessivas e marcantes intervens legislativas.
