Talvez esta capacidade se encontre hoje perto do limite. 14 A disciplina jurdica do Fundo de Garantia de Depsitos (FGD) sofrera j entretanto uma alterao para reforo do limite de cobertura, pelo DecretoLei n. 211A/2008, de 3 de novembro. 15 Por vezes designada DMIF, abreviatura da designao apresentada no texto. Reconhecese que a introduo de sucessivas alteras ao RGICSF  com a elevada frequncia que descrevi nesta exposio  tem vindo a contribuir, de forma gradual, para alguma perda na articulao temtica, sistemtica e lingustica deste diploma. Ser de considerar, assim, que face  perspetiva de uma certa estabilidade do atual quadro normativo, esta seja a altura certa para se comear a ponderar, em articulao com o legislador, sobre o que pode e deve ser feito para reintroduzir uma maior clareza ao atual regime geral. No desfile dos seus diversos marcos, em concluso, o RGICSF  um documento vivo da intensa evoluo verificada nas duas ltimas dcadas, nos deveres das instituis de crdito e das sociedades financeiras, bem como na definio e evoluo dos poderes administrativos nas reas da superviso microprudencial, superviso macroprudencial, superviso comportamental, ao sancionatria, sistema de garantia de depsitos e ainda na recuperao, resoluo e liquidao de instituis de crdito e de empresas de investimento.

Title: Initial intervention of Administrator Elisa Ferreira at the hearing of the Committee on Budget, Finance and Administrative Modernization
text: Hearing in the Committee on Budget, Finance and Administrative Modernisation June 27, 2017 Initial Intervention of Administrator Elisa Ferreira 1 1 Prepared for presentation. Madam President, Ladies and gentlemen,  In the person of the Chairman of the Committee on Budget, Finance and Administrative Modernisation (COFMA), I begin by greeting all members of this important Commission.  It is with great pleasure that I return here to this parliamentary committee, a year and only a few days later on a similar hearing that preceded the exercise of my current duties at Banco de Portugal.  This is also an excellent opportunity to account about the work that, as a member of the Board of Directors of Banco de Portugal responsible for prudential supervision, I have been developing.  A year ago, when I took office, I did so in a fully conscious way in relation to the dimension of the challenge I proposed to face; at the time I mentioned, and I quote, that I would join a team that captained "a ship in the middle of a very rough sea".  And in this same commitment I have made to the elected representatives of citizens, that is, the Members of COFMA, I have defined as the main objective of my future action, to contribute with all my commitment to the defence of the public good which constitutes the stability of the financial system and the protection of policymakers, in particular depositors, essential, especially in times of uncertainty.  Today, not all the objectives I advocated a year ago have been fully achieved, but undeniable progress is made, especially with regard to reducing uncertainties and strengthening credibility and confidence in the national banking system. Thinking about the situation of the big Portuguese systemic banks:  In relation to the General Deposit Box (CGD): o On 31 August 2016, a statutory amendment of the CGD was implemented (with the conversion of the internal government structure, the Anglo- as well as the new members of the Board of Directors and the Supervisory Board. o In January 2017, the first phase of CGD's capitalisation was completed, with a capital increase in kind of EUR 1.444 billion, which included the extinction of hybrid capital instruments subscribed by the State in 2012. o In February 2017, a new Board of Directors is appointed. o On 10 March 2017, the European Commission issues a formal decision on the recapitalisation of CGD. o At the end of that month (March) the second phase of the capitalisation operation was implemented, with the issuance of additional tier 1 capital instruments for private investors, in the amount of EUR 500 million and with an interest rate of 10.75% (with demand exceeding 4 times the offer being highlighted). o Finally, on May 18, 2017, the new statutory auditor was elected for the 2017/2020 term, in compliance with the provisions of Decree-Law No. 140/2015.  In relation to Millennium BCP: o In November 2016, there was a private issue of 175 million euros of new shares, fully subscribed by a new strategic shareholder. o In February 2017, this issue was complemented by a public subscription of 1.332 million euros, which allowed an increase in the percentage of capital held by strategic qualified shareholders (from 34% to 41%), with Fosun being the largest shareholder of BCP (with 23.9%), followed by Sonangol (with 15.2%). o There was also an increase in holdings held by institutional investors from 19% to 28%. o Following this capital increase, bcp repaid the remaining amount of hybrid capital instruments (EUR 750 million) subscribed by the Portuguese in 2012.  In relation to BPI: o On January 5, 2017, Banco BPI sold Unitel a representative share holding of 2% of Banco de Fomento Angola's share capital and voting rights, transferring control of BFA to Angolan society, which allowed the resolution of the shareholder dispute in Banco BPI and the regularization of the non-compliance with the limit of major risks vis-a-vis the Angolan State. o On February 7, 2017, Caixabank successfully completed the takeover bid of Banco BPI, holding a stake of 84.5% and taking control of Banco BPI. o In March 2017, Banco BPI strengthened its own funds through an issue of EUR 300 million of subordinated debt eligible for own funds (Tier 2), which was fully subscribed by Caixabank.  In relation to the NEW BANK: o On March 31, 2017, Banco de Portugal selected Lone Star to complete the sale of Novo Banco, and the Resolution Fund signed the contractual documents of the transaction. o The signature by the Resolution Fund has enabled the sales period set by the Commitments made by the State to the European Commission to be met. o Under the terms of the agreement, Lone Star will inject 1 billion of capital into Novo Banco (750 million at the time of completion of the transaction and 250 million within 3 years), and will have 75% of the institution's capital. The Resolution Fund will retain 25% of the capital (without voting rights or presence in the Administration). o There is a contingent capitalization mechanism, under which the Resolution Fund, as a shareholder, undertakes to carry out capital injections (maximum of EUR 3.89 billion over 8 years) in the event of certain cumulative conditions, related to: i) losses on a limited set of Novo Banco's assets, totalling 7.8 billion and (ii) the evolution of the bank's capitalization levels. o The completion of this sale operation is dependent on the implementation of a tax management exercise, subject to the bondholders' approval, which will cover novo banco's non-subordinated obligations, the terms of which are being finalized.  This progressive stabilisation of the four national systemic banks was only achieved through a major concerted effort between the bank administrations, their shareholders, the different national supervisory authorities (with particular note for full coordination with the CMVM) and the Government (particularly, but not only, in the case of Caixa Geral de Depositos).  Also at European level, with the Directorate General for Competition but above all in the context of the Single Supervisory Mechanism (MSS) - which is responsible for direct supervision of these institutions - the interaction has been intense:  Only by way of indication, since 1 July 2016 I have participated in 50 meetings of the European supervisory structures, between the Supervisory Board (Supervisory Board)  which meets in Frankfurt for two and a half days every fifteen days  its Executive Committee and the Macroprudential Forum (which brings together the Board of Governors and the Supervisory Board). It should be noted that only in few sessions, no Portuguese bank was discussed in depth (with detailed analyses of capital and liquidity positions, etc. and consequent supervisory charges).  I do not mean that the banking sector has all the problems solved.  Even in this phase of initial stabilization, in which progress is undeniable, there is still finalized sale of Novo Banco and ensure the stabilization of Caixa Economica Montepio Geral, for example. However, both processes are ongoing and being monitored very closely.  In terms of the banking sector as a whole, some indicators may help to perceive the major adjustment of the banking sector Portuguese: o Significant deleveraging: Total assets reduced from 526 billion in 2010 to 386 billion in 2016 by Strengthening solvency levels: Increased capital ratio from 7.4% in 2010 (Core Tier 1) to 11.4% in 2016 (Common Equity Tier 1) [serial breakdown]; o Liquidity improvement: the loan-to-deposit ratio (loan-to-deposit ratio) decreased from around 150% at the end of 2010 to around 96% at the end of 2016; o Increased efficiency: the cost-to-income ratio peaked at 72% at the end of 2013 and is now close to 60%;  In European comparative terms (average of the banks of the Single Supervisory Mechanism), today the Portuguese banks present Gross Operating Results as a percentage of the very similar equity, a total revenue as a percentage of equity slightly lower than the peers, but an impact of operating costs slightly more favorable.  The large difference in return on equity; RoE) compared to peers, it is only evident when Portuguese banks have to register the oddities arising from their high level of non-productive assets (NPLs).  Hence the importance of the work that, in an articulated way with the main holders of NPLs, BdP, Government and the Capitalize Unit (which brings together several ministries) have been developing in order to help the sector accelerate the reduction of non-productive assets of its balance sheet.  Despite the continuing severity of the problem, it is important to acknowledge the progress made since June 2016. Total non-performing assets (including loans but also other assets  Non Performing Exposures, NPE) decreased by around 3.5 billion between June and December 2016, reaching approximately 48 billion in December 2016. Recital only one of the most relevant segments of this cake, points out that the non-productive loans of non-financial corporations decreased by 3 billion euros in this space of 6 months, or 8.9%.  Considering the ratio of non-performing assets, this decreased by 0.3 p.p. between 2015 and 2016. The decrease continued in the first quarter of 2017, with this indicator reaching 16.7% in March.  The reduction in absolute terms is even more significant than the ratio itself as it incorporates the denominator effect, i.e. the decrease in total loans under the necessary balance sheet adjustment after the crisis.  Finally, it is worth mentioning the parallel effort of banks to increase the coverage of non-performing loans by odd ities, with their ratio increasing from 41% in 2015 to 45% in 2016.  Having said that, there is still a long way to go.  However, the recovery of the economy opens up renewed business opportunities that are an important element in this process.  Finally, it is important not to ignore the ongoing discussions at European Union level, in particular in the context of the revision of banking legislation, and to recognise the limitations that the current framework of an incomplete banking union imposes on the progressing recovery process on a daily basis.
text_original: Audio na Comisso de Oramento, Finanas e Modernizao Administrativa 27 de junho de 2017 Interveno Inicial da Administradora Elisa Ferreira 1 1 Preparado para apresentao. Senhora Presidente, Senhoras e Senhores Deputados,  Na pessoa da Presidente da Comisso de Oramento, Finanas e Modernizao Administrativa (COFMA), comeo por saudar todos os Senhores Deputados desta importante Comisso.   com o maior prazer que volto aqui, a esta comisso parlamentar, decorrido um ano e apenas alguns dias sobre uma audio semelhante que precedeu o exerccio das minhas atuais funes no Banco de Portugal.  Esta  tambm uma excelente oportunidade para prestar contas sobre o trabalho que, enquanto membro do Conselho de Administrao do Banco de Portugal responsvel pela superviso prudencial, tenho vindo a desenvolver.  H um ano, quando assumi funes, fi-lo de forma plenamente consciente em relao  dimenso do desafio que me propunha afrontar; na altura referi, e cito, que iria integrar uma equipa que capitaneava um navio no meio de um mar bastante agitado.  E, nesse mesmo compromisso que assumi perante os representantes eleitos dos cidados, isto , os Senhores Deputados da COFMA, defini como objetivo principal da minha futura ao, contribuir com todo o meu empenho para a defesa do bem pblico que constitui a estabilidade do sistema financeiro e a proteo dos aforradores, em particular dos depositantes, essencial, sobretudo em tempos de incerteza.  Hoje, nem todos os objetivos que defendi h um ano foram totalmente atingidos, mas constatam-se progressos inegveis, sobretudo no que se refere  reduo das incertezas e ao robustecimento da credibilidade e confiana no sistema bancrio nacional. Pensando na situao dos grandes bancos sistmicos portugueses:  Em relao  Caixa Geral de Depsitos (CGD): o Em 31 de agosto de 2016, foi concretizada uma alterao estatutria da CGD (com a converso da estrutura de governo interno, do modelo anglo- saxnico para o modelo latino), bem como nomeados os novos membros para o Conselho de Administrao e Conselho Fiscal. o Em janeiro de 2017, foi concluda a primeira fase da capitalizao da CGD, com um aumento de capital em espcie no valor de 1,444 mil milhes de euros, que incluiu a extino dos instrumentos hbridos de capital subscritos pelo Estado em 2012. o Em fevereiro de 2017,  nomeado um novo Conselho de Administrao. o A 10 de maro de 2017, a Comisso Europeia emite deciso formal sobre a recapitalizao da CGD. o No final desse mesmo ms (maro) foi concretizada a segunda fase da operao de capitalizao, com a emisso de instrumentos de fundos prprios adicionais de nvel 1 destinada a investidores privados, no valor de 500 milhes de euros e com uma taxa de juro de 10,75% (sendo de salientar uma procura superior 4 vezes  oferta). o Finalmente, a 18 de maio de 2017, foi eleito o novo auditor estatutrio para o mandato 2017/2020, em cumprimento do disposto no Decreto-Lei n. 140/2015.  Em relao ao Millennium BCP: o Em novembro de 2016, verificou-se uma emisso privada de 175 milhes de euros de novas aes, totalmente subscrita por um novo acionista estratgico. o Em fevereiro de 2017, esta emisso foi complementada com uma subscrio pblica, de 1,332 milhes de euros, que permitiu um aumento da percentagem de capital detida por acionistas qualificados estratgicos (de 34% para 41%), sendo a Fosun o maior acionista do BCP (com 23.9%), seguido da Sonangol (com 15.2%). o Tambm se verificou um aumento das participaes detidas por investidores institucionais, de 19% para 28%. o Na sequncia deste reforo de capital, o BCP reembolsou o montante remanescente dos instrumentos hbridos de capital (750 milhes de euros) subscritos pelo Estado Portugus em 2012.  Em relao ao BPI: o Em 5 de janeiro de 2017, o Banco BPI vendeu  Unitel uma participao social representativa de 2% do capital social e direitos de voto do Banco de Fomento Angola, transferindo o controlo do BFA para a sociedade angolana, o que permitiu a resoluo do diferendo acionista no Banco BPI e a regularizao do incumprimento do limite dos grandes riscos face ao Estado Angolano. o A 7 de fevereiro de 2017, o Caixabank completou com sucesso a oferta pblica de aquisio do Banco BPI, passando a deter uma participao de 84.5% e assumindo o controlo do Banco BPI. o Em maro de 2017, o Banco BPI reforou os seus fundos prprios, atravs de uma emisso de 300 milhes de euros de dvida subordinada elegvel para fundos prprios (Tier 2), a qual foi integralmente subscrita pelo Caixabank.  Em relao ao NOVO BANCO: o A 31 de maro de 2017, o Banco de Portugal selecionou a Lone Star para concluir a operao de venda do Novo Banco, tendo o Fundo de Resoluo assinado os documentos contratuais da operao. o A assinatura pelo Fundo de Resoluo permitiu que fosse cumprido o prazo de venda fixado nos compromissos assumidos pelo Estado junto da Comisso Europeia. o Nos termos do acordo, a Lone Star ir injetar 1.000 milhes de euros de capital no Novo Banco (750 milhes de euros no momento da concluso da operao e 250 milhes de euros no prazo de at 3 anos), passando a deter 75% do capital da instituio. O Fundo de Resoluo manter 25% do capital (sem direitos de voto ou presena na Administrao). o Existe um mecanismo de capitalizao contingente, nos termos do qual o Fundo de Resoluo, enquanto acionista, se compromete a realizar injees de capital (mximo de 3,89 mil milhes de euros ao longo de 8 anos) no caso de se materializarem certas condies cumulativas, relacionadas com:  i) perdas num conjunto delimitado de ativos do Novo Banco, que totalizam 7,8 mil milhes de euros e  ii) a evoluo dos nveis de capitalizao do banco. o A finalizao desta operao de venda encontra-se dependente da concretizao de um exerccio de gesto de passivos, sujeito a adeso dos obrigacionistas, que ir abranger as obrigaes no subordinadas do Novo Banco, cujos termos esto a ser finalizados.  Esta estabilizao progressiva dos quatro bancos sistmicos nacionais s foi conseguida atravs de um grande esforo concertado entre as administraes dos bancos, os seus acionistas, as distintas autoridades de superviso nacionais (com particular nota para a total articulao com a CMVM) e o Governo (particularmente, mas no s, no caso da Caixa Geral de Depsitos].  Tambm a nvel Europeu, com a Direo Geral da Concorrncia mas sobretudo no contexto do Mecanismo nico de Superviso (SSM) - a quem cabe a superviso direta destas instituies  a interao tem sido intensa:  Apenas a ttulo indicativo, desde 1 de julho de 2016 participei em 50 reunies das estruturas europeias de superviso, entre o Conselho de Superviso (Supervisory Board)  que rene em Frankfurt durante dois dias e meio de quinze em quinze dias -, o seu Comit Executivo e o Forum Macroprudencial (que agrega o Conselho de Governadores e o Conselho de Superviso). Note-se que no Conselho de Superviso s em escassas sesses no foi discutido em profundidade qualquer banco portugus (com anlises detalhadas das posies de capital e de liquidez, etc. e consequentes imposies em matria de superviso).  No quero com isto dizer que o setor bancrio est com todos os problemas resolvidos.  Mesmo nesta fase de estabilizao inicial, na qual os progressos so inegveis, ainda falta finalizar a venda do Novo Banco e garantir a estabilizao da Caixa Econmica Montepio Geral, por exemplo. No entanto, ambos os processos esto em curso e a ser acompanhados de muito perto.  Em termos do setor bancrio como um todo, alguns indicadores podem ajudar a percecionar o grande ajustamento do setor bancrio Portugus: o Desalavancagem significativa: Ativos totais reduziram de 526 mil milhes de euros em 2010 para 386 mil milhes de euros em 2016 o Reforo dos nveis de solvncia: Aumento do rcio de capital de 7.4% em 2010 (Core Tier 1) para 11.4% em 2016 (Common Equity Tier 1) [quebra de srie]; o Melhoria de liquidez: o rcio (de transformao) entre emprstimos e depsitos (loan-to-deposit ratio) reduziu de cerca de 150% no fim de 2010 para cerca de 96% no fim de 2016; o Maior eficincia: o rcio entre custos e receitas (cost-to-income) atingiu um pico de 72% no final de 2013 e situa-se agora perto de 60%;  Em termos comparativos europeus (mdia dos bancos do Mecanismo nico de Superviso), hoje os bancos portugueses apresentam Resultados Brutos de Explorao em percentagem do capital prprio muito semelhantes, um total de receitas em percentagem do capital prprio ligeiramente inferior aos pares, mas um impacto dos custos operacionais ligeiramente mais favorvel.  A grande diferena registada na rendibilidade dos capitais prprios (return on equity; RoE) face aos pares, s se evidencia quando os Bancos Portugueses tm de registar as imparidades decorrentes do seu elevado nvel de ativos no produtivos (NPLs).  Da a importncia do trabalho que, de forma articulada com os principais detentores de NPLs, BdP, Governo e a Unidade Capitalizar (que rene vrios ministrios) tm vindo a desenvolver no sentido de ajudar o setor a acelerar a reduo dos ativos no produtivos do seu balano.  Apesar da gravidade do problema, que persiste, importa reconhecer o progresso alcanado desde junho de 2016. O total de ativos no produtivos (incluindo emprstimos mas tambm outros ativos  Non Performing Exposures, NPE) reduziu-se em cerca de 3.5 mil milhes de euros entre junho e dezembro de 2016, alcanando aproximadamente 48 mil milhes de euros em dezembro de 2016. Considerando apenas um dos mais relevantes segmentos deste bolo, releva que os emprstimos no produtivos das Sociedades No Financeiras diminuram 3 mil milhes de euros neste espao de 6 meses, ou seja 8.9%.  Considerando o rcio de ativos no produtivos, este reduziu-se em 0.3 p.p. entre 2015 e 2016. O decrscimo continuou no primeiro trimestre de 2017, tendo este indicador atingido 16.7% em maro.  A reduo em termos absolutos  ainda mais significativa do que o rcio em si pois este incorpora o efeito denominador, ou seja, a diminuio do total de emprstimos no mbito do necessrio ajustamento de balano aps a crise.  Por fim,  de mencionar o esforo paralelo dos bancos em aumentar a cobertura dos emprstimos no produtivos por imparidades, tendo o respetivo rcio aumentado de 41% em 2015 para 45% em 2016.  Dito isto, h ainda um longo caminho a percorrer.  No entanto, a recuperao da economia abre renovadas oportunidades de negcio que so um elemento importante neste processo.  Por ltimo, importa no ignorar os debates em curso ao nvel da Unio Europeia nomeadamente no quadro da reviso da legislao bancria, bem como reconhecer as limitaes que o atual quadro de uma Unio Bancria incompleta quotidianamente impem ao processo de recuperao em progresso.

Title: Initial intervention of the Director of the Department of Behavioral Supervision of Banco de Portugal in COFAP on Bill 826/XII/4  Simplification and standardization of the commissioning of deposit accounts to order
text: Initial intervention of the Director of the Department of Behavioral Supervision of Banco de Portugal at COFAP on Bill 826/XII/4th  Simplification and standardization of the commissioning of deposit accounts to order1 1 Prepared for presentation. Exmos. Gentlemen I would first like to thank Banco de Portugal for its invitation to this hearing on Bill 826/XII/4 on "Simplification and standardization of commissioning of deposit accounts to order". As part of my exhibition, I will discuss in summary the themes present in this draft diploma that refer to: (a) the minimum banking services scheme; and (b) transparency in the collection of commissions by credit institutions. With regard to minimum banking services, I would like to begin by highlighting developments since the end of 2012, when there has been a major change in this scheme. Indeed, as V's knowledge is known. For example, the minimum banking services regime, in force since 2000, was the subject of (a thorough) review in 2011, at the initiative of the Assembly of the Republic (Law No. 19/2011 of 20 May), which established the possibility of converting deposit accounts to order in accounts of minimum banking services and established obligations to disclose these accounts by credit institutions and Social Security. This revision was consolidated in 2012 (Decree-Law No. 225/2012, of October 17), with the creation of new information duties for credit institutions, the publication of new protocols for the association of the minimum banking services regime and the allocation of supervisory and sanctioning powers to Banco de Portugal. Following these changes to the applicable legal framework, minimum banking services have become accessible to all customers who hold only one current account in the system and have increased their disclosure to the general public. The participating credit institutions now have to post posters at each counter (and on the internet) and advertise the marketing of this type of account on the first account statement each year. The law also required the publicization of the account of minimum banking services by Social Security (through information contained in the communications addressed to holders of social benefits). In parallel, Banco de Portugal also considered promoting minimum banking services, including through the Banking Client Portal and initiatives of the National Financial Training Plan. In this context, the number of minimum banking accounts has more than quadrupled since 2012 [there were 3,371 minimum service accounts in 2012, as opposed to 13,884 accounts at the end of 2014]. More specifically, in 2014, 5,172 minimum bank service accounts were opened and 1,572 existing accounts were converted into minimum bank accounts. The number of institutions adhering to the minimum banking services regime increased in mid-2014, also under Banco de Portugal's Circular Charter No. 24/2014/DSC, which invited credit institutions to join this regime. Currently, the credit institutions that provide the minimum banking services represent about 90 percent of the deposit accounts in the order in Portugal. It should be noted, in this regard, that, despite the fact that Banco de Portugal has been monitoring for some years the evolution of data on minimum banking services (giving public note of the evolution of this regime), with Instruction No. 43/2012 of Banco de Portugal, the institutions began to communicate, every six months, the information elements contained in the report map, namely: (i) changes in the number of minimum bank service accounts during the reference period; (ii) requests for the opening of minimum banking and conversion account accounts which were refused during the reference period; and (iii) charges associated with minimum bank services accounts. Banco de Portugal periodically discloses data on the evolution of minimum banking services through the Behavioral Supervision Report and the Behavioral Supervision Activities Report, as well as the Banking Customer Portal. With regard to the account maintenance fee charged on minimum service accounts, two institutions (Banco BPI and Caixa Geral de Depositos) do not charge maintenance commission (0) and the remaining institutions charge amounts close to the maximum legally established commission (5.05). With regard to the bill, and more precisely to the provision providing for "the provision of minimum banking services by credit institutions accepting retail bank deposits", I would recall the call made by Banco de Portugal to credit institutions, through Circular Letter No. 24/2014/DSC of 10 March 2014, to adhere to minimum banking services. Although not all have yet to accede to this request, the participating institutions today cover a wide range of banking customers and ensure the geographical coverage of the national territory. However, I would like to point out that not all institutions accepting deposits provide all the services included in the minimum banking services scheme, so I would suggest that this situation should be considered in the text of the draft diploma. With regard to the exception provided for in Article 4(2) of this draft, we may be allowed to suggest that this standard should be included in Article 4b, as it is understood that there is an exception to the rules on the ownership of minimum bank accounts. Moreover, the wording of that provision seems to point only to its application in cases where the accounts of minimum banking services have only two holders, so that, if that is not the objective of the legislature, it is suggested that that will be made explicit. Let me now make a brief reference to the commissioning proposals. I would like to begin by recalling you. that Notice No. 8/2009 of Banco de Portugal, which established the obligation for credit institutions to provide "the full pricing of the general conditions with the effects of carrying out the operations and the financial products and services marketed to the public", defines the commissions as the "pecuniary services payable to customers by credit institutions as remuneration for services provided by them, subcontractors to third parties in the course of their activity." As regards expenditure, the aforementioned Notice defines the concept in the following terms: ''expenses': other charges incurred by credit institutions, which are payable to them by third parties and pass on to customers, in particular payments to Conservatoires, Notarial Notarial, or tax-proofing'. In turn, the concept of charges covers "commissions" and "expenses". After the publication of Notice No. 8/2009, the concepts of "commissions" and "expenses" were also enshrined in the other regulatory diplomas of Banco de Portugal and in various legal provisions, currently corresponding to stable realities widely known by bank customers and credit institutions. It is understood that these concepts are mirrored in Article 3 of the bill under consideration, which explains the principle that "The collection of commissions by credit institutions must correspond to a service actually provided". As for the obligation to send an annual invoice receipt, which details all commissions and expenses associated with a current deposit account, provided for in the draft diploma under consideration, it is recalled that the Payment Accounts Directive (the provisions of which will apply from September 2016) provides for the issue of an "extract" frequently, at least, annual detailing all commissions charged under a payment account. I would therefore ask whether the legislature intends to anticipate this Community standard in the national legislative framework. Otherwise, if the objective is different, it would be suggested that account should be taken of the obligations arising from this Directive which will enter into force next year and whose harmonised implementation at European level is being prepared by the European Banking Authority (work in which Banco de Portugal is deeply committed). In fact, Banco de Portugal has been actively following the work of transposition of the Payment Accounts Directive (2) (transposition, as mentioned, must take place up to 18 (2) Directive 2014/92/EU of the European Parliament and the Council of 23 July 2014 on the comparability of commissions related to payment accounts, the change of payment account and access to basicly characteristic payment accounts. september 2016), also participating in the work associated with the implementation of this Directive which are being developed by the European Banking Authority (EBA) (September 2016), also participating in the work associated with the implementation of this Directive which are being developed by the European Banking Authority (EBA) (September 2016), also participating in the work associated with the implementation of this Directive that are being developed by the European Banking Authority (EBA) ((3) Guidelines on national provisional lists of the most representative services linked to a payment account and subject to a fee under the Payment Accounts Directive (2014/92/EU). This Directive, as you will know, presents three pillars of action  transparency in commissioning, switching between credit institutions and access to payment accounts with basic characteristics. With regard to the chapter on commissioning of this Directive, the work carried out by Banco de Portugal has focused on identifying the most representative services associated with payment accounts and subject to commissions at national level, which has implied an extensive reflection on the concept of commission and the service associated with it. Turning now to the proposal to amend the Legal Regime of the cheque without provision, I would point out that the bill states that "all expenses associated with the return of the cheque constitute an exclusive charge of the payer". It follows from that standard that the beneficiary of a cheque covered by that provision shall be exempted from the payment of expenditure. Bearing in mind the concepts of "commission" and "expenditure", the reference only to "expenses" does not change the possibility of collecting commissions from the beneficiary. In addition, most credit institutions currently charge commissions, with emphasis on the commission for returning a check without provision. Thus, if the current wording of the standard is to be uphold, only any expenses would be exempt. If the objective of the legislator is broader, it would be suggested that the wording of the standard be adjusted accordingly. In that regard, I would like to remind you that the return of a cheque does not prevent it from being subsequently regularised by the sacador and the commission being charged to the beneficiary, regardless of that fact. According to the manual of procedures approved between credit institutions, Banco de Portugal and SIBS, the credit institution, in case of return of a check to the beneficiary, provides the return service of that same check. This service may go through (i) manually search for the physical check, (ii) stamp the check with the reason for return, (iii) send the cheque stamped by mail (registered) to the beneficiary and (iv) send the image of the cheque stamped to the bank withdrawn. This is a procedure that goes out of the normal automated check handling circuit. As a rule, credit institutions, under the principle of contractual freedom and private autonomy, set the value of commissions as remuneration for those services. However, the return of a cheque is usually verified by the performance of the sacador, assuming the beneficiary a position of subjection (i.e. a more "passive" position). Accordingly, and although the provision of a service is at issue, that does not preclude the commission from being subject to limitation or prohibition by decision by decision of the legislature, as was the case in certain cases where the legislature prohibited commissions or set maximum values. Having said that, the legislator may always consider safeguarding the consumer's interest in the present case, in order to prohibit the collection of commission and/or expenses to be charged to the beneficiary for returning a cheque without provision. Lucia Leitao Lisbon, 7 April 2015
text_original: Interveno inicial da Diretora do Departamento de Superviso Comportamental do Banco de Portugal na COFAP sobre o Projeto de Lei 826/XII/4  Simplificao e padronizao do comissionamento de contas de depsito  ordem1 1 Preparada para apresentao. Exmos. Senhores Deputados, Gostaria, em primeiro lugar, de agradecer o convite formulado ao Banco de Portugal para esta audio sobre o Projeto de Lei 826/XII/4, relativo  Simplificao e padronizao do comissionamento de contas de depsito  ordem. No mbito da minha exposio, abordarei de forma sumria os temas presentes neste projeto de diploma que se referem: (a) Ao regime dos servios mnimos bancrios; e (b)  transparncia na cobrana de comisses pelas instituies de crdito. No que toca aos servios mnimos bancrios, gostaria de comear por destacar a evoluo registada desde finais de 2012, altura em que ocorreu uma importante alterao deste regime. Com efeito, como  do conhecimento de V. Exas., o regime dos servios mnimos bancrios, em vigor desde 2000, foi objeto de (uma profunda) reviso em 2011, por iniciativa da Assembleia da Repblica (Lei n. 19/2011, de 20 de maio), que consagrou a possibilidade de converso de contas de depsito  ordem em contas de servios mnimos bancrios e estabeleceu obrigaes de divulgao destas contas por parte das instituies de crdito e da Segurana Social. Esta reviso foi consolidada em 2012 (Decreto-Lei n. 225/2012, de 17 de outubro), com a criao de novos deveres de informao para as instituies de crdito, a publicao de novos protocolos de adeso ao regime dos servios mnimos bancrios e a atribuio de poderes de fiscalizao e de sancionamento ao Banco de Portugal. Na sequncia destas alteraes ao quadro legal aplicvel, os servios mnimos bancrios tornaram-se acessveis a todos os clientes que detm no sistema apenas uma conta  ordem e aumentou a sua divulgao junto do pblico em geral. As instituies de crdito aderentes passaram a ter de afixar cartazes em cada balco (e na internet) e de anunciar a comercializao deste tipo de conta no primeiro extrato de conta de cada ano. A lei passou a obrigar tambm  publicitao da conta de servios mnimos bancrios pela Segurana Social (mediante informao constante das comunicaes dirigidas aos titulares de prestaes sociais). Em paralelo, o Banco de Portugal tambm entendeu promover os servios mnimos bancrios, nomeadamente atravs do Portal do Cliente Bancrio e de iniciativas do Plano Nacional de Formao Financeira. Neste contexto, o nmero de contas de servios mnimos bancrios mais do que quadruplicou desde 2012 [existiam 3.371 contas de servios mnimos em 2012, por oposio a 13.884 contas no final de 2014]. Mais concretamente, no ano de 2014, foram abertas 5.172 contas de servios mnimos bancrios e convertidas 1.572 contas j existentes em contas de servios mnimos bancrios. O nmero de instituies aderentes ao regime dos servios mnimos bancrios aumentou em meados de 2014, tambm por fora da Carta Circular n. 24/2014/DSC, do Banco de Portugal, que convidou as instituies de crdito a aderirem a este regime. Atualmente, as instituies de crdito que disponibilizam os servios mnimos bancrios representam cerca de 90 por cento das contas de depsito  ordem em Portugal. Refira-se, a propsito, que, no obstante o Banco de Portugal monitorizar, h alguns anos, a evoluo dos dados relativos aos servios mnimos bancrios (dando pblica nota da evoluo deste regime), com a Instruo n. 43/2012 do Banco de Portugal, as instituies passaram a comunicar, com periodicidade semestral, os elementos informativos constantes do mapa de reporte, designadamente: (i) As alteraes registadas no nmero de contas de servios mnimos bancrios durante o perodo de referncia; (ii) Os pedidos de abertura de contas de servios mnimos bancrios e de converso que foram recusados durante o perodo de referncia; e (iii) Os encargos associados s contas de servios mnimos bancrios. O Banco de Portugal divulga periodicamente os dados relativos  evoluo dos servios mnimos bancrios atravs do Relatrio de Superviso Comportamental e do Relatrio de Atividades de Superviso Comportamental, bem como do Portal do Cliente Bancrio. No que respeita  comisso de manuteno de conta cobrada nas contas de servios mnimos, duas instituies (Banco BPI e Caixa Geral de Depsitos) no cobram comisso de manuteno (0 ) e as restantes instituies cobram valores prximos da comisso mxima legalmente estabelecida (5,05 ). No que se refere ao projeto de lei, e mais precisamente  disposio que prev a disponibilizao dos servios mnimos bancrios pelas instituies de crdito que aceitam depsitos bancrios a retalho, relembraria o apelo formulado pelo Banco de Portugal s instituies de crdito, atravs da Carta Circular n. 24/2014/DSC, de 10 de maro de 2014, para aderirem aos servios mnimos bancrios. Pese embora nem todas tenham ainda acedido a esta solicitao, as instituies aderentes cobrem, hoje, um vasto conjunto de clientes bancrios e asseguram a cobertura geogrfica do territrio nacional. Porm, gostaria de salientar que nem todas as instituies que aceitam depsitos disponibilizam todos os servios includos no regime de servios mnimos bancrios, pelo que me permitiria sugerir a ponderao desta situao no texto do projeto de diploma. Relativamente  exceo prevista no n. 2 do artigo 4. deste projeto, seja-nos permitida a sugesto de essa norma passar a constar do artigo 4.-B, por se entender estar em causa uma exceo s normas relativas  titularidade de contas de servios mnimos bancrios. Ademais, a redao deste preceito parece apontar apenas para a sua aplicao nos casos em que as contas de servios mnimos bancrios tenham apenas dois titulares, pelo que, se no for esse o objetivo do legislador, se sugere a explicitao dessa vontade. Permitam-me agora que faa uma breve referncia s propostas relativas ao comissionamento. Gostaria de comear por recordar a V. Exas. que o Aviso n. 8/2009 do Banco de Portugal, que veio instituir a obrigao de as instituies de crdito disponibilizarem o prerio completo das condies gerais com efeitos patrimoniais de realizao das operaes e dos produtos e servios financeiros comercializados junto do pblico, define as comisses como as prestaes pecunirias exigveis aos clientes pelas instituies de crdito como retribuio por servios por elas prestados, ou subcontratados a terceiros, no mbito da sua atividade. No que toca a despesas, o citado Aviso define o conceito nos seguintes termos: Despesas: os demais encargos suportados pelas instituies de crdito, que lhes so exigveis por terceiros e repercutveis nos clientes, nomeadamente os pagamentos a Conservatrias, Cartrios Notariais, ou que tenham natureza fiscal. Por sua vez, o conceito de encargos abrange as comisses e as despesas. Aps a publicao do Aviso n. 8/2009, os conceitos de comisses e despesas foram consagrados tambm nos demais diplomas regulamentares do Banco de Portugal e em vrios diplomas legais, correspondendo, atualmente, a realidades estveis e amplamente conhecidas pelos clientes bancrios e pelas instituies de crdito. Entende-se que estes conceitos esto espelhados no artigo 3. do projeto de lei em anlise, que explicita o princpio de que A cobrana de comisses pelas instituies de crdito tem de corresponder a um servio efetivamente prestado. Quanto  obrigao de envio anual de uma fatura-recibo, que detalhe todas as comisses e despesas associadas a uma conta de depsitos  ordem, prevista no projeto de diploma em anlise, relembra-se que a Diretiva das Contas de Pagamento (cujas disposies sero aplicveis a partir de setembro de 2016) prev a emisso de um extrato com frequncia, pelo menos, anual que detalhe todas as comisses cobradas no mbito de uma conta de pagamentos. Assim, permitir-me-ia questionar se o legislador pretende antecipar no quadro legislativo nacional esta norma comunitria. Caso contrrio, se o objetivo for diverso, sugerir-se-ia que se tivesse em linha de conta as obrigaes decorrentes desta diretiva que entraro em vigor no prximo ano e cuja implementao harmonizada a nvel europeu est a ser preparada pela Autoridade Bancria Europeia (trabalhos em que o Banco de Portugal est profundamente empenhado). Com efeito, o Banco de Portugal tem acompanhado ativamente os trabalhos de transposio da Diretiva das Contas de Pagamento (2) (a transposio, como referido, deve ocorrer at 18 (2) Diretiva 2014/92/UE do Parlamento Europeu e do Conselho de 23 de julho de 2014 relativa  comparabilidade de comisses relacionadas com as contas de pagamento,  mudana de conta de pagamento e ao acesso a contas de pagamento com caractersticas bsicas. de setembro de 2016), participando tambm nos trabalhos associados  implementao desta Diretiva que esto a ser desenvolvidos pela Autoridade Bancria Europeia (EBA) (de setembro de 2016), participando tambm nos trabalhos associados  implementao desta Diretiva que esto a ser desenvolvidos pela Autoridade Bancria Europeia (EBA) (de setembro de 2016), participando tambm nos trabalhos associados  implementao desta Diretiva que esto a ser desenvolvidos pela Autoridade Bancria Europeia (EBA) ((3) Guidelines on national provisional lists of the most representative services linked to a payment account and subject to a fee under the Payment Accounts Directive (2014/92/EU). Esta Diretiva, como ser do conhecimento de V. Exas., apresenta trs pilares de atuao  transparncia no comissionamento, mudana de conta entre instituies de crdito (switching) e acesso a contas de pagamento com caractersticas bsicas. Relativamente ao captulo sobre comissionamento da referida Diretiva, o trabalho desenvolvido pelo Banco de Portugal tem-se centrado na identificao dos servios mais representativos associados a contas de pagamento e sujeitos a comisses a nvel nacional, o que tem implicado uma extensa reflexo sobre o conceito de comisso e do servio que lhe est associado. Passando agora  proposta de alterao do Regime Jurdico do cheque sem proviso, salientaria que o projeto de lei refere que todas as despesas associadas  devoluo do cheque constituem um encargo exclusivo do sacador. Decorre desta norma que o beneficirio de um cheque abrangido por esta disposio fica isento do pagamento de despesas. Tendo presente os conceitos de comisso e de despesa, a referncia apenas a despesas no altera a possibilidade de cobrana de comisses ao beneficirio. Acresce que, atualmente, a maioria das instituies de crdito cobra comisses, com destaque para a comisso por devoluo de cheque sem proviso. Assim, a manter-se a atual redao da norma, s eventuais despesas ficariam isentas. Se o objetivo do legislador for mais amplo, sugerir-se-ia que a redao da norma seja ajustada em conformidade. A este propsito, gostaria de recordar que a devoluo de um cheque no impede que o mesmo seja posteriormente regularizado pelo sacador, sendo a comisso cobrada ao beneficirio, independentemente desse facto. De acordo com o manual de procedimentos aprovado entre as instituies de crdito, o Banco de Portugal e a SIBS, a instituio de crdito, em caso de devoluo de um cheque ao beneficirio, presta o servio de devoluo desse mesmo cheque. Este servio pode passar por (i) procurar, manualmente, o cheque fsico, (ii) carimbar o cheque com o motivo de devoluo, (iii) enviar o cheque carimbado por correio (registado) ao beneficirio e (iv) remeter imagem do cheque carimbado ao banco sacado. Trata-se de um procedimento que sai do circuito normal de tratamento automatizado de cheques. Ora, em regra, as instituies de crdito, ao abrigo do princpio da liberdade contratual e da autonomia privada, fixam o valor de comisses como retribuio por estes servios. Todavia, a devoluo de um cheque verifica-se, em regra, por fora da atuao do sacador, assumindo o beneficirio uma posio de sujeio (isto , uma posio mais passiva). Assim sendo, e apesar de estar em causa a prestao de um servio, tal no obsta a que, por deciso do legislador, a comisso seja objeto de limitao ou proibio, como o foi em determinados casos em que o legislador proibiu comisses ou fixou valores mximos. Posto isto, o legislador poder sempre ponderar tutelar o interesse do consumidor no caso concreto, no sentido de proibir a cobrana de comisso e/ou despesas a cobrar ao beneficirio por devoluo de cheque sem proviso. Lcia Leito Lisboa, 7 de abril de 2015

Title: Initial intervention of Deputy Governor Elisa Ferreira at the Banking Forum: "Banking system in Portugal: evolution and challenges"
text: BANKING FORUM NOVEMBER 29, 2017 Initial Intervention of the Deputy Governor of Banco de Portugal Elisa Ferreira1 1 Prepared for presentation. "Banking system in Portugal: evolution and challenges" Ladies and gentlemen, I am happy to participate in this edition of the Banking Forum promoted by the Economic Journal and PwC. The quality of the participants and the selected themes make the reflection very timely and constructive. I greet the organization and greet all the participants. I begin by thanking me for the invitation addressed to me for this inaugural intervention; I propose to address some of the elements that I consider most relevant on the recent evolution of the banking system in Portugal and identify some of the main future challenges. After a difficult and prolonged period following the 2007/08 crisis, in a changing international context including regulatory and institutional level, I believe that the progress made in recent years by the banking system in Portugal is undeniable, especially with regard to reducing uncertainties and strengthening its credibility and trust. The sector is now better prepared to provide the necessary financing for the development of the Portuguese economy. Taking the banking sector as a whole, some indicators can help to perceive the large adjustment operated in Portugal:  Significant reduction in accumulated risk through the deleveraging of the banking system which adjusted total assets from 526 billion in 2010 to 386.4 billion in June 2017.  Strengthening solvency levels, with the best quality capital ratio increasing from 7.4% in 2010 (Core Tier 1) to 13.2% in June 2017 (Common Equity Tier 1), a conclusion that remains valid despite adjustments to definitions;  Improved liquidity, with the loan-to-deposit ratio (transformation) falling from around 150% at the end of 2010 to around 94% in June 2017;  Increased efficiency, with the cost-to-income ratio falling from 72% at the end of 2013 to 60% (60.4% in June 2017);  Adjustment of installed capacity, with a decrease of about 30% of the number of branches, 1,852 (to 4,454), and a reduction of about 19% in the number of employees, minus 11,000 (to 46,069), was observed between 2011 and 2016. As a result of the adjustment made, the Portuguese has been experiencing a recovery in activity since the second half of 2013, with emphasis on the main variables:  More balanced financing profile, on the one hand, the resources of the Eurosystem and other central banks fell to 6.6% of the assets (25 billion euros) in June 2017, which is almost half the amount recorded in June 2012 (12.6% of the Asset). In addition, customer deposits totaling 228 billion in 2010 and financing 43.4% of assets increased stably (including during the economic and financial assistance programme), reaching 247 billion (64.3% of assets) in June 2017;  Recovery of financial margin, the main source of revenue, has benefited mainly from the adjustment of liabilities prices, with the rate of interest paid decreasing significantly as the rates of private deposits decrease;  Potential improvement of operational efficiency, operating costs represented, in June 2017, the same as in 2010 (1.5% of the Asset); however, restructuring programs still in progress (with upfront costs) support the expectation of improved operational efficiency by moving to "cruising speed" in terms of operating costs. In European comparative terms, banks in Portugal now report Gross Operating Results as a percentage of equity very similar to the average of the banks of the Single Supervisory Mechanism  SSM, a total revenue as a percentage of equity slightly lower, but a slightly more favourable impact of operating costs. The large difference in the profitability of equity against peers stems mainly from the fact that Portuguese banks have to register significant amounts of oddities to cover their non-performing assets (NPL). Although non-performing assets remain at levels above the European average, it is also important here to recognise the progress achieved since the maximum figure observed in June 2016. From that date until June 2017, i.e. within a year, total non-performing assets (including loans but also other assets  Non Performing Exposures, NPE) have been reduced by around 8.2 billion to approximately 42.3 billion. In terms of non-performing asset ratio, the reduction was 2.4 p.p. in the same period, up 15.5% in June 2017. The reduction in absolute terms is more significant than the ratio itself as it incorporates the denominator effect, i.e. the decrease in total loans under the necessary balance sheet adjustment after the crisis. Finally, it is also important to mention the parallel effort of banks in relation to the increase in coverage of non-performing loans due to odd loans, with their ratio increasing from 41% in 2015 to 45.9% in June 2017. Despite this positive development, the effort still needed to reduce non-productive assets to more sustainable levels is considerable. It is in this context that the work that has been developed to accelerate the reduction of these assets in the balance sheet of banks in Portugal is of particular importance. At national level, the strategy for reducing non-performing assets is primarily based on three interdependent and complementary pillars: i) review of the legal, judicial and fiscal framework; (ii) microprudential supervision actions, articulated within the SSM, with emphasis on banks' commitment to ambitious (but realistic) plans for the timed reduction of NPL; and iii) management of NPL portfolios, where the initiative to establish the Integrated Bank Credit Management Platform stands out, which should be operational in the short term, dedicated to the coordinated management of credits granted to non-financial corporations with cross-exposures to several banks. In short, despite the remarkable progress made over the past few years, there is still a lot of work to be done in a demanding and not yet stabilised regulatory context. In this context, the ongoing discussions at EU level should be closely monitored, in particular as regards the revision of banking legislation implementation of the different aspects of the Banking Union. In both cases, the defense of the national interest involves the clear identification of objectives and the maximization of the combined capacity of influence of all actors, including, of course, that of the national banking system. The transition to the new post-crisis regulatory framework  including the introduction of the IFRS9 accounting standard and compliance with the minimum requirements for liabilities that can absorb losses in case of resolution (MREL)  entails enormous challenges for which the banking system in Portugal needs to prepare with the greatest urgency, challenges that are substantially aggravated by the current degree of "incompleteness" of the Banking Union. In parallel with the fulfillment of these new regulatory requirements, it is also pressing that the banking system in Portugal adjusts its business models in order to integrate and revert to its benefit the current technological innovation, with special emphasis on FinTech. The best way for a market participant to anticipate and assume the challenges and impacts posed by technological advances is to put oneself at the center of technological innovation, so that it can be understood and oriented towards the proper functioning, efficiency, safety and confidence in the services provided. Changing the FinTech-induced business model is one of the supervisory priorities. Both The EBA and the SSM, of which Banco de Portugal is an active member, have ongoing regulatory and supervisory initiatives to respond to the challenges arising from FinTech, following a principle of "the same activity, the same risk, the same rules". On the side of Banco de Portugal, a multidisciplinary reflection group was set up to study the evolution of Banca Digital and FinTech and to look at, in the 2020 horizon, the challenges that arise in the broader context of its mission and in the specific framework of its regulatory and supervisory responsibilities. The EBA, for its part, has ongoing work on: (i) the perimeter and adequacy of the current regulation, and (ii) an appropriate assessment of the risks arising from new technologies, in prudential terms, the protection of financial consumers, the prevention of money laundering and the ability to implement resolution measures if necessary. With regard to the SSM, and following the end of the public consultation earlier this month, the guide to the evaluation of applications for authorisation of entities with a business model based on financial technology is being finalised. FinTech represents, above all, an inevitable change in the way financial services will be made available and in the way of interaction with customers; the market is inevitably becoming more competitive through margin squeeze and the provision of services competing with those of traditional banking. Although FinTech is one of the main sources of disupage for installed financial institutions, the degree of preparation of the sector is still manifestly insufficient2, which recommends an enhanced focus on the subject. 2 KPMG (2017), Forging the Future, How financial institutions are embracing fintech to evolve and grow. I end by appealing that this event contribute to a closer proximity between the banking system in Portugal and all potential providers of new technological solutions, be they the most traditional or FinTech. Thank you very much and I hope that it will be a very fruitful session for everyone.
text_original: FRUM BANCA 29 DE NOVEMBRO DE 2017 Interveno Inicial da Vice-Governadora do Banco de Portugal Elisa Ferreira1 1 Preparado para apresentao. Sistema bancrio em Portugal: evoluo e desafios Minhas Senhoras e Meus Senhores,  com muito gosto que participo nesta edio do Frum Banca promovida pelo Jornal Econmico e pela PwC. A qualidade dos participantes e os temas selecionados tornam a reflexo muito oportuna e construtiva. Cumprimento a organizao e sado todos os participantes. Comeo por agradecer o convite que me foi dirigido para esta interveno inaugural; proponho-me abordar alguns dos elementos que considero mais relevantes sobre a evoluo recente do sistema bancrio em Portugal e identificar alguns dos principais desafios futuros. Aps um difcil e prolongado perodo que se seguiu  crise de 2007/08, num contexto internacional em mutao incluindo a nvel regulamentar e institucional, considero que os progressos realizados em anos recentes pelo sistema bancrio em Portugal so inegveis, sobretudo no que se refere  reduo das incertezas e ao robustecimento da sua credibilidade e confiana. O setor est hoje melhor preparado para disponibilizar o financiamento necessrio ao desenvolvimento da economia portuguesa. Tomando o setor bancrio como um todo, alguns indicadores podem ajudar a percecionar o grande ajustamento operado em Portugal:  Reduo significativa do risco acumulado, atravs da desalavancagem do sistema bancrio que ajustou os ativos totais dos 526 mil milhes de euros em 2010 para os 386.4 mil milhes de euros em junho de 2017.  Reforo dos nveis de solvabilidade, com o rcio de capital de melhor qualidade a aumentar de 7.4% em 2010 (Core Tier 1) para 13.2% em junho de 2017 (Common Equity Tier 1), concluso que continua vlida apesar dos ajustamentos das definies;  Melhoria da liquidez, com o rcio (de transformao) entre emprstimos e depsitos (loan-to-deposit ratio) a baixar de cerca de 150% no fim de 2010 para cerca de 94% em junho de 2017;  Maior eficincia, com o rcio entre custos e receitas (cost-to-income) a baixar de 72% no final de 2013 para 60% (60.4% em junho 2017);  Ajustamento da capacidade instalada, tendo sido observada, entre 2011 e 2016, uma diminuio de cerca de 30% do nmero de balces, menos 1.852 (para 4.454), e uma reduo de cerca de 19% do nmero de colaboradores, menos 11.000 (para 46.069). Fruto do ajustamento realizado, o sistema bancrio portugus tem vindo a registar uma recuperao da atividade desde o segundo semestre de 2013, com destaque para as principais variveis:  Perfil de financiamento mais equilibrado, por um lado, os recursos do Eurosistema e outros bancos centrais baixaram para 6.6% do ativo (25 mil milhes de euros), em junho de 2017, o que equivale praticamente a metade do montante registado em junho de 2012 (12.6% do Ativo). Adicionalmente, os depsitos de clientes que em 2010 ascendiam a 228 mil milhes de euros e financiavam 43.4% do ativo aumentaram de forma estvel (incluindo durante o programa de assistncia econmica e financeira), atingindo 247 mil milhes de euros (64.3% do Ativo) em junho de 2017;  Recuperao da margem financeira, a principal fonte de receitas, tem beneficiado essencialmente do ajustamento dos preos dos passivos, com a taxa dos juros pagos a diminuir significativamente  medida que as taxas dos depsitos de particulares diminuem;  Potencial melhoria de eficincia operacional, os custos operacionais representavam, em junho de 2017, o mesmo que em 2010 (1.5% do Ativo); no entanto, os programas de reestruturao ainda em curso (com custos upfront) permitem sustentar a expectativa de melhoria da eficincia operacional ao passar para velocidade de cruzeiro em termos de custos operacionais. Em termos comparativos europeus, os bancos em Portugal apresentam hoje Resultados Brutos de Explorao em percentagem do capital prprio muito semelhantes  mdia dos bancos do Mecanismo nico de Superviso  MUS, um total de receitas em percentagem do capital prprio ligeiramente inferior, mas um impacto dos custos operacionais ligeiramente mais favorvel. A grande diferena registada na rendibilidade dos capitais prprios face aos pares decorre fundamentalmente do facto de os bancos portugueses terem de registar valores significativos de imparidades para cobertura dos seus ativos no produtivos (NPL). Apesar de os ativos no produtivos permanecerem em nveis acima da mdia europeia, importa, tambm aqui, reconhecer o progresso alcanado desde o valor mximo observado em junho de 2016. Desde essa data at junho de 2017, isto , no espao de um ano, o total de ativos no produtivos (incluindo emprstimos mas tambm outros ativos  Non Performing Exposures, NPE) foi reduzido em cerca de 8.2 mil milhes de euros, alcanando aproximadamente 42.3 mil milhes de euros. Em termos de rcio de ativos no produtivos, a reduo foi de 2.4 p.p. no mesmo perodo, situando-se em 15.5% em junho de 2017. A reduo em termos absolutos  mais significativa do que o rcio em si pois este incorpora o efeito denominador, ou seja, a diminuio do total de emprstimos no mbito do necessrio ajustamento de balano aps a crise. Por fim, importa ainda mencionar o esforo paralelo dos bancos em relao ao aumento da cobertura dos emprstimos no produtivos por imparidades, tendo o respetivo rcio aumentado de 41% em 2015 para 45.9% em junho de 2017. No obstante esta evoluo positiva, o esforo ainda necessrio para reduzir os ativos no produtivos para nveis mais sustentveis  considervel.  neste contexto que assumem especial relevncia os trabalhos que tm vindo a ser desenvolvidos para acelerar a reduo destes ativos no balano dos bancos em Portugal. A nvel nacional, a estratgia de reduo de ativos no produtivos assenta primordialmente em trs pilares interdependentes e complementares: i) reviso do enquadramento legal, judicial e fiscal; ii) aes de superviso microprudencial, articuladas no mbito do MUS, com destaque para o compromisso dos bancos com planos ambiciosos (mas realistas) para a reduo calendarizada de NPL; e iii) gesto dos portflios de NPL, onde se destaca a iniciativa de constituio da Plataforma de Gesto Integrada de Crditos Bancrios, que dever entrar em funcionamento a breve prazo, dedicada  gesto coordenada de crditos concedidos a sociedades no financeiras com exposies cruzadas a vrios bancos. Em sntese, no obstante os progressos assinalveis verificados no decurso dos ltimos anos, h ainda muito trabalho a fazer num contexto regulatrio exigente e ainda no estabilizado. Neste contexto, importa acompanhar atentamente os debates em curso ao nvel da Unio Europeia nomeadamente no que se refere quer  reviso da legislao bancria em geral quer  concretizao das distintas vertentes da Unio Bancria. Nos dois casos, a defesa do interesse nacional passa pela identificao clara dos objetivos e pela maximizao da capacidade de influncia combinada de todos os atores, incluindo, naturalmente, a do sistema bancrio nacional. A transio para o novo enquadramento regulatrio ps-crise  incluindo a introduo da norma contabilstica IFRS9 e o cumprimento dos requisitos mnimos de passivos suscetveis de absorver perdas em caso de resoluo (MREL)  acarreta enormes desafios para os quais o sistema bancrio em Portugal precisa de se preparar com a maior urgncia, desafios esses substancialmente agravados pelo atual grau de incompletude da Unio Bancria. Em paralelo com o cumprimento destes novos requisitos regulatrios,  tambm premente que o sistema bancrio em Portugal ajuste os seus modelos de negcio de modo a integrar e reverter em seu benefcio a inovao tecnolgica em curso, com especial destaque para as FinTech. A melhor forma, para um participante no mercado, de antecipar e assumir desafios e impactos colocados pelos avanos tecnolgicos,  colocar-se no centro da inovao tecnolgica, de modo que esta possa ser compreendida e orientada no sentido do bom funcionamento, eficincia, segurana e confiana nos servios prestados. A alterao do modelo de negcio induzida pelas FinTech constitui uma das prioridades de superviso. Tanto a EBA, como o MUS, dos quais o Banco de Portugal  membro ativo, tm em curso iniciativas regulatrias e de superviso para responder aos desafios decorrentes das FinTech, seguindo um princpio de a mesma atividade, o mesmo risco, as mesmas regras. Do lado do Banco de Portugal, foi criado um grupo de reflexo multidisciplinar, com o objetivo de estudar a evoluo da Banca Digital e das FinTech e de perspetivar, no horizonte 2020, os desafios que se colocam no contexto alargado da sua misso e no quadro especfico das suas responsabilidades de regulao e superviso. A EBA tem, por seu lado, em curso trabalhos sobre: (i) o permetro e adequao da regulao vigente, e (ii) uma avaliao adequada dos riscos decorrentes das novas tecnologias, em termos prudenciais, de proteo dos consumidores financeiros, da preveno do branqueamento de capitais e da capacidade de aplicao de medidas de resoluo se necessrio. No que concerne ao MUS, e na sequncia do trmino da consulta pblica no incio deste ms, est a ser finalizado o guia para a avaliao de pedidos de autorizao de entidades com um modelo de negcio baseado em tecnologia financeira. As FinTech representam, acima de tudo, uma inevitvel mudana na forma como os servios financeiros sero disponibilizados e no modo de interao com os clientes; o mercado est a tornar-se inevitavelmente mais competitivo pela via da compresso de margens e disponibilizao de servios concorrentes com os da banca tradicional. Apesar de as FinTech serem uma das principais fontes de disrupo para as instituies financeiras instaladas, o grau de preparao do setor  ainda manifestamente insuficiente2, o que recomenda um enfoque reforado sobre o tema. 2 KPMG (2017), Forging the Future, How financial institutions are embracing fintech to evolve and grow. Termino apelando para que este evento contribua para uma maior proximidade entre o sistema bancrio em Portugal e todos os potenciais prestadores de novas solues tecnolgicas, sejam elas as mais tradicionais ou as FinTech. Muito obrigada e fao votos de que seja uma sesso muito proveitosa para todos.

Title: Initial intervention of Administrator Luis Maximo dos Santos at the hearing of the Committee on Budget, Finance and Administrative Modernization
text: Hearing in the Committee on Budget, Finance and Administrative Modernisation June 27, 2017 Initial Intervention of Administrator Luis Maximo dos Santos1 1 Prepared for presentation. Madam President, Ladies and gentlemen, 1. Just over a year ago  more specifically on 17 May 2016  I was heard in this Commission in the context of the procedure laid down in the law for the appointment of the directors of Banco de Portugal. In the opening statement I read to you and the Honourable Ladies, I set out the reasons why I accepted the invitation, highlighting that acceptance sat in place as an act consistent with my professional career of more than 30 years. I also tried to give my view on the role of Banco de Portugal in Portuguese society, to indicate the main challenges that, in my view, i was confronted, in a context that I described as profound change and great uncertainty, and I also mentioned the way I looked at the functions for which I was invited and that I actually started to exercise on June 20, 2016. Today it is certainly unsurprising that I am able to reaffirm everything I have mentioned then, in particular as to the full awareness of the dimension of the responsibilities involved, but also in the fact that I am encouraged by a spirit of total commitment and dedication. Serving Banco de Portugal  whatever the position or function  is for any Portuguese an honor, as it means serving one of the oldest and most relevant national institutions, whose history is confused with the history of modernity in Portugal, regardless of the vicissitudes of each epoch. 2. When I began functions as Administrator, I was assigned, on a proposal from the Governor, the portfolios corresponding to the Department of Behavioral Supervision, the Department of Investigation and Sanctioning Action and the Department of Legal Services. On 5 July 2016, the Board of Directors appointed me to chair the Deposit Guarantee Fund's Management Committee and, more recently, in March of this year, to chair the Resolution Fund's Directive Committee, and was also left with the resolution department, recently created for the purpose of giving the most appropriate organic expression to the autonomous exercise of the resolution function, which  it should be stressed  has already been a fact since such a mission was committed to Banco de Portugal. It is therefore normal for my vision of Banco de Portugal to be more in-depth and more detailed today, better aware of the problems and needs that exist, as well as the needs of its employees. Banco de Portugal is an institution aware of the centrality of its role in Portuguese society and is mobilized to face challenges of enormous demand. Symptomatically, the Board of Directors adopted as the motto of the Bank's Strategic Plan for the period 2017-2020 the expression "always to do better". It was not a difficult choice, because it was enough to be attentive to the state of mind of the generality of employees. In fact, we want a Bank of Portugal always with the ambition to improve and we do not feel prisoners of any past. Under this Plan, Banco de Portugal has defined four strategic guidelines, including: - Affirm internally and externally the bank's capabilities as a monetary authority; - Participate in the definition of regulatory frameworks and in the application of supervisory practices in order to ensure the robustness and stability of the national financial system and the confidence of economic agents, in particular by ensuring a balanced relationship between financial institutions and their clients, based on high standards of conduct and appropriate financial training; - Promote knowledge about the Portuguese economy and European integration, contributing to an enlightened and well-informed society; - To be one of the most efficient banks in the Eurosystem. This is, therefore, in summary, not only the management program but that of each and every employee of Banco de Portugal. 3. As a result of the convergent action of several agents, important steps have been taken in recent times towards the stabilization of the financial system Portuguese. Of course, we are aware that there are crucial objectives that must still be concluded and among them is  undoubtedly  the sale of Novo Banco and the effective management of the whole process, in particular as to the impacts on the Resolution Fund. Despite the improvements, the European banking landscape remains unstable, as demonstrated by the resolution of Banco Popular Espana recently determined by the Single Resolution Board, and it is important to stress  in this regard  that we have managed to fully safeguard the stability of its subsidiary in Portugal. And in recent days, two Italian banks have had to be rescued by the authorities of their country. We have already started a process of internal reflection on these events in order to draw the lessons that are imposed. The Banking Union is a very recent reality and therefore with little experience, it does not exempt from the risks of this youth. But it is also an incomplete project, right from the outset because the pillar of the establishment of a common deposit guarantee system still does not see the light of day. On the other hand, its operation is quite complex and - we must be aware of this - it is an unprecedented innovation on a global scale. But we are also the Banking Union: Banco de Portugal actively participates in all its mechanisms and instruments. So, as difficult as the circumstances are, we must make ourselves heard and persevering in defending our prospects and interests, so that the most appropriate decisions are being taken in national and European terms. 4. On 23 June 2016  three days after starting office  the citizens of the United Kingdom voted freely and democratically to leave the European Union, and the mechanism laid down in Article 50 of the Treaty on European Union has already been triggered by the British government. This is an event of enormous implications at all levels, particularly for Portugal, which has seen the European balance lean even more on central Europe, thereby increasing our periphery in the context of the Union. I mention this event  the consequences of which far transcend the sphere of Banco de Portugal  only to underline that we live in a time characterized not only by major economic, technological and social changes but also by profound political changes. Given the uncertainties and strategic uncertainties of a time that may be too new for what we can now perceive or want to admit, the action of institutions such as Banco de Portugal is even more important for the country. The challenges are therefore immense, whatever the areas considered. For my part, I am confident that Banco de Portugal will continue to assert itself and achieve its objectives in the hard missions in which it is invested at national level and in the European context. 5. In a beautiful and short poem, Fernando Pessoa wrote, under the period Ricardo Reis: "to be great, be whole; put how much you are at least you do." The greatness of which the brilliant poet speaks of is surely inaccessible to me. But after this caveat, I can promise you ladies and gentlemen that I will be whole in the exercise of the duties of Deputy Governor of Banco de Portugal, if that is the outcome of this nomination process. Thank you so much for your attention.
text_original: Audio na Comisso de Oramento, Finanas e Modernizao Administrativa 27 de junho de 2017 Interveno Inicial do Administrador Lus Mximo dos Santos1 1 Preparado para apresentao. Senhora Presidente, Senhoras e Senhores Deputados, 1. H pouco mais de um ano  mais concretamente no dia 17 de maio de 2016 -, fui ouvido nesta Comisso no mbito do procedimento previsto na lei para a designao dos administradores do Banco de Portugal. Na declarao inicial que ento li perante as Senhoras e os Senhores Deputados, expus as razes que me levaram a aceitar o convite, destacando que a aceitao se me afigurava um ato coerente com o meu percurso profissional de mais de 30 anos. Procurei tambm dar a minha viso sobre o papel do Banco de Portugal na sociedade portuguesa, indicar os principais desafios com que, a meu ver, se confrontava, num contexto que qualifiquei como de profunda mudana e grande incerteza, e referi ainda o modo como encarava as funes para que fui convidado e que efetivamente comecei a exercer no dia 20 de junho de 2016. Hoje  certamente sem surpresa que me ouvem reafirmar tudo quanto ento referi, designadamente quanto  plena conscincia da dimenso das responsabilidades envolvidas mas tambm quanto ao facto de me animar um esprito de total compromisso e dedicao. Servir o Banco de Portugal  seja qual for o cargo ou funo   para qualquer portugus uma honra, pois significa servir uma das mais antigas e relevantes Instituies nacionais, cuja histria se confunde com a histria da modernidade em Portugal, independentemente das vicissitudes de cada poca. 2. Ao iniciar funes como Administrador foram-me atribudos, por proposta do Senhor Governador, os pelouros correspondentes ao Departamento de Superviso Comportamental, ao Departamento de Averiguao e Ao Sancionatria e ao Departamento de Servios Jurdicos. Em 5 de julho de 2016, o Conselho de Administrao designou-me para presidir  Comisso Diretiva do Fundo de Garantia de Depsitos e, mais recentemente, em maro deste ano, para presidir  Comisso Diretiva do Fundo de Resoluo, tendo ficado tambm com o pelouro do Departamento de Resoluo, recentemente criado com o propsito de dar a mais adequada expresso orgnica ao exerccio autnomo da funo de resoluo, que  importa sublinhar  era j uma facto desde que tal misso foi cometida ao Banco de Portugal.  assim normal que a minha viso do Banco de Portugal seja hoje mais aprofundada e mais detalhada, melhor conhecedora dos problemas e das necessidades existentes, bem como dos anseios dos seus colaboradores. O Banco de Portugal  uma Instituio consciente da centralidade do seu papel na sociedade portuguesa e est mobilizado para fazer face a desafios de enorme exigncia. Sintomaticamente, o Conselho de Administrao adotou como lema do Plano Estratgico do Banco para o perodo de 2017-2020 a expresso fazer sempre melhor. No foi uma escolha difcil, pois bastou estarmos atentos ao estado de esprito da generalidade dos colaboradores. Na verdade, queremos um Banco de Portugal sempre com a ambio de melhorar e no nos sentimos prisioneiros de nenhum passado. No quadro do referido Plano, o Banco de Portugal definiu quatro linhas de orientao estratgica, a saber: - Afirmar interna e externamente as capacidades do Banco enquanto autoridade monetria; - Participar na definio dos enquadramentos regulatrios e na aplicao das prticas de superviso de forma a garantir a robustez e estabilidade do sistema financeiro nacional e a confiana dos agentes econmicos, designadamente assegurando uma relao equilibrada entre as instituies financeiras e os seus clientes, pautada por elevados padres de conduta e por uma formao financeira adequada; - Promover o conhecimento sobre a economia portuguesa e a integrao europeia, contribuindo para uma sociedade esclarecida e bem informada; - Ser um dos bancos mais eficientes do Eurosistema. Este , pois, em sntese, no apenas o programa da Administrao mas o de todos e cada um dos colaboradores do Banco de Portugal. 3. Fruto da ao convergente de diversos agentes, tm sido dados nos ltimos tempos importantes passos rumo  estabilizao do sistema financeiro portugus. Claro que temos conscincia que h objetivos cruciais que importa ainda concluir e entre eles est  sem dvida  a venda do Novo Banco e a gesto eficaz de todo o processo, designadamente quanto aos impactos sobre o Fundo de Resoluo. Apesar das melhorias, a paisagem bancria europeia continua instvel, como bem o demonstra a resoluo do Banco Popular Espanha determinada, recentemente, pelo Conselho nico de Resoluo, sendo importante salientar  a este propsito - que conseguimos salvaguardar plenamente a estabilidade da sua filial em Portugal. E, nos ltimos dias, dois bancos italianos tiveram de ser resgatados pelas autoridades do seu pas. Inicimos j um processo de reflexo interna sobre estes acontecimentos de modo a extrair as ilaes que se imponham. A Unio Bancria  uma realidade muito recente e, portanto, com escassa experincia, no isenta dos riscos prprios dessa juventude. Mas  tambm um projeto incompleto, desde logo porque o pilar relativo  instituio de um sistema comum de garantia de depsitos continua sem ver a luz do dia. Por outro lado, o seu funcionamento  bastante complexo e - h que ter conscincia disso  constitui uma inovao sem precedentes  escala mundial. Mas a Unio Bancria somos tambm ns: o Banco de Portugal participa ativamente em todos os seus mecanismos e instrumentos. Por isso, por mais difceis que sejam as circunstncias, temos de nos fazer ouvir e ser perseverantes na defesa das nossas perspetivas e interesses, de modo a que aumente a probabilidade de serem adotadas as decises mais convenientes em termos nacionais e europeus. 4.
