O modelo de superviso adotado diferencia as instituies de crdito entre instituies significativas e instituies menos significativas, com base em critrios relacionados com a dimenso, a importncia da instituio na economia do pas e a extenso das atividades transfronteirias. Desde 4 de novembro, as instituies significativas esto sob a superviso direta do BCE; para as menos significativas, a superviso continua a ser exercida diretamente pelas autoridades nacionais competentes, em estreita articulao com o BCE. Com a entrada em funcionamento do MUS, colaboradores do Banco de Portugal passaram a integrar equipas conjuntas de superviso que asseguram a superviso regular das instituies significativas. O Banco participa tambm no Conselho de Superviso do MUS. A criao do MUS representa uma mudana estrutural profunda no quadro institucional e operacional de superviso das instituies financeiras europeias e um passo decisivo para a construo da Unio Bancria. A importncia da Unio Bancria para a rea do euro no seu todo, e para a economia portuguesa em particular, no pode ser menosprezada. A Unio Bancria contribuir para eliminar, de forma eficaz, os riscos de contgio recproco entre soberanos e bancos que caracterizou a crise da rea do euro a partir de 2010. A este propsito, gostaria de sublinhar quatro efeitos benficos da Unio Bancria: i) As condies de financiamento dos particulares e das empresas sero mais equitativas no espao da moeda nica; ii) O soberano ficar imune a acidentes no sistema bancrio, favorecendo a sustentabilidade das finanas pblicas e a proteo dos contribuintes; iii) A confiana dos depositantes e a estabilidade do sistema financeiro europeu sero fortalecidas com a harmonizao das normas, dos procedimentos e das prticas de superviso em torno de padres exigentes; iv) Ao contribuir para o aprofundamento da integrao financeira, a Unio Bancria ter um efeito estabilizador sobre a economia europeia. Os bancos portugueses avanaram para o novo modelo de superviso aps um escrutnio alargado e profundo dos seus balanos. A Avaliao Completa conduzida pelo BCE sucedeu ao ciclo de inspees transversais desenvolvidas pelo Banco de Portugal desde 2011. Este ciclo de inspees foi concludo em 2014, com o exerccio transversal de anlise dos planos de negcio de clientes relevantes do sistema bancrio (ETRICC2). O Banco de Portugal preparou-se atempadamente para o novo quadro europeu da superviso, em termos de modelo de governo, recursos e instrumentos. Em particular, - Segregou as funes de estabilidade financeira, superviso prudencial, superviso comportamental e ao sancionatria em diferentes departamentos e sob direo de diferentes membros do Conselho de Administrao; - Adotou novos instrumentos, incluindo planos de financiamento e capital dos bancos, testes de esforo e inspees transversais a determinados processos e rubricas de balano dos bancos; - Reforou significativamente o nmero de colaboradores afetos s reas de superviso e as respetivas competncias. Aplicao da medida de resoluo ao BES Conforme referi, a atividade do Banco de Portugal em 2014 ficou inevitavelmente marcada pela aplicao da medida de resoluo ao BES, em agosto. A aplicao desta medida, na sequncia dos prejuzos, inesperados e excecionais, divulgados no dia 30 de julho por aquela instituio, veio pr  prova as estruturas e as equipas do Banco de Portugal, que trabalharam num contexto de grande complexidade e exigncia, e sem a experincia de casos precedentes. O trabalho desenvolvido apoiou-se, necessariamente, nos esforos empreendidos desde 2012 na operacionalizao da funo de resoluo. Praticamente todos os departamentos e estruturas do Banco foram chamados a intervir. A implementao da medida de resoluo, a atuao sancionatria e o processo de alienao do Novo Banco continuam, em 2015, a absorver uma importante quantidade de recursos do Banco de Portugal. As operaes de descapitalizao e falhas no modelo de governo do BES so hoje amplamente reconhecidas e, no que ao Banco de Portugal respeita, esto a ser objeto da correspondente atuao sancionatria. No mbito do processo de contraordenao em curso relativo  colocao de dvida da ESI junto de clientes do Grupo BES foi, no passado dia 21 de maio, deduzida acusao contra 18 arguidos (3 pessoas coletivas e 15 pessoas singulares), a quem foi imputada a prtica, a ttulo doloso ou negligente, de diversas infraes previstas no Regime Geral das Instituies de Crdito e Sociedades Financeiras, designadamente: i) Prtica de atos dolosos de gesto ruinosa, em detrimento de depositantes, investidores e demais credores; ii) Prestao ao Banco de Portugal de falsas informaes; iii) Violao de regras sobre conflitos de interesses; iv) No adoo de um sistema de gesto de riscos compatvel com o prescrito pelo Aviso do Banco de Portugal n. 5/2008. Existem ainda quatro outros processos de contraordenao que esto em fase de investigao, com diferentes mbitos e arguidos, prevendo-se a concluso das investigaes ao longo do ano de 2015 e primeiro semestre de 2016 (para aqueles que exijam a colheita de meios probatrios em jurisdies estrangeiras). O processo de alienao do Novo Banco est a decorrer com normalidade, estando atualmente na fase de elaborao das ofertas vinculativas pelas cinco entidades selecionadas pelo Banco de Portugal, aps efetuada uma avaliao e um procedimento de audincia prvia. Durante esta fase, os potenciais compradores tm oportunidade de realizar uma due diligence completa ao Grupo Novo Banco, designadamente, recorrendo a documentao e informao pormenorizadas, visitando locais pr-selecionados (por exemplo agncias), realizando reunies com o Banco de Portugal e seus assessores e endereando questes  Comisso Europeia (DG-Concorrncia). As ofertas vinculativas tero de ser entregues at 30 de junho de 2014. Seguir-se- a fase de seleo do comprador, cuja durao depender de as propostas serem mais ou menos prximas e da interao com as entidades competentes no processo, nomeadamente a DG-Concorrncia. O Banco de Portugal mantm a Comisso Europeia e o Tribunal de Contas permanentemente informados sobre o processo de alienao do Novo Banco. Para concluir este ponto, gostaria de sublinhar que a medida de resoluo assentou  como no poderia deixar de ser  nas finalidades legalmente consagradas, nomeadamente: i) A continuidade da prestao dos servios financeiros essenciais;, ii) A preveno do risco sistmico; iii) A salvaguarda dos interesses dos contribuintes e do errio pblico; e iv) A preservao da confiana dos depositantes. At agora, e pela forma como todo este complexo processo tem decorrido, o Banco de Portugal considera que estas finalidades tm vindo a ser alcanadas. A eficcia da interveno do Banco de Portugal s poder ser definitivamente avaliada depois de concludo o processo de alienao do Novo Banco. No entanto, 10 meses volvidos desde a aplicao da medida de resoluo ao BES, podemos reconhecer que foi preservada a estabilidade do sistema financeiro nacional, cumprindo-se, assim, uma das misses fundamentais do Banco de Portugal. Tal no significa, e j o referi por diversas vezes, que no haja lugar a uma reflexo profunda e  adoo de medidas que diminuam a possibilidade de, no futuro, ocorrer uma situao idntica. Os trabalhos da Comisso Parlamentar de Inqurito  Gesto do BES e do Grupo Esprito Santo em muito contriburam para esta reflexo. O Banco de Portugal tem feito tambm a sua prpria avaliao deste caso. A comisso independente de avaliao da atuao do Banco de Portugal no caso BES, que nomeei em novembro passado, apresentou recentemente ao Conselho de Administrao o seu trabalho. As recomendaes sero divulgadas no stio do Banco de Portugal durante a prxima semana. Funes de autoridade monetria Alm das atividades mais diretamente ligadas  preservao da estabilidade do sistema financeiro, o Banco prosseguiu a sua atividade regular, designadamente no cumprimento das suas funes de autoridade monetria. Em 2014, o Conselho do BCE adotou novas medidas de carter convencional e no convencional para restabelecer o funcionamento do mecanismo de transmisso da poltica monetria, promover o financiamento da economia e relanar a atividade econmica, tendo em conta o objetivo de estabilidade de preos. No mbito das medidas no convencionais, foram realizadas oito operaes de refinanciamento de prazo alargado direcionadas (TLTRO) e dois programas de compra de ttulos, sobre operaes de titularizao (ABSPP) e sobre obrigaes hipotecrias (CBPP3). O Banco de Portugal participou na preparao e na execuo das novas medidas no convencionais, bem como nos trabalhos preparatrios do programa de compras de ttulos do setor pblico (PSPP), anunciado pelo BCE j em 2015. Pelo seu carter inovador, todas estas medidas exigiram do Banco o estabelecimento de novas regras e procedimentos. A crise financeira iniciada em 2008 introduziu importantes perturbaes no mecanismo de transmisso da poltica monetria, confrontando os bancos centrais com a necessidade de complementarem as medidas de poltica convencionais com novas formas de atuao. As principais medidas no convencionais adotadas pelo Conselho do BCE desde o incio da crise assumiram a forma de operaes de crdito com garantia e de compras de ativos financeiros. As operaes de crdito com garantia contriburam para reparar o mecanismo de transmisso (nomeadamente do canal do crdito), ao mitigarem as restries de liquidez do mercado monetrio e as dificuldades de financiamento dos bancos e, posteriormente, a fragmentao financeira. As compras de ativos financeiros permitiram apoiar mais diretamente o funcionamento de segmentos especficos de mercado, restabelecer o mecanismo de transmisso, salvaguardar a unicidade da poltica monetria da rea do euro e torn-la mais acomodatcia (atravs dos canais de liquidez e de reequilbrio de carteiras). No devemos esquecer que as polticas no convencionais podem operar tambm atravs de um outro canal relevante  o canal de sinalizao  ao fornecerem indicaes sobre a natureza futura da poltica monetria. Avaliar a eficcia das medidas de poltica monetria, em particular as no convencionais,  um exerccio complexo. Todavia, a evidncia sugere que as medidas tomadas foram fundamentais para reduzir as tenses nos mercados financeiros, impedir uma reduo mais acentuada do crdito  economia e evitar riscos extremos para a rea do euro. 2. Organizao interna e Contas Gostaria de terminar esta interveno inicial com uma breve referncia  evoluo da organizao do Banco de Portugal nos ltimos anos e s contas de 2014. Nos ltimos quatro anos, o modelo de governo, a organizao interna e as polticas de gesto do Banco de Portugal sofreram alteraes significativas, inspiradas nas melhores prticas. Conforme referi em anteriores audies nesta Comisso, o Banco: i) Criou a figura de Consultor de tica e reforou os Cdigos de Conduta aplicveis aos trabalhadores e aos membros do Conselho de Administrao; ii) Aprovou e divulgou o Regulamento do Conselho de Auditoria; iii) Adotou um novo modelo de gesto integrada do risco; iv) Procedeu a uma profunda reorganizao e ao reforo de recursos na rea da superviso; v) Tem promovido uma crescente mobilidade de recursos humanos e uma maior abertura e concorrncia no preenchimento de posies de gesto; vi) Seguiu uma poltica de abertura  sociedade. No final de 2014, o Banco de Portugal tinha 1776 efetivos. O nmero de colaboradores do Banco de Portugal aumentou 2,5% para responder s novas atribuies de regulao e superviso. Simultaneamente, o nmero de requisitados/em licena sem vencimento passou de 62 no final de 2013 para 94 no final de 2014, representando mais de 5% dos efetivos do Banco. Este aumento expressivo deveu-se  sada de colaboradores (33) para integrarem as equipas do BCE/MUS. No final do ano, 47 colaboradores do Banco encontravam-se a exercer funes no BCE. No obstante o aumento do nmero de colaboradores, os custos com pessoal continuaram a diminuir, refletindo uma poltica global de conteno de gastos administrativos prosseguida desde 2010 e o novo enquadramento em termos do sistema de proteo social aplicvel aos empregados admitidos a partir de maro de 2009. O balano do Banco de Portugal era, no final de 2014, de 105 608 milhes. A diminuio de cerca de 6 mil milhes (5 984 milhes) em relao a 2013 deveu-se, essencialmente, ao significativo decrscimo do montante de cedncia de liquidez nas operaes de poltica monetria (menos 16 673 milhes), refletindo menores necessidades de refinanciamento do sistema bancrio nacional junto do Eurosistema. Este efeito foi parcialmente compensado pelo aumento dos ativos de gesto do Banco de Portugal (mais 6 527 milhes)  traduzindo a opo de investimento do Banco  e pela subida do preo de mercado do ouro. O resultado lquido em 2014 foi de 304 milhes de euros (253 milhes em 2013), aps transferncia de  245 milhes para reforo da proviso para riscos gerais (130 milhes em 2013). Refira-se que a proviso para riscos gerais tem uma natureza equivalente a uma reserva, dado o seu carter permanente, e destina-se a cobrir riscos potenciais de balano numa perspetiva de mdio e longo prazo. A dotao desta proviso  revista anualmente, considerando, entre outros fatores, a avaliao de riscos efetuada para o perodo em anlise e o exerccio de projeo das demonstraes financeiras e dos riscos a trs anos. Pretende-se, desta forma, reforar os recursos prprios e assegurar nveis de autonomia financeira adequados  misso do Banco, capacitando-o para, a qualquer momento, cobrir eventuais perdas, incluindo as que resultem da partilha de risco com o Eurosistema. Para o aumento do resultado lquido do Banco contriburam essencialmente o acrscimo dos resultados realizados em operaes financeiras e a reduo dos prejuzos no realizados. O resultado apurado possibilitou uma distribuio de dividendos ao Estado de 243 milhes (202 milhes em 2013), sujeitos a reteno na fonte de IRC, resultando num dividendo lquido de 191 milhes. Muito obrigado. Estou agora  disposio dos Senhores Deputados para responder s questes que entendam por pertinentes.

Title: Initial intervention of the Governor of Banco de Portugal in the Committee on Budget, Finance and Public Administration
text: Committee on Budget, Finance and Public Administration, 12 June 2015 Initial Intervention of Governor Carlos da Silva Costa1 1 Prepared for presentation. Good afternoon Mr President, ladies and gentlemen. Just two weeks ago I had the opportunity in this Commission to take a very thorough assessment of the five years of the term that now ends. Benefiting from this and also given that this is a hearing in which it is important to look forward to the new mandate for which I was appointed by the Government, I will focus my initial intervention on the missions of Banco de Portugal and on the main challenges and priorities that I anticipate for the near future and for the medium term. 1. Banco de Portugal's missions Banco de Portugal has, as is known, two complementary tasks: (i) maintaining price stability in the euro area; and (ii) safeguarding the stability of the national financial system. With the transfer to the European plan of responsibility for monetary policy and, more recently, the supervision of credit institutions, Banco de Portugal carries out the tasks entrusted to it in a shared way. This does not mean that the demand on Banco de Portugal has decreased. On the contrary, the complexity of the framework in which the Bank operates has increased significantly, both as a result of institutional developments at European level and as a result of the effects of the international financial crisis and the ongoing adjustment in the Portuguese economy. Today, active and influential participation in the European decision-making process and the ability to fulfil the tasks assigned to it imply an increased demand in terms of skills, resources and the quality and robustness of the government model and processes of Banco de Portugal. The Bank's activity as a monetary authority covers a number of shared functions of the Eurosystem, namely:  Monetary policy advice and economic studies;  Implementation of monetary policy;  Asset management;  Statistics;  Payment systems;  Monetary issuance;  International relations. Although we do not have an autonomous monetary policy, our influence on European monetary policy is now much greater than it was in the period before the adoption of the euro. The Governor of Banco de Portugal is on an equal footing with the other Governors on the Governing Council, and is entitled to one vote, as is each of the other Governors, regardless of the size, or economic weight, of their respective countries. But the effective weight of national central banks in governing Council decisions is not only a function of the weight of their vote. It is mainly a function of their ability to influence decisions on the basis of the quality of the arguments. And here I would like to stress that Banco de Portugal occupies a prominent position in the Eurosystem in several areas of shared competence. For example, the Bank actively participated in the design and implementation of non-conventional monetary policy measures. The Bank is also contributing to the creation of a credit responsibility centre at European level, benefiting from the pioneering experience in Portugal. This is the result of the excellent technical quality of the Bank's human resources, as well as its effort and commitment to pursuing a proactive attitude of anticipating problems and presenting solutions. As part of prudential supervision, Banco de Portugal has been part of the Single Supervisory Mechanism since the end of last year, participating in its structures, including the Supervisory Board, and in the joint teams that oversee significant euro area credit institutions. This new institutional framework is a relevant challenge in the level of articulation between teams and also in the adoption of new methodologies, processes and tools. At the same time, Banco de Portugal continues to supervise the less significant institutions of the banking system Portuguese in close coordination with the ECB. Banco de Portugal continues to be the guarantor of the stability of the national financial system. The Bank retains specific competences as a macroprudential authority and resolution authority  without prejudice to coordination at European level. The Bank also retains autonomous competences in the field of sanctioning action and in the field of behavioural supervision. Since the responsibility for behavioral supervision in 2008, Banco de Portugal has promoted transparency in the contracting of banking products  deposits, credits and payment instruments  and has been heavily invested in training and financial literacy. In the national context, Banco de Portugal also has the responsibility to contribute to the economic debate and knowledge about the Portuguese economy. In fact, Banco de Portugal has been, and will continue to be, a reference think tank on economic issues, where its researchers are only conditioned by methodological and scientific rigour. Banco de Portugal also provides various services to the community, including, among others, the maintenance of a credit liability center and a database of bank accounts, both with the possibility of online consultation by citizens. Finally, I would like to stress that Banco de Portugal and its employees are not indifferent to the surroundings in which they are part. In this sense, the Bank has strengthened its activities in the field of social responsibility and volunteering, developing, among others, initiatives to combat school failure and provide meals to the needy population in the areas where the Bank is located. The commitment to the protection and valorization of heritage is also well expressed in the rehabilitation of banco de Portugal's head of the Baixa-Chiado area and in the cultural dynamic associated with the future Money Museum that we have been promoting. 2. Immediate challenges and priorities For the next 18 months, i would highlight three priority strands of action: 1. First, the dossier which resulted from the application of the resolution measure to bes in August last year must be closed. This means completing the sale of Novo Banco, completing the indemotory and sanctioning proceedings and winding up BES. In general, these processes have taken place at a good pace and without major disturbances. I have given an account of them to the House of the Republic, both at the hearings of the Parliamentary Committee of Inquiry and at the May hearing before this Committee. 2) Secondly, and as I have mentioned several times, Banco de Portugal cannot fail to make its own assessment of the experience in the BES case. Over the next few months, Banco de Portugal will produce a white paper on the regulation and supervision of the financial system. This White Paper will provide an action programme for improving the institutional and regulatory framework and the supervisory model with a view to enhancing the effectiveness of supervisory action. This process will benefit from the work already carried out by independent committees and working groups in three relevant areas, namely:  From the evaluation to the decisions and the performance of Banco de Portugal in the supervision of BES  whose recommendations were disclosed last June 4;  The evaluation of models and practices of government, control and audit of financial institutions  the recommendations of which will be released later today; I can now move forward that the working group has concluded that, in Portugal, larger credit institutions have corporate governance structures and procedures generally aligned with the principles adopted at international level. However, there are still deficiencies at three levels: i) at the level of the collective functioning of the management body as a supervisor and counterweight of executive management; (ii) at the level of the selection processes of non-executive members of these bodies; and iii) in the prevention of conflicts of interest involving related parties. In this way, the Working Party made a set of recommendations on the governance, control and audit models and practices of financial institutions focusing on seven themes: o Corporate governance structures and functions of the top bodies; o Adequacy of members of the governing bodies and senior leaders; o Prevention of conflicts of interest; o Caixa Economica Montepio Geral and Mutual Agricultural Credit Banks; o Remuneration policies; o Internal control and external audit; o Supervision of corporate governance.  The third area concerns the evaluation of the preparation of sanctioning proceedings  work that was requested by the National Council of Financial Supervisors and whose recommendations will be released in mid-July. In addition to this work, other contributions will also be taken into account in the preparation of the White Paper, including legislative proposals already submitted by the different parliamentary groups. 3) Thirdly, but not least, we will remain committed to the implementation of banco de Portugal's Strategic Plan, established for the three-year period 2014-2016 and based on four broad lines of strategic orientation:  Contribution to financial stability in the European context;  Full and effective contribution to the performance of monetary authority functions within the Eurosystem;  Organization and efficient management of resources;  Promotion of a Bank open and respected by society. 3. Medium-term challenges As demanding as the tasks we propose to undertake in the short term, we cannot fail to look ahead to the more distant future. In particular, we cannot fail to consider the implications for the fulfilment of Banco de Portugal's tasks: (i) the normalisation of monetary policy in the euro area and (ii) the transformation of the European financial system in response to the creation of the Banking Union. The monetary policy orientation is determined by the objective of maintaining price stability in the euro area in the medium term. Monetary policy is currently accommodative and, as such, contributes to supporting the economic activity of the euro area. However, as the President of the ECB has repeatedly pointed out, monetary policy does not solve the problem of the persistence of high structural unemployment, nor the problem of low growth in potential product in the euro area. To this end, the contribution of other areas of economic policy is decisive. In order to increase investment, boost job creation and increase productivity, greater momentum is needed to:  Improve the business environment in several countries, including: o Increasing the financial autonomy of companies, enhancing investment capacity; o Strengthening its management and organisation capacity; o Improving knowledge absorption capacities and new technologies.  Adapt labour market regulatory frameworks and workers' qualifications to new employment conditions and introduce adjustments to the product market that ensure responsiveness to global competition conditions. For their part, fiscal policies must support economic recovery without jeopardising the Budgetary Treaty, the full and coherent implementation of which is essential for confidence in the euro area. The Eurosystem's monetary policy has favoured economies under pressure, providing favourable conditions for the continuation of the deleveraging process and for improving the liquidity position of the various institutional sectors. However, the long-term maintenance of low interest rates poses risks to financial stability and poses challenges to policy-making. Indeed, current levels of interest rates may lead to an incorrect risk assessment and, consequently, lead to an inefficient allocation of resources. It is therefore essential that, in lending decisions, banks take into account that in future the current interest rates may be substantially different from those in the current ones. In a context where improving profitability remains one of the main challenges facing the Portuguese banking system, adequate risk management is particularly relevant at the time of lending and during its validity. In addition, banks need to rethink their business models more structurally, particularly taking into account the implications of two new realities: the digital economy and the creation of the Banking Union in Europe. The creation of a single banking market will create business dynamics of consolidation and expertise, with an impact on the entire European banking system. On the credit side, the convergence of spreads to a European standard will depend on the competition that is to take place. If competition is high, as is desirable, medium and large enterprises in all member countries will benefit. For small and medium-sized enterprises, information and proximity asymmetry factors will act even more markedly as elements of capture and market segmentation. In this context, it is essential to ensure the quality of the information provided by companies. The lower the quality of information available, the more asymmetric the relationship between funder and financed and the less competitive the market will be. From this point of view, it is essential to ensure that economic agents taking credit in Portugal are in a position to reduce the perception of risk of your company, ensuring the sufficiency and quality of the information provided. In conclusion, I would like to underline a point which, although known, is often ignored. Despite all the progress and improvements that have been made in financial supervision at international level, it must be recognised that this is a process that will always be unfinished, given that the supervised reality is rapidly and permanently changing. It is important that institutions with supervisory responsibilities are particularly attentive and vigilant to the reality surrounding them, in particular the evolution of risk factors, and that they are available to constantly review working methods and make improvements to their practices and functioning. This notion has always been present throughout my first term at Banco de Portugal  such as the changes to the supervisory approach  and will continue to be in the coming years. Thus, for the future, Banco de Portugal reaffirms its commitment to work together with the competent authorities, namely the Assembly of the Republic, on all initiatives that contribute to the improvement of the financial system and to the development of the Portuguese economy and society. On my side, I will continue to guide my performance by the primacy of public service, which is manifested by financial and monetary stability. Thank you very much.
text_original: Comisso de Oramento, Finanas e Administrao Pblica, 12 de junho 2015 Interveno Inicial do Governador Carlos da Silva Costa1 1 Preparado para apresentao. Boa tarde Senhor Presidente, Senhoras e Senhores Deputados. H apenas duas semanas tive a oportunidade de, nesta Comisso, fazer um balano bastante exaustivo dos cinco anos do mandato que agora termina. Beneficiando desse facto e atendendo tambm a que esta  uma audio na qual importa perspetivar o novo mandato para que fui indicado pelo Governo, centrarei a minha interveno inicial nas misses do Banco de Portugal e nos principais desafios e prioridades que antevejo para o futuro prximo e para o mdio prazo. 1. As misses do Banco de Portugal O Banco de Portugal tem, como  sabido, duas misses complementares: i) a manuteno da estabilidade dos preos na rea do euro; e ii) a salvaguarda da estabilidade do sistema financeiro nacional. Com a transferncia para o plano europeu da responsabilidade pela poltica monetria e, mais recentemente, pela superviso das instituies de crdito, o Banco de Portugal cumpre as misses que lhe foram confiadas de forma partilhada. Isto no significa que a exigncia que recai sobre o Banco de Portugal tenha diminudo. Pelo contrrio, a complexidade do enquadramento em que o Banco atua aumentou significativamente, quer por fora da evoluo institucional no plano europeu quer em consequncia dos efeitos da crise financeira internacional e do ajustamento em curso na economia portuguesa. Hoje, a participao ativa e influente no processo de deciso europeu e a capacidade para cumprir as misses que lhe esto atribudas implicam uma exigncia acrescida em termos de competncias, de recursos e da qualidade e robustez do modelo de governo e dos processos do Banco de Portugal. A atividade do Banco enquanto autoridade monetria abrange diversas funes partilhadas do Eurosistema, designadamente:  Aconselhamento de poltica monetria e estudos econmicos;  Execuo da poltica monetria;  Gesto de ativos;  Estatsticas;  Sistemas de pagamentos;  Emisso monetria;  Relaes internacionais. Apesar de no termos uma poltica monetria autnoma, a nossa influncia na poltica monetria europeia  hoje muito superior  que foi no perodo que antecedeu a adoo do euro. O Governador do Banco de Portugal est em p de igualdade com os outros Governadores no Conselho do BCE, tendo direito a um voto, tal como cada um dos restantes Governadores, independentemente da dimenso, ou peso econmico, dos respetivos pases. Mas, o peso efetivo dos bancos centrais nacionais nas decises do Conselho do BCE no  apenas funo do peso do seu voto.  funo, sobretudo, da sua capacidade para influenciarem as decises com base na qualidade dos argumentos. E aqui quero sublinhar que o Banco de Portugal ocupa uma posio proeminente no Eurosistema em diversas reas de competncia partilhada. Por exemplo, o Banco participou ativamente no desenho e na implementao das medidas no convencionais de poltica monetria. O Banco est tambm a contribuir para a criao de uma central de responsabilidades de crdito a nvel europeu, beneficiando da experincia pioneira em Portugal. Isto  resultado da excelente qualidade tcnica dos recursos humanos do Banco, bem como do seu esforo e empenho na prossecuo de uma atitude pr-ativa de antecipao de problemas e de apresentao de solues. No mbito da superviso prudencial, o Banco de Portugal integra, desde finais do ano passado, o Mecanismo nico de Superviso, participando nas suas estruturas, incluindo o Conselho de Superviso, e nas equipas mistas que supervisionam as instituies de crdito significativas da rea do euro. Este novo quadro institucional constitui um desafio relevante ao nvel da articulao entre as equipas e tambm da adoo de novas metodologias, processos e ferramentas. Paralelamente, o Banco de Portugal continua a exercer a superviso das instituies menos significativas do sistema bancrio portugus em estreita articulao com o BCE. O Banco de Portugal continua a ser o garante da estabilidade do sistema financeiro nacional. O Banco mantm competncias especficas enquanto autoridade macroprudencial e autoridade de resoluo  sem prejuzo da coordenao a nvel europeu. O Banco mantm tambm competncias autnomas no domnio da ao sancionatria e em matria de superviso comportamental. Desde a atribuio, em 2008, da responsabilidade pela superviso comportamental, o Banco de Portugal tem promovido a transparncia na contratao dos produtos bancrios  depsitos, crditos e instrumentos de pagamento  e tem apostado fortemente na formao e na literacia financeira. No contexto nacional, o Banco de Portugal tem ainda a responsabilidade de contribuir para o debate econmico e para o conhecimento sobre a economia portuguesa. De facto, o Banco de Portugal tem sido, e continuar a ser, um centro de reflexo de referncia sobre questes econmicas, em que os seus investigadores esto apenas condicionados pelo rigor metodolgico e cientfico. O Banco de Portugal presta tambm diversos servios  comunidade, que incluem, entre outros, a manuteno de uma central de responsabilidades de crdito e de uma base de dados de contas bancrias, ambas com possibilidade de consulta on-line por parte dos cidados. Por ltimo, gostaria de sublinhar que o Banco de Portugal e os seus colaboradores no so indiferentes  envolvente onde se inserem. Nesse sentido, o Banco tem reforado a sua atuao no domnio da responsabilidade social e do voluntariado, desenvolvendo, entre outras, iniciativas de combate ao insucesso escolar e fornecimento de refeies  populao carenciada nas reas onde o Banco se encontra localizado. O compromisso com a proteo e valorizao do patrimnio est tambm bem expresso na reabilitao da sede do Banco de Portugal na zona da Baixa-Chiado e na dinamizao cultural associada ao futuro Museu do Dinheiro que temos vindo a promover. 2. Desafios e prioridades imediatas Para os prximos 18 meses, destacaria trs vertentes de atuao prioritrias: 1) Em primeiro lugar, h que fechar o dossi que resultou da aplicao da medida de resoluo ao BES em agosto do ano passado. Isto significa, concluir a venda do Novo Banco, concluir os processos de contraordenao e sancionatrios e proceder  liquidao do BES. Em geral, estes processos tm decorrido a bom ritmo e sem perturbaes de maior. Deles tenho dado conta  Assembleia da Repblica, quer nas audies da Comisso Parlamentar de Inqurito quer na audio de maio perante esta Comisso. 2) Em segundo lugar, e conforme j diversas vezes referi, o Banco de Portugal no pode deixar de fazer a sua prpria avaliao da experincia no caso BES. Ao longo dos prximos meses, o Banco de Portugal produzir um livro branco sobre a regulao e a superviso do sistema financeiro. Este livro branco constituir um programa de ao para a melhoria do quadro institucional e regulamentar e do modelo de superviso, tendo em vista reforar a eficcia da ao de superviso. Este processo beneficiar dos trabalhos j realizados por comisses e grupos de trabalho independentes em trs domnios relevantes, designadamente:  Da avaliao s decises e  atuao do Banco de Portugal na superviso do BES  cujas recomendaes foram divulgadas no passado dia 4 de junho;  Da avaliao sobre modelos e as prticas de governo, de controlo e de auditoria das instituies financeiras  cujas recomendaes sero divulgadas ainda hoje; Posso desde j avanar que o grupo de trabalho concluiu que, em Portugal, as instituies de crdito de maior dimenso tm estruturas e procedimentos de governo societrio genericamente alinhados com os princpios adotados a nvel internacional. Porm, subsistem deficincias a trs nveis: i) ao nvel do funcionamento coletivo do rgo de administrao enquanto fiscalizador e contrapeso da gesto executiva; ii) ao nvel dos processos de seleo de membros no executivos desses rgos; e iii) ao nvel da preveno dos conflitos de interesses envolvendo partes relacionadas. Desta forma, o grupo de trabalho formulou um conjunto de recomendaes sobre os modelos e as prticas de governo, de controlo e de auditoria das instituies financeiras que incidem sobre sete temas: o Estruturas de governo societrio e funes dos rgos de topo; o Adequao dos membros de rgos sociais e dos altos dirigentes; o Preveno de conflitos de interesses; o Caixa Econmica Montepio Geral e Caixas de Crdito Agrcola Mtuo; o Polticas remuneratrias; o Controlo interno e auditoria externa; o Superviso da corporate governance.  O terceiro domnio diz respeito  avaliao da preparao de processos sancionatrios  trabalho que foi solicitado pelo Conselho Nacional de Supervisores Financeiros e cujas recomendaes sero divulgadas em meados de julho. Para alm destes trabalhos, sero tambm tidos em considerao na elaborao do livro branco outros contributos, incluindo as propostas legislativas j apresentadas pelos diferentes grupos parlamentares. 3) Em terceiro lugar, mas no menos importante, continuaremos empenhados na concretizao do Plano Estratgico do Banco de Portugal, estabelecido para o trinio 2014-2016 e que assenta em quatro linhas gerais de orientao estratgica:  Contribuio para a estabilidade financeira no contexto europeu;  Contribuio plena e efetiva para o desempenho das funes de autoridade monetria no quadro do Eurosistema;  Organizao e gesto eficiente dos recursos;  Promoo de um Banco aberto e respeitado pela sociedade. 3. Desafios de mdio prazo Por muito exigentes que sejam as tarefas que nos propomos empreender no curto prazo, no podemos deixar de perspetivar tambm o futuro mais longnquo. Em particular, no podemos deixar de equacionar as implicaes para o cumprimento das misses do Banco de Portugal: (i) da normalizao da poltica monetria na rea do euro e (ii) da transformao do sistema financeiro europeu em resposta  criao da Unio Bancria. A orientao da poltica monetria  determinada pelo objetivo de manuteno da estabilidade de preos na rea do euro a mdio prazo. Atualmente, a poltica monetria tem uma orientao acomodatcia e, como tal, contribui para apoiar a atividade econmica da rea euro. Contudo, e como tem sido repetidamente referido pelo Presidente do BCE, a poltica monetria no resolve o problema da persistncia do elevado desemprego estrutural, nem o problema do baixo crescimento do produto potencial na rea do euro. Para isso, o contributo de outras reas da poltica econmica  decisivo. A fim de aumentar o investimento, impulsionar a criao de emprego e aumentar a produtividade, impe-se uma maior dinmica no sentido de:  Melhorar o enquadramento empresarial em diversos pases, designadamente atravs: o Do aumento da autonomia financeira das empresas, potenciando a capacidade de investimento; o Do reforo da sua capacidade de gesto e organizao; o Da melhoria das capacidades de absoro de conhecimento e de novas tecnologias.  Adequar os quadros regulamentares do mercado de trabalho e as qualificaes dos trabalhadores s novas condies de emprego e introduzir ajustamentos no mercado de produto que garantam capacidade de resposta s condies de concorrncia global. Por seu turno, as polticas oramentais devem apoiar a recuperao econmica sem pr em causa o Tratado Oramental, cuja aplicao integral e coerente  essencial para a confiana na rea do euro. A poltica monetria do Eurosistema tem favorecido as economias sob presso, proporcionando condies favorveis para a continuao do processo de desalavancagem e para a melhoria da posio de liquidez dos vrios setores institucionais. No entanto, a manuteno, por um perodo longo, de baixas taxas de juro potencia riscos para a estabilidade financeira e coloca desafios  conduo das polticas. Efetivamente, os nveis atuais das taxas de juro podero propiciar uma incorreta avaliao do risco e, consequentemente, induzir uma ineficiente afetao de recursos. Por conseguinte,  fundamental que, nas decises de concesso de crdito, os bancos tenham em conta que, no futuro, as taxas de juro vigentes podero ser substancialmente diferentes das atuais. Num contexto em que a melhoria da rendibilidade permanece um dos principais desafios que o sistema bancrio portugus enfrenta,  especialmente relevante uma adequada gesto do risco no momento de concesso de crdito e durante a sua vigncia. Para alm disso, os bancos necessitam de repensar os seus modelos de negcio de forma mais estrutural, tendo particularmente em conta as implicaes de duas novas realidades: a economia digital e a criao da Unio Bancria na Europa. A criao de um mercado nico bancrio originar dinmicas empresariais de consolidao e de especializao, com impacto em todo o sistema bancrio europeu. Do lado do crdito, a convergncia dos spreads para uma norma europeia depender da concorrncia que venha a verificar-se. Se a concorrncia for elevada, como  desejvel, as mdias e grandes empresas em todos os pases membros sairo beneficiadas. Para as pequenas e mdias empresas, fatores de assimetria de informao e de proximidade funcionaro, de forma ainda mais vincada, como elementos de captura e de segmentao de mercado. Neste contexto,  fundamental garantir a qualidade da informao prestada pelas empresas. Quanto menor for a qualidade da informao disponvel, mais assimtrica ser a relao entre financiador e financiado e menos concorrencial ser o mercado. Deste ponto de vista,  fundamental assegurar que os agentes econmicos tomadores de crdito em Portugal esto em condies de reduzir a perceo de risco da sua empresa, garantindo a suficincia e a qualidade da informao prestada. Para concluir, gostaria de sublinhar um ponto que, embora conhecido,  muitas vezes ignorado. Apesar de todos os progressos e melhorias que tm vindo a ser introduzidos na superviso financeira a nvel internacional,  preciso reconhecer que este  um processo que estar sempre inacabado, tendo em conta que a realidade supervisionada est em rpida e permanente alterao.  importante que as instituies com responsabilidades de superviso estejam particularmente atentas e vigilantes  realidade que as rodeia, em particular  evoluo dos fatores de risco, e que estejam disponveis para permanentemente reverem os mtodos de trabalho e introduzirem melhorias s suas prticas e ao seu funcionamento. Esta noo esteve sempre presente ao longo do meu primeiro mandato no Banco de Portugal  de que so exemplo as alteraes introduzidas  abordagem de superviso  e continuar a estar nos prximos anos. Assim, para o futuro, o Banco de Portugal reafirma o compromisso de trabalhar em conjunto com as autoridades competentes, designadamente a Assembleia da Repblica, em todas as iniciativas que contribuam para a melhoria do sistema financeiro e para o desenvolvimento da economia e da sociedade portuguesa. Do meu lado, continuarei a orientar a minha atuao pelo primado do servio pblico, que se manifesta pela estabilidade financeira e monetria. Muito obrigado.

Title: Initial intervention of Deputy Governor Jos Ramalho in the Parliamentary Committee of Inquiry to the process that led to the sale and resolution of BANIF
text: Parliamentary Committee of Inquiry into the process leading to the sale and resolution of Banif April 26, 2016 Initial intervention by Deputy Governor Jose Ramalho Mr Chairman of the Parliamentary Committee of Inquiry Ladies and gentlemen Good morning I thank you for the opportunity to address this Commission and to provide all the clarifications that are within my power and to help to better understand the process that led to the sale and resolution of Banif. My intervention will focus on the role of Banco de Portugal as the Resolution Authority in the Banif process throughout 2015. I'm going to split the presentation into four parts. First, the preparation of contingency plans and the choice of a resolution strategy to apply in case of need. Second, the resolution decision, its constraints and reasoning. Third, the application of the resolution measure. And finally, if I may, I will conclude with a brief evaluation of the results and reflection on some of this process. First Part: Preparation of contingency plans and choice of resolution strategy Preparation of contingency plans Banco de Portugal has relaunched the preparation of contingency plans for Banif from May 2015. This preparation was due to the european Commission's repeated recommendations on the restructuring plans successively submitted by Banif and not approved, and also to the deterioration of the bank's situation. The preparation of contingency scenarios was strengthened from the beginning of October, along with the continuation of the voluntary sale plan by the bank's management and its shareholders. To support its work, Banco de Portugal has hired a financial adviser (Oliver Wyman), in particular for the preparation of an assessment in a resolution scenario, in accordance with the applicable regulatory framework (the BRRD, Bank Recovery and Resolution Directive, and the draft technical standards of the EBA, European Banking Authority). Legal advisors (Allen & Overy and Cuatrecasas) were also hired. The alternative scenarios studied were four, with the evaluation made in a methodology of disinvestment value (exit value): pblica recapitalization obrigatia, internal recapitalization (bail-in), transition bank and sale of the activity. The last two alternatives were combined with the prior segregation and transfer of part of the assets to an asset management vehicle. The scenarios were presented and discussed with the various European institutions involved  The European Commission's Directorate-General for Competition (DGComp), the ECB's Single Supervisory Mechanism (SSM) and the Single Resolution Board (SRB)  and with the Government, and several variants have been tested and updates have been made throughout the process. An assessment was also made in a liquidation scenario. In short, Banco de Portugal, within the time allowed by the progressive urgency of the situation, considered and analyzed the widest possible spectrum of alternatives and contingency plans for the possibility of irreversible deterioration of the Banif situation. Choice of contingency strategy Among the various scenarios studied, the choice of contingency strategy to be applied in case of need involved several phases, which configured a progressive bottleneck of the options until the only viable alternative to settlement became the sale of the activity in resolution. Let me summarize these successive phases. Step 1 Having evaluated the various contingency scenarios, Banco de Portugal informed the Ministry of Finance, in a letter of November 17, 2015, its preference for a pblica recapitalization solution, accompanied by a restructuring plan that was accepted by the General Directorate of Competition and involved the subsequent sale of Banif to another institution. This recommendation was taken into note in particular:  Banif's specific circumstances, in particular the structure of its liabilities (which would imply the possibility of rapidly affecting depositors in a potential resolution, or mobilising public funds to avoid it);  The high level of indebtedness of the Resolution Fund and the long-term burden stems from the financial system Portuguese, which advised no further use of the Fund; and  The concern to avoid the reputational risk of imposing a resolution measure on a bank widely perceived as public. Step 2 Already in December, the Ministry of Finance proposed to the General Directorate of Competition of the European Commission the combination of the pblica recapitalization alternative recommended by Banco de Portugal (however based in more detail in a letter of 4 December) with the integration in CGD. Banco de Portugal has adhering to this solution from the perspective of financial stability. However, the solution was made unfeasible by the General Directorate of Competition, based on arguments that are known to this CPI. Step 3 Among the alternative solutions, the internal recapitalisation (bail-in) was ruled out by Banco de Portugal, since banif's liability structure implied that this option would create a significant risk to financial stability, as it would involve losses for most senior creditors, including depositors (with the exception of pits protected by the Pitos Guarantee Fund and, by the end of 2015, of the depitos above 100,000 euros of natural persons or SMEs). In this context it was agreed preliminary (10/11 December) between the various parties involved (Banco de Portugal, Ministry of Finance, Directorate General of Competition of the European Commission, Single Supervisory Mechanism of the ECB) that, in case of failure of voluntary sale, implying the need for resolution, this would be made in the form of sale of the activity with as a solution of appeal (fallback)the establishment of a transitional bank. Step 4 Subsequently (15/16 December), however, the ECB's Single Supervisory Mechanism objected to the establishment of a transitional bank. The hipesis of the constitution of a transition bank was dependent on the finding of the impossibility of a sale. This made it impossible, in practice, to establish a transitional bank as a resource solution, in the required time horizon, and the availability of this resource solution as an element of strengthening the business capacity in the sales process. Thus, as a result of the successive restrictions introduced, the alternative resolution was limited to the sale of the activity, otherwise the bank would go into liquidation. Second Part: Resolution decision, its constraints and reasons Banif's decision to resolve on 20 December 2015 was taken under a set of strong constraints and constraints. The context that determined the need for the resolution measure on that date resulted from three key facts:  The failure of the voluntary sale process;  the serious worsening of the risks to the solvency of Banif; and  The serious deterioration of the bank's liquidity situation. Capital situation, constraints and constraints Banif's capital situation was already fragile, particularly since the end of 2014, which had even made it impossible for Banco de Portugal to allow the repayment of the final tranche of the CoCos in December 2014. More recently, Banco de Portugal had determined the implementation of several prudential adjustments, identified several material risks to the bank's capital position and, as a result, had determined banif to submit a capital plan and assess the viability and sustainability of the institution in the long term, without having obtained a satisfactory response. The risks to Banif's capital situation increased very severely from the moment the General Directorate of Competition expressed a clear preference for resolution (or liquidation) for deeming Banif unviable and unable to present a credible restructuring plan, and expressed great skepticism in pursuing the voluntary sale process. This position of the Directorate General for Competition (most notified from mid-November) considerably increased the risk of obligation to refund State aid, which would create a situation of irrecoverable capital shortfall. The ECB's Single Supervisory Mechanism has also repeatedly expressed its view of Banif's financial situation. Furthermore, if the matter were not resolved by the end of the year, from 1 January 2016 the control of the procedure would be taken over by the Single Resolution Board (SRB), in accordance with the legal framework of the Single Resolution Mechanism (SRM), and it is certain that the Council would not fail to take into account the opinions of the General Directorate of Competition and the Single Supervisory Mechanism of the ECB. The Single Resolution Board would have to assess whether Banif met the resolution criteria, in particular whether it was systemic. If banif was considered to have no systemic importance, the bank would be sent for liquidation; if systemic importance were recognised, the bank would be the subject of resolution, but in this case involving extensive bail-in, including unsecured events, with great probability. Liquidity situation and interaction with ECB Banif's liquidity situation, which has gradually deteriorated since late 2014, deteriorated dramatically in the week before the resolution. To this contributed news about an imminent intervention in the bank and risk of closure, and the generalization of the perception that the continuity of the bank depended on the success of the sale operation. With no more collateral eligible for additional access to Eurosystem monetary policy operations, Banif started to resort, from 15 December 2015, to emergency liquidity transfer operations by Banco de Portugal (ELA operations) in increasing amount (starting at 300 million euros on December 15 and ending the week at 1000 million). It should be noted that, in view of Banif's dramatic liquidity situation, Banco de Portugal discussed with the Ministry of Finance the possibility of alternative liquidity support measures. However, since it was possible to meet liquidity needs with ELA operations, these alternative measures were removed. On 16 December the Governing Council of the ECB decided to immediately limit, at the existing level, the amount of Banif's monetary policy operations (which, in any event, could no longer increase because the bank did not have more collateral for access to these operations) and decided in advance that Banif's access to those operations would be suspended (obliging the repayment of its balance) from 21 december if the bank had not been sold or resolved. Banco de Portugal informed the ECB's decision by the Government, the CMVM and the Banif Board of Directors (in this case only the immediate measure). Throughout the week, Banif's depitos were reduced by almost 1,000 million, so at the end of the week, even the collateral available for ELA operations was virtually exhausted (the existing buffer was only 124 million). The ongoing negative dynamic, which would certainly be accentuated by the disclosure of the failure of voluntary sales, would very likely prevent the bank from fulfilling its obligations to customers and from maintaining regular payment flows at the opening of the following week (December 21). Triggering and substantiating the resolution Following the progressive narrowing of the range of alternatives I described above, Banco de Portugal and the Ministry of Finance agreed that, since the successful voluntary sale was not successful, the sale of the activity in resolution was the least burdensome solution for financial stability and the protection of depositors and the public treasury, in view of the alternative available, which was just that of the liquidation. Banco de Portugal asked the Ministry of Finance to confirm the impossibility of making the voluntary sale and, since this solution required active involvement of the Ministry in the definition of the perimeter, distribution of losses, provision of guarantees and financial support of the State, also requested the Ministry to appoint an interlocutor with decision-making capacity to monitor the sales negotiations in resolution. The Ministry appointed the Deputy Secretary of State, the Treasury and Finance and an advisor. On December 18, the Ministry reported that the voluntary sale did not appear to have materialized, and confirmed this information the following day, based on a communication received from the Board of Directors of Banif. On 18 December, the General Directorate of Competition clarified that voluntary sales could not proceed if it involved State aid  which was the case in all proposals that were known to it  a situation that would imply the need for resolution. In this context, on December 19, Banco de Portugal decided to declare that Banif was at risk or in bankruptcy (failing or likely to fail). The (published) resolution recalls the history, relies on the communications received from the Ministry of Finance and the Directorate General for Competition, and substantiates the decision on the basis of the risk of creating an unrecoverable capital shortfall (by obligation to refund State aid) and the notified and accelerated degradation of Banif's liquidity situation, which put it at serious and serious risk of non-compliance with its obligations and the provision of essential financial services, which would also be aggravated by the frustration of expectations of voluntary sale. The resolution concludes that all this would imply that Banif would be led to a situation of non-compliance with the requirements for the maintenance of the authorisation for the exercise of its activity, so that it was at risk or in insolvency. In the circumstances described, Banco de Portugal thus decided to initiate the process of applying the measure of resolution of total or partial sale of Banif's activity. Selection of candidates The selection of candidates for purchase in resolution was conditioned by the extreme urgency of the process (to the extent that the proposals had to be submitted by the following day and the transaction concluded also on that day), by the draft commitments agreed with the General Directorate of Competition on the profile of the acquirer and by the legal requirements associated with a sale of banking activity. The urgency of the process limited the possible number of candidates (it would be very difficult to manage a process with more than a small number of competitors in such a short period of time) and, in practice, required them to be chosen from among the participants in the voluntary sale process (to benefit from their expression of interest and the knowledge they had acquired from Banif). For its part, the requirements of the draft of the State's letter of commitments regarding the profile of the acquirer restricted eligibility to a commercial bank with significant presence in Portugal or a certain global dimension and financial capacity. Added to these requirements was the legal need for the buyer to have a banking licence, since it was not the sale of a shareholder stake but the sale of the activity. The only two institutions that were profiled as meeting the various requirements were Banco Santander Totta and Banco Popular Espaol. Moreover, in the context of the voluntary sale process, the proposals of these two candidates were precisely those which had been selected by the advisor of that tender (the company N1) as the most interesting proposals. In this context, Banco de Portugal, the Ministry of Finance and their advisors initiated exploratory meeting scans with the two candidates, followed by teleconferences to which the European Commission's Directorate General for Competition was joined. In these days, in the same resolution of December 19, in which it was decided to start the resolution process with sale, Banco de Portugal selected Banco Santander Totta and Banco Popular Espaol for tender and approved the documents of this tender. Third Part: Application of the resolution measure Process The process of implementing the resolution measure took place over the weekend of 19 and 20 December. The measure applied consisted of the disposal of Banif's activity, combined with the prior segregation of part of the assets to an asset management vehicle. The two potential acquirers were delivered to specifications containing, inter alia, a summary description of the measure, including the transfer perimeter for the asset management vehicle. It was expressly stated that the proposals should be delivered by 8:00 a.m. on the 20th, with a view to the mandatory completion of the process by 23:59 on the same day. The process of implementing the measure involved numerous meetings and teleconferences (with competitors, Banco de Portugal and its advisors, the Ministry of Finance and its advisors, the European Commission's Directorate-General for Competition and also the ECB's Single Supervisory Mechanism) to discuss the proposals, to correct the letter of commitments of the authorities and to prepare for technical aspects. Of the two competitors only Banco Santander Totta presented a binding proposal, so the negotiations and discussions on Sunday focused on the proposal of this institution. The process also involved a close interaction and exchange of correspondence between Banco de Portugal and the Ministry of Finance with regard to the financing of the transaction, namely the burden-sharing between shareholders and creditors, the Resolution Fund and the State. Transaction description The approved transaction, according to Banco de Portugal's december 20 resolution, involved the breakdown of Banif's balance sheet into three components: (i) The vast majority of assets (about 9.7 thousand euros1) and the majority of senior and guaranteed liabilities (about 11.2 thousand euros) were transferred to Banco Santander Totta; (ii) A set of problematic or unwanted assets by the buyer (in particular real estate assets, defaulted credits and financial holdings totaling 2,200 million euros) was transferred to the Asset Management Vehicle Oitante, held by the Resolution Fund; (iii) And a residual set of assets remained in Banif, which will be settled within a short time. Assets transferred to the vehicle were subject ed to a heavy haircut determined by the General Directorate of Competition (about 66% on the balance sheet net value), so their value was reduced to 746 million euros; the acquisition of these assets by the vehicle was financed by the issuance of bonds, guaranteed by the Resolution Fund and counter-guaranteed by the State, which were delivered to Banco Santander Totta. Banco Santander Totta also received an amount of 2255 million euros (489 million from the Resolution Fund and 1766 million from the State) to bridge the gap between assets and liabilities, ensure a positive difference of 750 million euros (resulting from a minimum amount of CET1 funds fully loaded of 500 million euros) and cover credit risks, commercial, operational and legal. Small remaining adjustments were also made and Banco Santander Totta paid an amount of EUR 150 million, already taken into account in the amount mentioned above. In aggregate terms, the operation involved a cost of about 3.3 thousand euros, of which 1.4 thousand resulting from the haircut applied to assets transferred to the vehicle and about 1.8 thousand million arising from the value adjustments required by Banco Santander Totta and, residually, the assets left in Banif. 1 It does not include Oitante's debt securities (EUR 746 million) or the amount of public support by the State and Resolution Fund (totalling EUR 2255 million). The financing of this cost involved three components:  First, the imputation of losses to Banif's shareholders and subordinated creditors, in an amount slightly exceeding EUR 1000 million;  Secondly, the provision of financial support by the Resolution Fund (EUR 489 million), made up to the maximum limit allowed by BRRD and by law, and financed through a state loan to the Resolution Fund;  And finally, direct financial support from the state (1766 million euros). It should be noted that the total cost reached (3.3 thousand euros) was relatively close to that foreseen in the contingency scenario prepared by Banco de Portugal based on the exit value assessment over a very short horizon (2.9 thousand euros); the difference results from the combination of several factors, with emphasis on the greater haircut applied by the General Directorate of Competition in the transfer of assets to the vehicle (differential of about 0.4 thousand euros). The involvement of the Resolution Fund in the operation basically included three components: (i) direct financial support of 489 million euros, for loss absorption, financed by a state loan (in return for this support the Resolution Fund was left with a credit on the residual Banif, whose expected value, however, is a prime of zero); (ii) the provision of a guarantee to obligations issued by Oitante, in the amount of EUR 746 million, with a counter-guarantee from the State; and (iii) the subscription and realization of Oitante's share capital (50,000 euros). The state's involvement in the operation also basically included three components: (i) direct financial support of EUR 1766 million; (ii) the loan to the Resolution Fund in the amount of EUR 489 million; (iii) and the provision of a counter-guarantee to obligations issued by Oitante in the amount of EUR 746 million. Fourth Part: Brief evaluation of the results and some questions When a bank reaches a situation of irreparable financial imbalance, there are no no-cost solution. The questions that arise are, firstly, that of the size of these costs compared to alternative solutions, which we can only estimate because there is no counterfactual observed, and secondly, that of the distribution of costs between the various creditors of the settled bank, the other banks, and taxpayers. The application of the resolution measure to Banif has achieved the main objective of preserving financial stability. The measure ensured the protection of all depitos, as well as senior creditors. It also ensured the continuity of the financing of the economy (notably on the islands, where Banif was the market leader) and the provision of financial services by the bank, without any outage. There were no significant signs of contagion to the financial system or the economy. All of these are fundamental positive aspects that are not too much to highlight, because public attention tends to focus on costs and to underestimate the fact that what was essential has been safeguarded. And I would point out that preserving the essential sums is a result that was not guaranteed at the outset and that, or would not have been achieved with the alternative solution  settlement  or would certainly be cost, disupsure and much higher risks, including for taxpayers. That said, it is indisputable that the banif resolution entailed a very high absolute cost for Portuguese taxpayers, which penalizes us all. There are several reasons for this high cost for taxpayers. First, the scope of the absorption of losses by creditors, basically restricted to shareholders and subordinated creditors. This decision was taken by Banco de Portugal, in close coordination with the Ministry of Finance, and took into account the need not to risk financial stability, in view of a banif liability structure in which a greater scope of loss absorption would hit retail creditors and unsecured depositors. A second reason for the high cost to taxpayers was the heavy haircut applied by the General Directorate of Competition to assets transferred to the vehicle (although part of this amount may be recovered). Finally, and not least, the high cost to taxpayers has also resulted to a large extent from sales able sums, in an extremely short period and in a negotiating position greatly weakened by the absence of a redress solution other than liquidation. The experience gathered from this resolution raises a number of questions and questions. In particular, i would highlight three very brief reflections. First, this case illustrates the need to re-reflect on the treatment of banks in difficulty, compared to companies in other sectors, on the instruments available to deal with these situations and on the appropriate cost-sharing between creditors, other banks and taxpayers, when a bank is the subject of resolution and the financial funds are not sufficient to absorb all losses. Secondly, consideration should be given to whether the regulatory framework in Europe properly weighs the sometimes conflicting objectives of preserving financial stability, minimising costs for the taxpayer and maintaining competition. In particular, it seems deeply questionable the prevailing role that competition considerations play in these processes, to the detriment of the priority considerations, which are the preservation of financial stability and the protection of the public air. Moreover, concerns about competition in this context are considered from a limited perspective of avoiding distortions of competition resulting from State aid by disregarding (or taking secondary account) the potential for more general distortion of competition resulting from the banking merger process. Finally, it is important to assess whether the banking union's movement to set up can contribute to a reweightisation of priorities in banking resolution processes, or whether it will become even more complex by introducing new actors (the Single Supervisory Mechanism, the Single Resolution Board, in addition to the existing Directorate General for Competition), each focused on a specific mandate, without ensuring an efficient framework for coordination between them, and none of them have as a central concern the preservation of financial stability. Thank you very much.
text_original: Comisso Parlamentar de Inqurito ao processo que conduziu  venda e resoluo do Banif 26 de abril de 2016 Interveno inicial do Vice-Governador Jos Ramalho Senhor Presidente da Comisso Parlamentar de Inqurito Senhoras e senhores deputados Bom dia, Agradeo a oportunidade de me dirigir a esta Comisso e de prestar todos os esclarecimentos que estiverem ao meu alcance e possam contribuir para melhor compreender o processo que conduziu  venda e resoluo do Banif. A minha interveno ir centrar-se no papel do Banco de Portugal enquanto Autoridade de Resoluo no processo do Banif, ao longo do ano de 2015. Vou dividir a apresentao em quatro partes. Primeiro, a preparao de planos de contingncia e escolha duma estratgia de resoluo para aplicar em caso de necessidade. Segundo, a deciso de resoluo, suas condicionantes e fundamentao. Terceiro, a aplicao da medida de resoluo. E, finalmente, se me permitirem, concluirei com uma breve avaliao dos resultados e reflexo sobre algumas lis deste processo. Primeira Parte: Preparao de planos de contingncia e escolha da estratgia de resoluo Preparao dos planos de contingncia O Banco de Portugal relanou a preparao de planos de contingncia para o Banif a partir de maio de 2015. Essa preparao deveu-se s reiteradas dvidas da Comisso Europeia quanto aos planos de reestruturao sucessivamente apresentados pelo Banif e no aprovados, e tambm  deteriorao da situao do banco. A preparao dos cenrios de contingncia foi reforada a partir do incio de outubro, a par da prossecuo do plano de venda voluntria por parte da administrao do banco e respetivos acionistas. Para apoiar o seu trabalho, o Banco de Portugal contratou um consultor financeiro (Oliver Wyman), designadamente para a preparao duma avaliao em cenrio de resoluo, conforme o quadro regulatrio aplicvel (a BRRD, Diretiva de Recuperao e Resoluo Bancria, e o projeto de normas tcnicas da EBA, Autoridade Bancria Europeia). Foram tambm contratados assessores jurdicos (Allen & Overy e Cuatrecasas). Os cenrios alternativos estudados foram quatro, com a avaliao feita numa metodologia de valor de desinvestimento (exit value): recapitalizao pblica obrigatia, recapitalizao interna (bail-in), banco de transio e venda da atividade. As duas ltimas alternativas foram conjugadas com a prvia segregao e transferncia de parte dos ativos para um veculo de gesto de ativos. Os cenrios foram apresentados e discutidos com as vrias instituies europeias envolvidas  Direo Geral da Concorrncia da Comisso Europeia (DGComp), Mecanismo nico de Superviso do BCE (MUS) e Conselho nico de Resoluo (SRB)  e com o Governo, tendo sido ensaiadas variantes e feitas atualizaes diversas ao longo do processo. Foi tambm feita uma avaliao num cenrio de liquidao. Em suma, o Banco de Portugal, dentro do tempo permitido pela urgncia progressiva da situao, considerou e analisou o mais largo espectro possvel de alternativas e planos de contingncia para a eventualidade de se verificar uma deteriorao irreversvel da situao do Banif. Escolha da estratgia de contingncia De entre os vrios cenrios estudados, a escolha da estratgia de contingncia a aplicar em caso de necessidade envolveu diversas fases, que configuraram um progressivo afunilamento das ops at que a nica alternativa vivel  liquidao passou a ser a venda da atividade em resoluo. Deixem-me resumir estas sucessivas fases. Fase 1 Avaliados os diversos cenrios de contingncia, o Banco de Portugal comunicou ao Ministrio das Finanas, em carta de 17 de novembro de 2015, a sua preferncia por uma soluo de recapitalizao pblica, acompanhada por um plano de reestruturao que fosse aceite pela Direo Geral de Concorrncia e envolvesse a posterior alienao do Banif a outra instituio. Esta recomendao tinha em ateno, em particular:  As circunstncias especficas do Banif, nomeadamente a estrutura do seu passivo (a qual implicaria a possibilidade de rapidamente ser necessrio afetar negativamente depositantes numa potencial resoluo, ou de mobilizar fundos pblicos para o evitar);  O elevado nvel de endividamento do Fundo de Resoluo e os encargos que, a prazo, da resultam para o sistema financeiro portugus, o que desaconselhava nova utilizao do Fundo; e  A preocupao de evitar o risco reputacional de impor uma medida de resoluo a um banco largamente percebido como pblico. Fase 2 J em dezembro, o Ministrio das Finanas props  Direo Geral de Concorrncia da Comisso Europeia a conjugao da alternativa de recapitalizao pblica recomendada pelo Banco de Portugal (entretanto fundamentada de forma mais detalhada em carta de 4 de dezembro) com a integrao na CGD. O Banco de Portugal avaliou favoravelmente esta soluo, na perspetiva da estabilidade financeira. Contudo, a soluo foi inviabilizada pela Direo Geral de Concorrncia, com base em argumentos que so do conhecimento desta CPI. Fase 3 Entre as solus alternativas, a recapitalizao interna (bail-in) foi afastada pelo Banco de Portugal, uma vez que a estrutura de passivos do Banif implicava que esta opo criaria um risco significativo para a estabilidade financeira, dado que envolveria perdas para a generalidade dos credores seniores, incluindo depositantes (com exceo dos depitos protegidos pelo Fundo de Garantia dos Depitos e, at final de 2015, dos depitos acima de 100.000 euros de pessoas singulares ou PME). Neste contexto ficou acordado preliminarmente (10/11 de dezembro) entre as vrias partes envolvidas (Banco de Portugal, Ministrio das Finanas, Direo Geral de Concorrncia da Comisso Europeia, Mecanismo nico de Superviso do BCE) que, em caso de insucesso da venda voluntria, implicando a necessidade de resoluo, esta seria feita na modalidade de venda da atividade tendo como soluo de recurso (fallback)a constituio dum banco de transio. Fase 4 Posteriormente (15/16 dezembro), no entanto, o Mecanismo nico de Superviso do BCE colocou objes  constituio dum banco de transio. A hipese de constituio de um banco de transio ficou dependente da constatao da impossibilidade de uma venda. Isto inviabilizou, na prtica, a possibilidade de constituio dum banco de transio como soluo de recurso, no horizonte temporal exigido, e a disponibilidade dessa soluo de recurso como elemento de reforo da capacidade negocial no processo de venda. Deste modo, em consequncia das sucessivas restris introduzidas, a alternativa de resoluo ficou limitada  venda da atividade, caso contrrio o banco entraria em liquidao. Segunda Parte: Deciso de resoluo, suas condicionantes e fundamentao A deciso de resoluo do Banif, em 20 de dezembro de 2015, foi tomada sob um conjunto de fortes restris e condicionantes. O contexto que determinou a necessidade da medida de resoluo, nessa data, resultou de trs factos fundamentais:  O insucesso do processo de venda voluntria;  O srio agravamento dos riscos sobre a solvabilidade do Banif; e  A grave deteriorao da situao de liquidez do banco. Situao de capital, condicionantes e restries A situao de capital do Banif apresentava-se j frgil, designadamente desde finais de 2014, o que tinha inclusivamente impossibilitado que o Banco de Portugal permitisse o reembolso da tranche final dos CoCos em dezembro de 2014. Mais recentemente, o Banco de Portugal tinha determinado a implementao de vrios ajustamentos prudenciais, tinha identificado diversos riscos materiais sobre a posio de capital do banco e, em consequncia, tinha determinado ao Banif a apresentao dum plano de capital e uma avaliao da viabilidade e da sustentabilidade da instituio no longo prazo, sem ter obtido uma resposta satisfatia. Os riscos sobre a situao de capital do Banif aumentaram de forma muito grave a partir do momento em que a Direo Geral de Concorrncia manifestou uma preferncia clara pela resoluo (ou liquidao) por considerar o Banif invivel e incapaz de apresentar um plano de reestruturao credvel, e expressou grande ceticismo em prosseguir o processo de venda voluntria. Esta posio da Direo Geral de Concorrncia (mais notia a partir de meados de novembro) acentuou consideravelmente o risco de obrigao da restituio da ajuda de Estado, o que criaria uma situao de irrecupervel insuficincia de capital. Tambm o Mecanismo nico de Superviso do BCE manifestou recorrentemente dvidas em relao  situao financeira do Banif. Acresce que, se o assunto no fosse solucionado at final do ano, a partir de 1 de janeiro de 2016 o controlo do processo seria assumido pelo Conselho nico de Resoluo (SRB), de acordo com o quadro legal do Mecanismo nico de Resoluo (SRM), sendo certo que este Conselho no deixaria de ter em conta as opinis da Direo Geral de Concorrncia e do Mecanismo nico de Superviso do BCE. O Conselho nico de Resoluo teria de avaliar se o Banif cumpria os critrios para resoluo, designadamente se tinha importncia sistmica. Se fosse considerado que o Banif no tinha importncia sistmica, o banco seria enviado para liquidao; se fosse reconhecida importncia sistmica, o banco seria objeto de resoluo, mas, neste caso, envolvendo, com fortssima probabilidade, bail-in extensivo, incluindo de depitos no garantidos. Situao de liquidez e interao com BCE A situao de liquidez do Banif, em deteriorao gradual desde final de 2014, degradou-se dramaticamente na semana anterior  resoluo. Para isso contriburam notcias sobre uma iminente interveno no banco e risco de fecho, e a generalizao da perceo de que a continuidade do banco dependia do sucesso da operao de venda. No dispondo de mais colateral elegvel para acesso adicional a operas de poltica monetria do Eurosistema, o Banif passou a recorrer, a partir de 15 de dezembro de 2015, a operas de cedncia de liquidez de emergncia pelo Banco de Portugal (operas ELA) em montante crescente (comeando em 300 milhs de euros no dia 15 de dezembro e acabando a semana em 1000 milhs). De referir que, perante a situao dramtica de liquidez do Banif, o Banco de Portugal discutiu com o Ministrio das Finanas a possibilidade de medidas alternativas de apoio  liquidez. No entanto, tendo sido possvel suprir as necessidades de liquidez com operas ELA, aquelas medidas alternativas foram afastadas. No dia 16 dezembro o Conselho de Governadores do BCE decidiu limitar de imediato, no nvel existente, o montante de operas de poltica monetria do Banif (que, em todo o caso, j no podiam aumentar pelo facto de o banco no dispor de mais colateral para acesso a estas operas) e decidiu por antecipao que o acesso do Banif a essas operas seria suspenso (obrigando ao reembolso do respetivo saldo) a partir de dia 21 de dezembro, caso o banco no tivesse sido vendido nem resolvido. O Banco de Portugal informou da deciso do BCE o Governo, a CMVM e o Conselho de Administrao do Banif (neste ltimo caso apenas a medida imediata).
